ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY001_DESC: It's got all the twiddly knobs, the fancy band and something called a bezel. Treasure it.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY005_DESC: How many kills until I get the nuke? Now you don't have to ask anymore - just look at your watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY006_DESC: A pet watch that lets you hatch and look after your very own monster. It's a game within a game.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY007_DESC: Once you've drawn your last breath, the step counter will act as a memorial... until the battery runs out.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY008_DESC: You HAVE time to kill, or it IS time to kill? Your choice with this functional timepiece which tracks your K/D.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0101_DESC: Sail into darkness with the Black Sea Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0102_DESC: Careful not to drop the Desert Sands Watch on the beach, you may never find it again.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0103_DESC: Time your victory with the Mangrove Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0104_DESC: There's only one time that matters with the Sublime Watch... Just check your wrist.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY010_DESC: When your back is against the wall - it's time to crunch!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY011_DESC: Stay hungry with the Dinner Time watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY012_DESC: Always be on time with this DIY vacuum fluorescent display - long on brightness, short on battery life!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY013_DESC: Bask in the splendor of the Golden Grandeur watch
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY014_DESC: Strong, reliable, and readable yet impeccably beautiful. Handcrafted to the highest of standards.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY015_DESC: Thank you for participating in the Season 3 drops program!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY016_DESC: Not only does this watch tell perfect time but it keeps track of your progress through the ranks.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY018_DESC: Show off your true colors and your impeccable timekeeping skills, all in one chronographic triumph.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY019_DESC: Analogue precision + soft, glow-in-the-dark hands = the night raid operator's best friend.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY020_DESC:
Thank you for supporting our veterans!
Visit callofdutyendowment.org to learn more
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY021_DESC: Never lose track of the real time or date with the Digital Ink Watch - good for both martial and marital situational awareness.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY022_DESC: This one is for people who appreciate simplicity. It's retro, it looks cool and it tells the time.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY023_DESC: There\xe2\x80\x99s never anything better than a black edition\xe2\x80\x94and whatever may hatch from the Tomogunchi Black will be no exception.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY024_DESC: Track your in-game steps and heart rate while you track your enemies - the watch keeps you honest.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY025_DESC: Time is the fire in which our K/D ratios burn. Keep track of it all with the Time to Die watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY027_DESC: Father Time is as old as the hills. This watch's retro look belies its stellar performance, however.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY028_DESC: This watch ranks as one of the most progressive out there. Oh, and it shows your rank progress too.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY029_DESC: You're always mission-aware with the Tactics Tracker Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY030_DESC: Show them what you've got with the Emblem Precision II Watch which displays your currently equipped Emblem on its face.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY031_DESC: A hidden engraving in the rear plate reads: "Five long years he wore this watch..."
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY033_DESC: Any watch will tell the time, but few do it in as classy a manner as the Inotay Retro.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY034_DESC: Count down to the apocalypse with the Radioactive Watch, which tracks your progress towards a Tactical Nuke.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY035_DESC: Get a little extra time with the Freeze Frame Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY050_DESC: Spring forward or fall back with the Time Traveler Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY053_DESC: Don't get caught hibernating with the Ursa Minor Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY054_DESC: No need to watch the sun. Use the Blue Skies Watch, son.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY055_DESC: The Clepsydra Watch would no doubt be as useful underwater as above it. It's just, how would you test something like that?
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY056_DESC: Times are changing, just check your watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY057_DESC: Time to watch the world burn. Introducing the Swiftlet Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY058_DESC: Take it one thing at a time with the Red Barchetta Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY059_DESC: The biological clock is a ticking timebomb. Keep an eye on it with the Acid Rain Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY060_DESC: Keep track of the tides of battle with the Flood Plain Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY061_DESC: They'll wind up dead when you wear the Winding Skull Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY062_DESC: Plans will go like clockwork when you all synchronize with the Hammer Down Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY063_DESC: Colorful dreams and sleeping on the job? Prevent malfunctions with the Chromatose Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY064_DESC: It\xe2\x80\x99s always a bloody good time with the Blood Simple Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY065_DESC: Beat more than Father Time with the Red Ratio Watch and keep track of your K/D ratio while you're at it.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY066_DESC: The Call of Duty: Mobile Watch is featherweight, reliable, and obnoxiously hard to lose.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY067_DESC: They don't know it yet, but they're living on borrowed time when you're wearing the Jackals Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY068_DESC: The fabled Chimera is a cobbled-together animal \xe2\x80\x93 which is in stark contrast to the beautiful precision analog timepiece.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY069_DESC: It's been calculated that one human hour equates to seven dog hours. The Demon Dogs Watch keeps regular people time however.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY070_DESC: Come correct and get buttoned up with the Warcom Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY071_DESC: The SAS Watch embodies one trait above all others: dependability
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY072_DESC: In Communist Russia, time kills you. The Spetsnaz Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY073_DESC: Evolve your pet after each match to unlock corresponding pet charms. Make sure to keep your pet good and fed!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY074_DESC: Make sure your opponents never miss their appointment with death when you wear your A Time To Reap Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY076_DESC: Always keep spatial awareness when utilizing the Mini Map watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY077_DESC: Don't you just love seeing how stuff works? The Sortie Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY079_DESC: Take no time off with the Willpower Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY081_DESC: Your opponents will never miss their appointment with death when you rock the Redline Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY082_DESC: Give out more than red cards with the Injury Time Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY083_DESC: Timing is everything with the Steadfast Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY084_DESC: Look for a sign with the Foreshadow Watch. Results may vary.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY085_DESC: Time your assault perfectly with the Treasure Trove Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY086_DESC: Take to the sea! It's the Angamos Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY087_DESC: Get out of the weeds with the Shadowy Moor Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY088_DESC: The Calamity Watch is quite unexpected, but very welcome.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY089_DESC: Contrary to its name, this watch hates the water.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY090_DESC: No splitting hairs with the Isotope Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY092_DESC: Take the first shift with the Night Watchman Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY093_DESC: Calculate your average kills with the Golden Mean Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY094_DESC: You losing? Something isn't adding up, better double check the math.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY095_DESC: How many kills did I get today? Let's add 'em up!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY096_DESC: Ever needed to know where North or South was in a pinch? Just look at the Four Winds Watch on your wrist!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY098_DESC: Keep an eye on the time in style with the Strange Magic Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY099_DESC: Time your opponent's demise with the Death Note Watch.

challenge/pmc_ai_weapon_extract_detail_d:
We need to acquire intel about how Al-Qatala is arming its grunts. Bring back some of their weapons so we can analyze them.

Extract ^.&&1^7 enemy grunt weapons.
challenge/pmc_capture_sam_site_detail_de:
Al-Qatala has set up several surface-to-air missile sites in the DMZ. There are frequently transport planes flying overhead, SAM sites can shoot them down allowing you to recover their supplies.

Capture ^.&&1^7 SAM sites.
challenge/pmc_cash_extract_detail_desc:
We are low on coin because of several consecutive botched operations by your fellow soldiers. We need a lump sum urgently for an upcoming mission.

Extract ^.&&1^7 cash in one match.
challenge/pmc_charlie725_extract_detail_:
Uncle Sam is looking to do some research on the weapons being distributed throughout Al Mazrah. Acquire and extract a Hail Storm shotgun and we can use it to gain some goodwill with the feds. 

There's a rumor the Hail Storm can be purchased at specific buy stations.

Extract a Hail Storm.
challenge/pmc_extract_weapon_case_desc: Kill a boss and extract their weapon case.
challenge/pmc_extract_weapon_case_detail:
We've received intel that the chemist has acquired a weapon case containing valuable rare weapons. Find a hard drive and upload it in order to track him down. Acquire his weapon case by any means necessary.

Kill a boss and extract their weapon case.
challenge/pmc_full_backpack_extract_deta: While we recover from the recent attacks, our infiltrations and extractions from the AO will be limited. Recover enough items to fill your backpack and make it worth the risk.
challenge/pmc_gas_drain_detail_desc:
Al-Qatala is planning to transport weapons using civilian vehicles, drive nearby vehicles until their tanks are empty to sabotage Al-Qatala's plans.

Empty ^.&&1^7 vehicles of gas.
challenge/pmc_grenade_extract_desc: Extract with ^.&&1^7 different lethals or tacticals.
challenge/pmc_grenade_extract_detail_des: Extract with ^.&&1^7 different lethals or tacticals.
challenge/pmc_hydro_shotgun_ai_desc: Kill ^.&&1^7 grunts in hydro using a shotgun.
challenge/pmc_hydro_shotgun_ai_detail_de:
Travel to Hydro and get up close to the Al-Qatala infantry so we can observe their tactics. Dispatch them with a shotgun. You can acquire one in a buy station or in an enemy supply cache.

Travel to Hydro ^.&&1^7 time.
Kill ^.&&2^7 grunts in hydro using a shotgun.
challenge/pmc_kill_riot_shield_detail_de:
Enemy strongholds are often guarded by well equipped grunts with riot shields. If you can outflank them you'll have easy access to the loot they're protecting.

Kill ^.&&1^7 riot shield grunts.
challenge/pmc_kill_tier3_detail_desc:
Heavily armored grunts will infil if you cause enough trouble in the DMZ. We need intel on their combat capabilities, get their attention and terminate them.

Kill ^.&&1^7 armored grunts.
challenge/pmc_liquor_extract_detail_desc:
Before Al Mazrah was evacuated, a famous collector of fine liquors lived there. Looters have stolen and relocated most of his collection all around Al Mazrah. Find a few bottles and bring them back, they're highly valuable.

Extract ^.&&1^7 liquor bottles.
challenge/pmc_long_range_kill_detail_des:
Good marksmen can take out enemies before they're ever detected. Prove your marksmanship by eliminating some Al-Qatala grunts from long range.

Kill ^.&&1^7 grunts at long range.
challenge/pmc_oilfield_sniper_ai_desc: Kill ^.&&1^7 grunts in oilfield using a sniper rifle.
challenge/pmc_oilfield_sniper_ai_detail_:
The Oilfields are a critical POI for our operation. Wipe out the grunts there, but don't get too close. Acquire a sniper rifle at a buy station or elsewhere and use it to eliminate the hostiles.

Travel to Oilfield ^.&&1^7 time.
Kill ^.&&2^7 grunts in oilfield using a sniper rifle.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_ar_desc: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with an assault rifle.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_ar_detail_de:
Prove that you have the skills to be a helpful asset to us. Acquire an assault rifle and use it to terminate other operators.

Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with an assault rifle.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_detail_desc:
We need to increase our influence in Al Mazrah. Eliminate any operators you find to strengthen our foothold.

Kill ^.&&1^7 operators.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_exhume_detai:
Command wants to get a foothold in Quarry, but informants have told us about rampant activity from other Factions. Clear out some of their operators so we can move in.

Kill ^.&&1^7 operators in Quarry.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_smg_detail_d:
Weapons found in the DMZ are unreliable. Verify the killing potential of a recovered SMG by testing it on hostile operators.

Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with an SMG.
challenge/pmc_pistol_headshot_desc: Kill ^.&&1^7 grunts with headshots using a pistol.
challenge/pmc_pistol_headshot_detail_des: Kill ^.&&1^7 grunts with headshots using a pistol.
challenge/pmc_poi_travel_desc: Travel to ^.&&1^7 different Points of Interest (POIs) in one deployment.
challenge/pmc_poi_travel_detail_desc: Al-Qatala has taken over our area of occupation and we need to understand their command structure to know where to hit them. Recon multiple sectors in the area and we'll observe how their network operates.
challenge/pmc_tag_extract_detail_desc:
We need proof of enemy faction presence in the DMZ to get approval for higher troop deployments. Tech will run a background check on the operator and pay you a lump sum for each dog tag extracted.

Extract ^.&&1^7 operator dog tags.
challenge/pmc_task_elimination_detail_de:
Al-Qatala has stationed several high value targets in Al Mazrah. Intercept their communications to track them down and eliminate them.

Complete ^.&&1^7 elimination contracts.
challenge/pmc_task_hunt_detail_desc:
You can intercept enemy communications in order to find the location of hostile Faction operators. Use this intel to eliminate enemy squads.

Complete ^.&&1^7 hunt contracts.
challenge/pmc_uav_tower_detail_desc: AQ is using UAV Towers to recon the area. Gaining access to these towers is a priority for Signals Intellience. Your primary objective is to locate a UAV Tower, access the controls, and reroute the signal.
challenge/pmc_uav_tower_single_detail_de: Al-Qatala has deployed UAV towers at many points of interest around the DMZ. These towers provide critical intel on the surrounding areas. Activate them and route the signal to base so we can gain an informational advantage.

challenge/pmc_vehicle_destruction_detail: Transport is scarce in Al Mazrah, so AQ is commandeering all vehicles in the area. We need you to limit their movement capabilities for an upcoming operation. Locate and destroy any vehicles you find.

CINEMATICS/CAPTIVE_DESC: With the Wolf dead, but Hadir and the gas still at large, Farah\xe2\x80\x99s forces are put on the Foreign Terrorist Organization list. Alex chooses to stay with Farah\xe2\x80\x99s army.
CINEMATICS/EPILOGUE_DESC: In the wake of their success against Barkov, Price and Laswell discuss the formation of new task force called \xe2\x80\x9c141.\xe2\x80\x9d
CINEMATICS/ESTATE_DESC: On the heels of a trying interrogation of the Butcher, Price and Kyle race to intercept Hadir at Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s estate as Kyle questions where they draw the line.
CINEMATICS/HIGHWAY_DESC: Farah hatches a plan to ambush the Wolf on the \xe2\x80\x9cHighway of Death\xe2\x80\x9d before he can escape to the mountains.
CINEMATICS/LAB_DESC: Hadir discovers the location of Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s gas factory but is apprehended by Price and Kyle. Laswell gives Hadir to the Russians. Price asks Farah to help him destroy the lab.
CINEMATICS/MARINES_DESC: Alex and Farah prep for a mission to capture the Wolf. Farah explains that anyone who uses terrorist tactics is her enemy, without exception.
CINEMATICS/PICCADILLY_DESC: After terrorists steal Russian gas from General Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s PMCs, Laswell calls Captain John Price for help with recovering the stolen chemicals and de-escalating tensions with Russia.
CINEMATICS/PROXYWAR_DESC: CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell commands an operation with Ground Branch officer Alex and Marine Raiders to intercept a chemical weapons shipment bound for Urzikstan.
CINEMATICS/SACRIFICE_DESC: The team plants charges to demolish Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s gas facility but the detonator is damaged. Alex volunteers to sacrifice himself and set off the explosions manually.
CINEMATICS/SAFEHOUSE_DESC: When Al-Qatala claims responsibility for a London attack, SAS Sgt. Kyle Garrick wants to escalate. Alex meets with militia Commander Karim to join forces in pursuit of the stolen gas.
CINEMATICS/SAFEHOUSEFINALE_DESC: From Hadir\xe2\x80\x99s safehouse, Hadir and Alex prep for an assault on General Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s airbase.
CINEMATICS/STPETERSBURG_DESC: Then: Lt. Price helps rescue Farah and Hadir from Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s POW camp. Now: intel says Hadir is planning an attack in Russia. Price and Laswell launch a covert mission to stop it.
CINEMATICS/TOWNHOUSED_DESC: Kyle\xe2\x80\x99s intel leads to a raid on a London townhouse where the Al-Qatala terror cell is holed-up.
CINEMATICS/TUNNELS_DESC: Upon discovering that her brother Hadir is responsible for stealing the Russian gas, and is now in Al-Qatala\xe2\x80\x99s hands, Farah vows to hunt him down alongside Price\xe2\x80\x99s team.

CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL11_TXT:
"Yaser, come in."
"Go ahead, brother."
"You are in Zone 17, yes?"
"Yes. Setting up the servers now."
"ETA?"
"Two years? This hardware is ancient."
"We need it done today."
"Then get Abu-Jamil here. He has more experience with this."
"He is needed in Zone 5. You will have to do this alone."
"Okay, but I will tell you, this hardware is easy to detect. Drones, satellites\xe2\x80\xa6any newer tech will find these fast."
"Understood. We just need it working, as planned. Security will come later."
"I will radio when the job is done."
"Okay, brother."
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL12_TXT:
"3-1,
Received intel on hidden bunker in the Sattiq mountains.
NE hillside \xe2\x80\x93 hatchway leads underground.
Need Echo Team to gain access and recon the location.
This could be what we\xe2\x80\x99ve feared. Guard yourself.

For Urzikstan. 
  \xe2\x80\x93 K\xe2\x80\x9d
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL13_TXT:
"Brothers- we were victorious in our mission.\xe2\x80\x9d
We killed many invaders and captured the ones we sought.
The prisoners were taken to the embassy. 
They will be ready to instruct our teams.

We await news of your success in Sattiq. 
- Jabour"
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL14_TXT:
"URGENT -- CHEMICAL LEAK IN LAB01/LAB02 STORAGE AREA
DO NOT ENTER | EXTREMELY DANGEROUS

CONTAINMENT TEAM:
Access only if storage area has been ventilated via control console(s).
Contact LAB01/02 Management for assistance."
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL16_TXT:
We have sent word to our partners across the sea.
Offered routes, resources, a foothold.
They are on their way to Al-Mazrah.
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL17_TXT:
3-1
Arif and others dead.
AQ is after missile. Could already have it.
Heading up silo \xe2\x80\x93 will disarm if able.
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL18_TXT:
We lost a brother to the gas. 
The vent system reboots \xe2\x80\x93 the chemicals come back.
Security systems are becoming more difficult to bypass.
Require specific sequences, multiple people. Sometimes 3, sometimes 10.
With faith, we will find what we need before being discovered.
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL20_TXT:
We have the material.
Still in the city.
Will cross the border soon.
Meet there.
- \xd8\xad
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL21_TXT:
My sister, Farah Karim, has been captured.
Two soldiers are with her \xe2\x80\x93 one British, one American.
These soldiers are subject to the law of war. They live by the sword; they die by it.
As for my sister, trust when I tell you- she is better to us alive.
The Russians are her enemy. Our enemy. Urzikstan is her home. Our home.
I will not allow her to stop what we have begun here, but I believe she will help us finish it.
-H
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL22_TXT:
Why follow him?\xe2\x80\x9d they have asked.
I follow him because I followed the Wolf.
Sulaman believed in Hadir, and in return he gave us the power to fight.
Fight those who have sought to be our masters.
Now Hadir has given us something beyond power- and so I follow him, still.
 
\xe2\x80\x9cOur children stand on our shoulders and see the future.
What future exists if we live on our knees?
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL23_TXT:
Sister,
I understand your hatred for these things I have done- and your hatred for me.
I do not bear your scorn lightly, for we are the same blood, but it is a price I am willing to pay.
My hatred is to the Russians. The real Russians. The ones who destroyed our family, our country, and hid their cities beneath our ground.
We have fought the Russians since we were children. No child should have to fight them again.
All I have done has been, and will always be,\xc2\xa0for Urzikstan.
H
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL24_TXT:
We are through the underground city.
This is but one. Of how many, only the real Russians know.
With Hadir\xe2\x80\x99s help, we will find the others.
These weapons they made to kill us, will send them to hell.
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL25_TXT:
Prepare the barrels for transport.
Store them near the elevator.
Be safe, brothers. We know what harm these chemicals can do.
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL2_TXT:
"Safi-
The enemy is here. We will be overrun.

I am low on men. Replaced a group we lost just yesterday. 
Supplies are scarce from the fighting in areas 5 and 6.

Destroy Site 3. Do not let the enemy find its destination.
Use groups 6, 7, and 12.

Do not hesitate."
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL4_TXT:
"Abassi-?"
"Yes, brother?"
"What is taking so long? Get the launchers in position."
"We are moving as fast as we can."
"You must go faster, brother. Gunships are in the air."
"For days we have run supplies, moved launchers, dug trenches...my men are exhausted!"
"What do you need then?"
"Proper equipment- and rest!"
"Sleep is not an option. Start drinking all that coffee around you."
"We are! I came here to fight, not harvest beans."
"Okay- listen. Move the launchers so we can attack their gunships. Once we can move, we will get equipment to you."
"Yes, brother. Thank you."
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL5_TXT:
URGENT // PRIORITY TASKING

Request immediate deployment of THREE (3) Demon Dog Squads to the ZAYA OBSERVATORY.  Al-Qatala is after stockpiles of munitions abandoned by Shadow Co. operators.

Primary Objective(s):
Secure munitions and the Zaya Observatory.
This will give us a tactical advantage in the region and keep weapons out of AQ hands.

KL/Watcher-1
CP_INTEL_IW9/INTEL8_TXT:
"Brothers - we are losing too many soldiers.  Team 3 was wiped out. We lost 6, 7, and 12 at the observatory. If we do not win the next battles, we will lose this war.

We need immediate reinforcements to zone 17. 
Send team 9. They must not fail their mission."
CP_INTEL_IW9/PHOTO_TEXT_1:
Mother,
I want you to know I am safe, for now. Though this may be the last time you hear from me. 
This morning, the Killers arrived. They came with weapons and anger. They took us from our homes and gave them to soldiers. The home papa built for us now houses those monsters.
I was able to escape, but my Kamal was taken. God only knows what they've done to him. 
You will worry for me, and I would be a fool to tell you otherwise. 
Please know that I have not given up. 
I still have hope.
-Amal

MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MEDICAL01:
^BMedical Journal^R
Entry 1:
MAR 04, 2020

\xe2\x80\xa6Since the accident on Floor 3 this morning, patients have experienced symptoms including: loss of appetite, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and even seizures and coma.

One of the security guards is still in critical condition. We had to sedate him after he started screaming at us in Russian. Will have to add delirium to the list of symptoms\xe2\x80\xa6

I\xe2\x80\x99ve never seen anything like this before.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MEDICAL02:
^BMedical Journal^R
Entry 2:
MAR 11, 2020

To be honest, we don\xe2\x80\x99t have the necessary medical support for those patients. The only thing we can do is easing their pain.

However, we are not allowed to transfer them to the ER nearby. Only medical and security employees have access to the ICU. Guards are all over. 

By the way, just out of nowhere, some of the patient\xe2\x80\x99s reports are missing somehow.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MEDICAL03:
^BMedical Journal^R
Entry 3:
APR 04, 2020

Some members of our medical team have expressed further concerns about the long-term effects of radiation exposure. 

What if another accident like that happens to us? What if it was not an accident?

Well, department leads ask us not to investigate it. Not even talk about it. 

I can\xe2\x80\x99t do this any longer.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS01:
^BPrecision Equipment Handling^R
MAR 19, 2020

Please make sure your crew takes extreme caution when handling the precision equipment. There\xe2\x80\x99s an accident caused by improper operation recently. We cannot afford any further loss.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS02:
^BShipment Ready^R
NOV 05, 2020

This should be the last shipment to <redacted> this month.

Make sure you have the right treatment and make deliveries ASAP.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS03:
^BAccident Report^R
SEP 09, 2019

There was a blast in the Side Lab this morning, causing potential gas leaks. All the security doors automatically sealed, but some staff members are hurt. The wounded have been sent to the hospital for physical examination.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS06:
^BAccess Cards^R

Professor, can we try to get more access cards for the whole team? 

Each time when we need something from those locked rooms, it\xe2\x80\x99s always frustrating to make official requests that usually takes forever.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS07:
^BElevators^R

Steve,

To use elevators in the facility, you need higher security permissions. 

I know it might be inconvenient to move around here sometimes, but the DRC is a highly classified place with restricted areas, and I hope you understand that this is mainly out of safety concerns.

-Rebecca
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS08:
^BComplaint Letter^R
AUG 30, 2019

The garage is too dark! I almost fell to the ground yesterday, and it\xe2\x80\x99s nearly impossible to find anything. 

I can\xe2\x80\x99t imagine what would happen if we keep it that way.

-Anonymous
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS09:
^BOT Food Request^R

Could we provide more food to employees who work overtime?

Seems that we have a pretty nice restaurant, but it\xe2\x80\x99s closing way too early.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_MISCELLANEOUS10:
^BRequest Accepted^R
JAN 09, 2020

Hello Terissa,

I\xe2\x80\x99m happy to inform you that your application to the Gym Club has been accepted. 

As a new member, you\xe2\x80\x99ll have access to all available programs, including our most popular Aikido courses. 

Enjoy!

Fonda
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_OFFICER01:
^BJournal of an Officer ^R
Entry 1:
JUNE 19, 2019

Voice record of a security officer.

\xe2\x80\xa6Please read your DRC Employee Handbook to learn about our Lab Protection Conditions (LPCON).

LPCON is a system of recommended preventive actions and responses to hostile adversaries\xe2\x80\xa6

\xe2\x80\xa6It sets the LPCON level at Normal, Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, and Delta.

Higher LPCON levels will be applied when an increased or more predictable threat exists in the facility\xe2\x80\xa6
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_OFFICER02:
^BJournal of an Officer ^R
Entry 2:
AUG 01, 2019

Introduced the LPCON levels in the facility to all new employees during the security training program. We get a lot of former-military types here, but something\xe2\x80\x99s different about these fellas. Look and talk like SF? 

Found it concerning they wouldn\xe2\x80\x99t take the LPCON levels seriously. They thought the DRC is well protected, and there\xe2\x80\x99s no such thing as a real threat.

I really hope they were right.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_OFFICER03:
^BJournal of an Officer ^R
Entry 3:
DEC 29, 2019

LPCON ECHO IS REAL.

I would never believe this if I hadn\xe2\x80\x99t seen it with my own eyes.

Beyond LPCON Delta, they are prepared to kill EVERYONE if things go bad. Even I\xe2\x80\xa6cannot escape.

Everything makes sense now. No wonder the Armory Room is always locked and guarded by the security crew. The rumor that large amounts of lethal weapons are stored there must be true.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_OFFICER04:
^BJournal of an Officer ^R
Entry 4:
FEB 06, 2020

Need to prepare for emergencies. Right now.

Move fast. No chance to escape if LPCON ECHO is really applied. The whole facility will be locked, with gas spreading everywhere. The reaction team could easily eliminate anyone who\xe2\x80\x99s exposed.

Remember to stay low. It\xe2\x80\x99s safe to use elevators. They would be running on backup power. Gas Masks should be there.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_RESEARCHER01:
^BResearch Journal ^R
Entry 1:
OCT 19, 2019

This is my first day at the DRC. 

I can\xe2\x80\x99t be more excited to work as a Biochemistry specialist. The colleagues here are all top-tier scientists in this field.

It\xe2\x80\x99s a bit strange though \xe2\x80\x93 security here is more strict than other places. As soon as I entered the facility, security took my cellphone and other communication equipment for safety reasons. Network connection is highly restricted in the facility. It felt like working for the military instead of a Lab.

But anyways I must go through a series of training exercises designed for new employees. Hopefully I can get my hands on laboratory equipment soon.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_RESEARCHER02:
^BResearch Journal ^R
Entry 2:
JAN 30, 2020

The experiments here are quite suspicious.

I took a glance at the research journals the other day, and found these records\xe2\x80\xa6

\xe2\x80\x9cSubject 2-51 become unconscious after taking the 3rd dose within 24 hours.

Subject still in coma. Estimated to be incapacitated for another 6-8 hours.

Subject 2-51 gone. This is beyond maximum tolerance.\xe2\x80\x9d

Are they testing on animals or humans? Is this why they have such a huge hospital in this building?
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_RESEARCHER03:
^BResearch Journal ^R
Entry 3:
MAR 05, 2020

There was an accident on the third-floor last week. Rumor says it caused gas leak around that area, and quite a few people were sent to the ICU.

I talked with the victims. It turns out that the DRC has been shipping some of our test substance to Verdansk- and our security team is aware of the whole thing. Rumor is the DRC has military ties. We\xe2\x80\x99re supposed to be working on deterrents of war, not weapons of it. Why are they doing this?
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_RESEARCHER04:
^BResearch Journal ^R
Entry 4:
MARCH 21, 2020

The DRC facility is completely cut off in connection with the outside world. We are not allowed to contact family or friends while we are here. We are not allowed to leave the facility either. 

Security has become more aggressive with us. We see them moving weapons, vehicles \xe2\x80\x93 armored ones like the Army have. It\xe2\x80\x99s like they know something\xe2\x80\x99s coming and they\xe2\x80\x99re abandoning ship.

Maybe they are military\xe2\x80\xa6Army? Contractors? At least that would make more sense. But if something has them spooked, that doesn\xe2\x80\x99t bode well for the rest of us.
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_SECURITY01:
^BData Center Attack^R
SEP 26, 2019

Hi all,

There are multiple new security employees that are not on any approved/vetted list, yet they\xe2\x80\x99re getting priority clearance without looping us in. All DRC employees MUST be cleared by IT before accessing restricted areas.

With the unusual amount of attack to the servers lately, security is our top priority. 

If you have any problems, do not hesitate to reach out to the security team for support.


-DRC Security
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_SECURITY02:
^BFacility Access Card Policy^R
SEP 30, 2019

Hi all,

Our team has received several reports on missing access cards this month. 

Here\xe2\x80\x99s a reminder that no access card should be brought out of the facility or borrowed to others according to our policies.

All access cards are important assets of the DRC, and anyone who lost one will have to file a report to explain what happened.

-DRC Security
MP_BIO_LAB/JOURANL_SECURITY03:
^BSecurity Locks Upgrade^R
JAN 04, 2020

Team,

I\xe2\x80\x99m sure some of you have heard about the new LPCON \xe2\x80\x93 ECHO\xe2\x80\xa6

We\xe2\x80\x99ve been asked to take certain measures given the new security protocol:

-	Today we\xe2\x80\x99ve completed a sensor upgrade to all the doors among High Security Areas. As a result, no personnel would be able to enter those restricted areas without granted permissions.

-	In the event of an LPCon Echo, ^Ball system files will be erased^R. 

Please keep this to yourselves, as we don\xe2\x80\x99t want employees making personal copies of any files.

If anyone has any questions/concerns, my door is always open.

Thanks,

-DRC Security

MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_BOSS01:
^BReinforcement Sent^R
 
Reports have been filed on disturbances that happened in the Factory Wing occasionally. We\xe2\x80\x99ve got reasonable suspicion of smuggling, or some sort of resistance organized by locals. 

A group of reinforcements, led by two expert commanders, has been dispatched to the Factory Wing. The Rhinoceros, one of the aces in close-quarters combat, used to be the bodyguard of a senior officer for years. The Sniper, a silent killer, can instantly take down targets from miles away. With these guys guarding the area, the Weapon Case stored there should be safe.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_BOSS02:
^BOperation W^R

The objective is to protect the assets in the Factory Wing Secure Room.

Be prepared for armed resistance you may encounter. Remove all threats if necessary.

A response team will follow your lead. The Sniper will provide fire support.

Call reinforcement if things go south.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_BOSS03:
^BOperation W^R

Get into the hideout on the high ground. Spotter and ammunition are all set.

Eliminate any target entering the Factory Wing.

Use emergency access as the escape route once your position is exposed.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_DARK01:
^BChemical Plant^R

Not sure where that complaint is coming from. The power supply has not been fully restored in the Chemical Plant, and that\xe2\x80\x99s why the whole area is so dark. I\xe2\x80\x99m fully aware of the inconvenience caused by this, but do they have any idea how much electricity is needed to operate a facility of this magnitude? 

All I\xe2\x80\x99m asking is a bit of patience until the problem is handled. As a backup, all the units in the dark have been equipped with flashlights or NVGs.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_DARK02:
^BThe Key^R

Someone left the key to Factory Admin on the floor of the Chemical Plant. Please come and retrieve it ASAP.

-R
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_DARK03:
^BFind the Key^R

Someone left the key to Factory Admin in the door again. I bet it must be George! That blockhead has done such things multiple times. Find the other key in the Chemical Plant. It must be somewhere around there.

-K
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_DATA_CENTER01: It\xe2\x80\x99s not surprising that the Soviets were storing all sorts of data, like they always did, but it\xe2\x80\x99s hard to imagine how much space it takes to accommodate all the equipment in use. This place, the so-called Alpha Cluster, is so large that it feels like a mining farm filled with data tapes.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_DATA_CENTER02: To make it more mysterious, some rooms in the Alpha Cluster have been on lock since the day we arrived. Maybe it\xe2\x80\x99s the Soviets who did this, but who knows? What secrets were they hiding behind those walls?
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_ENTRANCE_A01:
^BDefense Research Division^R

A large amount of radiation was detected when we first discovered this area. During the investigation, we found multiple radioactive nuclear materials, hidden in several locations. This lab, formally known as the Defense Research Division, was run by the Soviet military. It\xe2\x80\x99s most likely that the nuclear materials were left here by them when they evacuated from here for some reason.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_ENTRANCE_A02:
^BRadiation Hazard^R

These high-risk areas remain dangerous, as my hazmat crew is still cleaning up the site. It\xe2\x80\x99s not clear what purpose the Soviet\xe2\x80\x99s research had, so proceed with caution during any of your operations.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_ENTRANCE_B01:
^BNote from a Soldier^R

This place looks like a living accommodation for military personnel, back at the time when it was functional. What were the Soviets doing down here, over 100 feet underground? Why do they need such a large number of soldiers?
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_ENTRANCE_B02:
^BNote from a Soldier^R

It\xe2\x80\x99s been a shithole since someone blew a hole in the ceiling, then water leaked in and flooded the entire area. God knows how toxic the water could be! Honestly, I\xe2\x80\x99m willing to trade anything for a chance to get out of here.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_ENTRANCE_C_D:
^BPower Supply^R

Due to the lack of power supply, the blast doors to the Chemical Plant can only be forced to open from the outside. However, we\xe2\x80\x99re not allowed to leave these doors open during operations, making it a pain in the rear for my guys to do their job. 

If we can find a car battery and jumper cables to power up and activate the blast doors, it will save us a lot of trouble.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_HANDBOOK01:
^BEmergency Response^R

In case of emergency, all access to the outside will be blocked, except for the elevators run by our allies on the ground. Read the following instructions for details: 

- Call the elevator by pushing the button on the wall. 

- Wait for a few seconds. The elevator should arrive shortly. 

- Step inside and operate on the control panel. Be aware that the elevator has been programmed to leave automatically if there\xe2\x80\x99s no response.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_HANDBOOK02:
^BRadiation Lab^R

All personnel must wear gas masks inside radiation labs.

Do not operate the buttons to control the airtight doors during experiments.

In case of a gas leak, use the valve handle at the door to force close the door.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_HANDBOOK03:
^BExternal Communication^R

For security reasons, private contact with the outside is prohibited.

All communication devices are managed in the comms room at External Ops.

File an application if you do have a need for external communication. Approval of superiors is required.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_HANDBOOK04:
^BAccess Permission^R

No personnel shall make unauthorized entry into the Information Extraction. Nor shall any person remain there without authorization after working hours.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_HANDBOOK05:
^BFactory Admin^R

When in short of living supplies, apply for more and receive them at Factory Admin.

Factory Admin is located to the north of the Chemical Plant.

No supply of anything that may cause addiction, e.g., cigarettes, alcohol, and hypnotics.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_MAD01:
^BEntry 1^R

My name is Sergei. This is my story.

I started my career at the Laboratory of Electrical Systems, under the direction of the Academy of Science. Back at the time, ideological limitations were loosened and a new hope for cybernetics has just been built.

As a young mathematician working on complex analysis and differential equations, I devoted myself to the cause of numerical computation. I could never imagine that one day, my life would be completely changed by intelligent systems.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_MAD02:
^BEntry 2^R

Together with a group of scientists and engineers, I was sent to this bunker to conduct a secret program. Not until we arrived did we realize that the job was to develop the most advanced computer in the USSR and in the world.

This machine would be powered by a new intelligent system, taking advantage of algorithms the world had never heard of. Unlike Kaissa, the chess-playing program, it could perform larger-scale computation and handle more complex tasks.

As the operation of this system would generate a huge amount of data, countless computing and storage units were built inside Alpha Cluster.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_MAD03:
^BEntry 3^R

We\xe2\x80\x99ve got promising results from the development of the supercomputer. It has way higher performance than the previous model, but occupies 6 times less area, and consumes 8 times less electricity power.

With the help of the newly designed intelligent system, it can assist in computation with unprecedented efficiency. It can be applied to a variety of disciplines, such as rocket science and aerospace industry.

Since it\xe2\x80\x99s so advanced, compared to its predecessors, we decided to name it M-550.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_MAD04:
^BEntry 4^R

The government has decided to abandon the development of original computer designs, including our program. The laboratory will be permanently closed in the near future.

I don\xe2\x80\x99t think they understand the value of our research. With the M-550, we could easily catch up with the West in the race of computation technology. It could have changed the world!
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_MAD05:
^BEntry 5^R

After protests against the decision have failed, I have to find another way. 

I saved a copy of the algorithm that was ordered to be deleted, and stored the data in a safe place. I scrabbled on the walls with radiation, leaving marks that lead to the safe room.

If someone could ever discover them, hopefully they may unravel the secrets, and let M-550 live again. This is the least I can do.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_RADIATION01:
^BProtection Required ^R

Sam, 

I strongly recommend your staff to be equipped with gas masks or radiation blockers. This old facility has fallen into disrepair. When the radiation comes in from Al Mazrah, no one would be able to escape from it without proper protection. 

-G
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_RESEARCH01:
^BResearcher\xe2\x80\x99s Journal^R
Entry 1:

I was recommended to the Defense Research Division about a year ago, specializing in chemical toxicology. With a group of fellow scientists, I study the adverse effects of chemical substances on living organisms.

However, I don\xe2\x80\x99t quite understand what substance we\xe2\x80\x99ve been experimenting on lately. There is no other molecular structure in toxics that is anything like this. Not only is it highly toxic, but it also produces a high degree of radiation. If it enters the human body through the respiratory system, it may cause a respiratory arrest or even suffocation in a very short time.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_RESEARCH02:
^BResearcher\xe2\x80\x99s Journal^R
Entry 2:

I\xe2\x80\x99d be lying if I said working at a research institute hidden in an underground bunker doesn\xe2\x80\x99t feel strange at all. The regulations here are extremely strict. Doors are on lock most of the time. Soldiers can be seen everywhere, guarding the entire facility. Contact with the outside can only be made through the External Ops.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_RESEARCH03:
^BResearcher\xe2\x80\x99s Journal^R
Entry 3:

Overheard a conversation between two soldiers when I was delivering test samples requested at the last minute. It was about those outsiders.

Normally, we only work inside the labs. It\xe2\x80\x99s the outsiders\xe2\x80\x99 job to do the dirty work such as transporting chemicals, and the maintenance of the Chemical Plant. They turned out to be prisoners interrogated by agents from the Information Extraction. They are forced to work long hours, without any protection. No wonder they always look so heartless and indifferent.

Such treatment is undeniably cruel, if not inhuman.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_RESEARCH04:
^BResearcher\xe2\x80\x99s Journal^R
Entry 4:

Today we were told that all personnel must be evacuated by the end of this month. No explanation.

We were ordered to stop all ongoing experiments, shut down all instruments, and destroy all stored data.

\xe2\x80\x9cThis place doesn\xe2\x80\x99t exist,\xe2\x80\x9d they said, \xe2\x80\x9cYou\xe2\x80\x99ve never been here.\xe2\x80\x9d
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_RESEARCH05:
^BResearcher\xe2\x80\x99s Journal^R
Entry 5:

Rumor has it that a scientist named Sergei was locked up for quite a few days for his protest against the recent decision to close the labs and cancel all the programs.

I heard he\xe2\x80\x99s a very experienced researcher, and a very brave man. Hope he\xe2\x80\x99s okay, but honestly there\xe2\x80\x99s nothing I can do about it.
MP_BIOBUNKER/JOURNAL_SHOP01:
^BNote from a Soldier ^R

I heard of a guy called the Shopkeeper, who has access to resources from the outside. He\xe2\x80\x99s a bit strange though. You can get your hands on the premium goods only if you give him something he wants first. 

Some say he\xe2\x80\x99s not a real person. No one knows about his identity. No one has ever seen his face.

MP_DMZ_NOTES/DELTA_MAYOR_2:
^BPrinted Document^R

Social media analysis of citizen response to the peacekeepers concludes:
-Ninety percent of reactions are negative, with core themes being fear, oppression, confusion, and invasion. These are, of course, overreactions, but a notable percentage.
-Three percent actually feel safer, putting trust in our city leadership calling in such a specialized team to handle the situation, with themes of trust, precaution, and appreciation.
-Less than one percent are the usual conspiracy theories
-Less that one percent are online \xe2\x80\x9cmemes\xe2\x80\x9d often criticizing the fashion sense of the peacekeepers, or depicting them enjoying the city\xe2\x80\x99s many tourist attractions. The latter may actually help soften the public perception!

Overall messaging from citizens does indicate one trend quite clearly: The people are looking for answers.

We will not be able to simply hand-wave the justification for such measures much longer. If we must continue to withhold any and all information regarding the chemical threats, we must make a clear and decisive course of action to legitimize the situation in the public perception. This could be a lockdown, or evacuation, or any recommendations from our new advisors.

We need to move on from the secretive, passive appearance from leadership. People love when leaders GET THINGS DONE! This is supported by the polling data found on page 15.

^BHandwritten Note^R

Rajah,

My family is leaving here as soon as we can. I am not sure when we will return, if ever. I\xe2\x80\x99ve gathered my belongings and left some other items behind. If there\xe2\x80\x99s anything you want, please feel free to take it and make sure you lock the shop up tight when you go.

Travel safely. Hope to see you again some day.

-Fahad
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY03:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Hasina, 

They are telling us to leave now. My father said he\xe2\x80\x99s not going to wait, so I don\xe2\x80\x99t know what to do. I want to see you again. I want you to come with me. 


I wish you would answer your phone and I hope you are ok. We are all meeting at the shop I told you about. Please, if you see this come as soon as you can. Grab anything in the apartment. You might need it.

-Dabir
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY04:
^BQuickly Scrawled Written Note^R

Dabir,

I came as quickly as I could. My phone died and I can\xe2\x80\x99t get back into downtown Al Mazrah without being detained. I thought you might head here, but clearly you haven\xe2\x80\x99t been here in some time.

I\xe2\x80\x99m going to try to make it to the East. I\xe2\x80\x99m going to stay off the roads as much as I can. I hope to see you soon.

-Hasina
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY05:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Hasina, we waited as long as we could. I am so sorry. Our escort is here and they are already threatening to leave.

I have left supplies around the shop. They are all for you. Be safe and I hope you and Dabir can meet up again some day. No one expected this day would come so soon.

To anyone else who finds this, please take whatever you find in my shop if you need it to survive. We all must stick together\xe2\x80\xa6
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HANDWRITTEN_NOTE_DESC: Sheet of paper with a handwritten note.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HOARD01:
^BOfficial Note^R

Chief,

We\xe2\x80\x99ve locked up as many weapons as we could find in the main locker room. I have the key, but I know it\xe2\x80\x99s not the only one. Some of the officers have standard issue keys to the room. I\xe2\x80\x99ve locked each locker as well. 

Let\xe2\x80\x99s hope these weapons don\xe2\x80\x99t fall into the wrong hands.

- Officer K.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HOARD02:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Weapon inventory has revealed some weapons missing from this lockup. Additional weapons have been moved to Sawah Village. 

I left a key to the lockers here. Please take what you need but save some for others. Defend this location at all costs.

-Kamal
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HOARD03:
^BHandwritten Note^R

The last of our weapons remain here. We need to hold out as long as we can. Let us hope that the water levels do not rise and flood this room. 

Be well and good luck.

-Kamal
MP_DMZ_NOTES/JOURNAL_DESC: A journal with multiple hand written entries.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LAMINATED_PAPER_DESC: A printed document that has been laminated for protection.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOGBOOK_DESC: An official looking logbook with many hand written entries
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_BLACK_MOUS_INT:
^BBlack Mous Intel Documents^R

This folder holds classified documents containing computer records and transactions between Rohan Oil and Black Mous.

One document lists coordinates that are most likely meeting spots or possibly dead drops. This highly sensitive information looks very much like it was not meant for public consumption.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_CAVES_INTEL:
^BSmuggling Records^R

This binder holds meticulously kept records of incoming and outgoing shipments of chemicals, oil, opioids, narcotics, and weapons.

The records appear to indicate a recent dramatic increase in incoming weapon deliveries to the region.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_CRANE_INTEL:
^BQuarry Operations Folder^R

The folder contains documents detailing various operations, incoming and outgoing shipments, employees, customers, and government contracts.

The documents also contain time stamps of shipments received unusually late at night, indicating shipments being moved under cover of darkness.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_SHIPPING_MANIF:
^BRohan Oil Shipping Manifest^R

A binder full of pages and pages of Rohan Oil shipping notes. Most of the pages have numerous crossed out items. Some line items are written so poorly it's as if someone didn't want them to be legible.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_STRONGHOLD_INT:
^BStronghold Intel Documents^R

This folder is full of Al-Qatala documents containing names of guards, records of supply deliveries, and communication details.

The list of guards indicates transfers and desertions. Some name are crossed out, likely indicating guards that were KIA.

The supply deliveries show that the Strongholds are being used to temporarily store valuable munitions before they are distributed to troops across Al Mazrah.

The communication details seem to be written in some sort of coded shorthand.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_SYSTEM_ARCHITE:
^BAl-Qatala System Architecture Documentation^R

The documents contained in this folder detail the architecture for the utilities, security, and communications of Al-Qatala computer systems.

The pages look like they were printed by someone in a hurry as some have smeared printer ink and most are crumpled as if they were jammed into the folder in a panic.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FACTION_WHITE_LOTUS_IN:
^BWhite Lotus Intel Documents^R

The folder holds documents containing information on active and inactive members of the White Lotus faction. 

Some of the names are grouped up, possibly to show agents who work well together or perhaps who have similar specialties. A number of the groups have code names.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FOLDER:
^BImportant Looking Folder^R

The documents inside seem important enough to pick up. They might fetch a fair price from an interested buyer.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FOLDER_CLASSIFIED:
^BFolder Containing Classified Documents^R

The documents inside contain highly classified information that absolutely must not fall into the wrong hands. Their recovery will absolutely reward a handsome recovery fee.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/LOOT_FOLDER_SENSITIVE:
^BFolder Containing Sensitive Documents^R

The documents inside contain sensitive information that shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. Their recovery should reward a reasonable finders fee.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/MYSTERIOUS_LETTER_DESC: A mysterious letter containing some instructions.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/MYSTERIOUS_LETTER_NOTE:
^BInstructions^R

We have some important information we need relayed but our upload was interrupted.

Go to an upload station at the top of a radio tower and resume the upload for us.

- Laswell
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO01:
^BNote From Sailor to Captain^R

Captain, we found this in his bunk. The journal was damaged, but I transcribed what I could make out...

\xe2\x80\x9cThis boat. This sea. I may never come back.

Once upon a time, two of us ate SEVEN whole loaves of bread and called it good.

\xe2\x80\xa6why does that banging never stop?

I think the captain wants me, Samum, locked up. I should make sure he doesn\xe2\x80\x99t find these notes.

They know it was me who started the fire. I can hear them coming down the hall.

They think they have me trapped. I may need to jump overboard\xe2\x80\xa6and off to Taraq.\xe2\x80\x9d
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO02:
^BScrawling of a Mad Man^R

Friends\xe2\x80\xa6I think this explosion may rock the region. Now how do I get this on TV?

Downtown Al Mazrah has a station. Perhaps I should give it a visit?

-Samum
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO03:
^BPrinted Out Office Memo^R

To the staff\xe2\x80\xa6

We received a disturbing phone call that the infamous "Samum" is on his way over to our station. I expect you will want to either leave early or lock yourself in after reading this memo. 

We expect to continue to report the news as long as we can. Extra security has been assigned to the lobby.

Please stay safe.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO04:
^BHastily Written Note^R

The news station was a waste of time. Make sure the ingredients are correct and they will have no choice to cover this story. 

Wait for my signal.

-Samum
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO05:
^BHastily Written Note^R

If you are reading this, the deed is done. Tank #1 burns, but I don\xe2\x80\x99t think I\xe2\x80\x99m done yet. It\xe2\x80\x99s time to retreat into the tunnels where they won\xe2\x80\x99t find us. 

I forced a worker to reprogram the access code. The code is in my original notes\xe2\x80\xa6that I lost back on that ship. 

-Samum
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SABA_ARCHITECTS_NOTE_1:
^BPerfectly Handwritten Note^R

The work here is almost complete. We are working on the final stages. 

Seismic readings will help us pinpoint the location of the bunker\xe2\x80\xa6and they will all think we just wanted to destroy the train tracks. Fools.

If you find this note, you know where I went.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SABA_B21_NOTE_1:
^BPrinted Document^R

Top Secret: Building 21 contents in this container are to be opened only by authorized personnel with the proper protection.

Fragile: If contents are disturbed, containers could break. Chemicals are not to be mixed under any circumstances.

Warning: Direct contact with contained substances should be done with extreme caution.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SABA_CAPT_SILVER_NOTE:
^BPrinted Document^R

X97215 \xe2\x80\x93 B \xe2\x80\x93 TOP SECRET

Mission Protocol \xe2\x80\x93 Search and Destroy

Code Phrase \xe2\x80\x93 Alpha Delta Papa Charlie

From: The Board
To: Captain Silver
Message Text: You are to infiltrate the space as quickly as you can. Quiet approach is preferred, but completion of the job is of highest importance. If you run into trouble, hold down your area and reinforcements will be sent in.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SABA_LIEUTENANTS_NOTE:
^BA Printed Document^R

Operator X, 

Deep Dive is approaching its final preparations. This briefcase contains data that may be helpful once inside. You know what the key is for.

As discussed, you will need to move in ahead of the General. He is impatient and wants this to look like it was all his doing. Make me proud and you will be rewarded.

-Lt. Mahdi
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SABA_TRAPPER_NOTE_1:
^BHandwritten Note^R

I have used up many of the supplies on Ashika and will need more items as soon as you can. If things are going to proceed, I need the following:

<list of chemicals and electronic equipment>

Do not skip a single item. Place them in this secure box and lock it for the flight back. Use this cash for your purchases. Keep the rest.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SCRAWLED_NOTE_DESC: A sheet of paper with a quickly scrawled note.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_B21_NOTE_1:
^BPrinted Document^R

TOP SECRET

The water treatment system is to be shut off completely over the next few days.

Please do NOT under any circumstances tell any of the villagers. Act like business is as usual.

Please destroy this message after you have read it.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_B21_NOTE_2:
^BPrinted Document^R

TOP SECRET

Very soon we are going to bring our cargo ships in. Make sure that no unauthorized ships arrive at the island for any reason. 


If a local ship captain becomes insistent, tell him to contact me directly and I will handle it.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_B21_NOTE_3:
^BPrinted Document^R

TOP SECRET

The shipment from the DRC should be arriving today. 

When it does, send boats out to escort them in and get that cargo loaded carefully onto a truck headed up the hill. Tell your men to drop everything and make sure it arrives at the castle as soon as possible. 

I want you to personally escort it the whole way. This is your number one priority.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_COUPLE_FIGHT_1:
^BWaterlogged Note^R

Oh so you found where I tossed your share. I can\xe2\x80\x99t believe you would take me to this horrible, creepy island for our anniversary.

I am so done with your crap. I\xe2\x80\x99m taking what's mine and a little extra for my trouble. 

Don\xe2\x80\x99t try to follow me!!
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_ISLAND_WORKERS_1:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Itsu,

I don\xe2\x80\x99t trust these new soldier people. They don\xe2\x80\x99t listen to me when I tell them this place is haunted. I warn them about the island spirits, but they dishonor them every chance they get. It\xe2\x80\x99s time to fight back. 

Oh, and I left you some extra rice I had. My wife always makes too much.

Jiro
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_ISLAND_WORKERS_2:
^BHandwritten Note^R

If you are reading this from the fridge in the water, it is probably already too late. 

Let it be known that we planned to dumped this as a last ditch effort to avoid detection. 

The soldier people cannot know we are about to fight back. I feel silly even leaving this note, but I want the world to know one day what happened here.

- Jiro
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_ISLAND_WORKERS_3:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Jiro, 

I\xe2\x80\x99ve hid the weapons in here like you asked. If you are reading this, I am sure the fight has begun, my friend. We will retake the castle and the island if it\xe2\x80\x99s the last thing we do. Good luck!

If this is not Jiro, then the fight is probably already lost. Please take these weapons and use them. Fight back. Take back Ashika!

-Itsu
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_ISLAND_WORKERS_4:
^BScrawled Note^R

Things have gotten so much worse.

It\xe2\x80\x99s time to leave before they capture more of us. I don\xe2\x80\x99t even know where they took some of the villagers who were up the hill last night banging on the gates. 

If you find this, I\xe2\x80\x99m already heading to the boat leaving this morning. Just drop your tools and join me.

-Hanako
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_SCARED_VILLAGER_1:
^BJournal Entry^R

As I sit and ponder the recent events, I can\xe2\x80\x99t help but think the soldiers have awoken something in the island. 


The masks literally feel off the wall yesterday and fell into my bag. I think the island spirits are trying to tell me it\xe2\x80\x99s time to leave and they want me to help them.

A thick fog has rolled in over the last few days and strange ships have arrived to take some of us off the island. I think I am going take the masks with me.

-Ichika
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_SCARED_VILLAGER_2:
^BJournal Entry^R

Something has attacked the ships and we are now drifting back to the island and slowly sinking. The groaning noises from the ship\xe2\x80\x99s hull sound like a monster\xe2\x80\xa6or maybe it IS a monster. 

The island won\xe2\x80\x99t let us leave. I\xe2\x80\x99m pondering jumping in the water with the masks in my bag\xe2\x80\xa6yes, that IS what I am doing. The masks are compelling me to make a swim for it. 

Here we go\xe2\x80\xa6

-Ichika
MP_DMZ_NOTES/SEALION_SCARED_VILLAGER_3:
^BLaminated Paper^R

The Three Sacred Masks of Ashika

Found in an old wooden box uncovered on castle grounds after an earthquake in 1855. Their origins are unknown.

Mask 1: Askika Kitsune Original
Mask 2: Ashika Tengu Original
Mask 3: Ashika Mask of Riddles

MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF01:
^BResearcher's Memo^R

Item 23b was stolen from the archive sometime in the last few weeks. This was clearly an elaborate operation as various security system were disabled in order to pull off this heist. 

The only clue so far has been a brochure to a lighthouse that is NOT a part of anything here at Al Bagra.

Please be on the look out for anything else that might help lead to the location of 23b.

-Antiquities Inventory Team
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF02:
^BHandwritten Ransom Note^R

I have your precious antiquity. Pay me what it\xe2\x80\x99s worth or it leaves the country. Meet me on the bridge. The captain will mediate our negotiation.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF03:
^BCaptain\xe2\x80\x99s Log \xe2\x80\x93 Recent Entry^R

The treasure is being stored below deck, but one of the workers stole the only key to the box and ran off. He was dressed in some sort of postal uniform. 

Now the ship is under attack, and I can only hope we can get to open water before they damage the hull. What a mess this treasure has brought upon us.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF04:
^BHandwritten Note^R

I am being followed. The key here is for what you think it\xe2\x80\x99s for. I just hope the ship hasn\xe2\x80\x99t left yet. If I don\xe2\x80\x99t make it, good luck and be safe.

-J
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF05:
^BLaminated Sheet of Paper^R

Item 23b \xe2\x80\x93 Golden Skull of Al Bagra Minor

Thought to contain magical powers. This skull is made of gold and, while it looks like so many other Golden Skulls, there appears to be some glyphs along the outside that make it unique and especially valuable. The meaning of the glyphs is unknown and still being investigated.

objectives/blitz_hint: Take your team's flag into the enemy base.

objectives/btm_hint: Large war with mixed vehicle and infantry combat. Capture and hold the objectives to win.
objectives/conf: Recover dog tags to score for your team and deny enemy scores.

objectives/conflict: Eliminate your enemies and capture objectives. Be the first team to reach the score limit to win.
objectives/conflict_hint: Eliminate your enemies and capture objectives. Be the first team to reach the score limit to win.
objectives/control: Take turns attacking and defending the objective.
objectives/control_attacker_hint: Capture both zones to win the round.
objectives/control_defender_hint: Defend the zones until the time limit is reached to win the round.
objectives/ctf: Take the enemy flag back to your base.
objectives/cyber: Locate the bomb and disable the enemy data center.
objectives/cyber_hint: Locate the bomb and disable the enemy data center.
objectives/dm: Gain points by eliminating other players.
objectives/dm_dom_desc: Domination combined with Team Deathmatch. Gain points by capturing flags and eliminating enemy players.
objectives/dm_koth_desc: Hardpoint combined with Team Deathmatch. Gain points by capturing the hardpoint and eliminating enemy players.
objectives/dom_hint: Capture the zones and defend them.
objectives/esc_hint: Kill bad guys - take their stuff - GTFO!
objectives/fr: free roam Hint (TDM Example: Eliminate the other team or be holding the flag when time runs out.)
objectives/fr_hint: free roam Hint (TDM Example: Eliminate the other team or be holding the flag when time runs out.)
objectives/grind: Recover dog tags and take them to the objective marker to score for your team.
objectives/grnd: Hold the Drop Zone for Team Points and Care Packages.
objectives/gun: Gain points by eliminating other players. First player to 18 wins.
objectives/gwai: ground war ai Hint (TDM Example: Eliminate the other team or be holding the flag when time runs out.)
objectives/gwai_hint: ground war ai Hint (TDM Example: Eliminate the other team or be holding the flag when time runs out.)
objectives/gwbomb: Destroy the enemies bomb sites while defending your own.
objectives/gwbomb_hint: ground war bomb Hint (TDM Example: Eliminate the other team or be holding the flag when time runs out.)
objectives/gwtdm: Hold the frontline and eliminate the enemy team.
objectives/gwtdm_hint: Eliminate the enemy at all costs.
objectives/havoc_hint: Eliminate the enemy with incrementing gameplay modifiers
objectives/hq: Gain points by capturing and holding the Headquarters.
objectives/infect: Eliminated Survivors become Infected.  Infect everyone, or survive the game to win.
objectives/ko: Eliminate the other team or be holding the cash when time runs out.
objectives/ko_hint: Eliminate the other team or be holding the cash when time runs out.
objectives/koth: Gain points by holding the Hardpoint.
objectives/ks_conf_desc: Recover dog tags to score for your team and deny enemy scores. Collecting enemy dog tags awards killstreak progress.
objectives/oic: Gain ammo by eliminating enemies.  Last one standing wins.
objectives/pill: Collect currency from enemies and caches. Bank currency at depots. Pillage more than the enemy team to win.
objectives/rescue: Extract or defend the prisoners to win.
objectives/rescue_hint_attackers: Extract the prisoners, each prisoner is worth 100 points.
objectives/rescue_hint_defenders: Keep the prisoners from being taken, each prisoner kept is worth 50 points.
objectives/sd: Take turns destroying and defending A and B bomb sites.
objectives/siege: Capture points to revive fallen teammates. Taking all points will win the round.
objectives/siege_hint: Capture points to revive allies. Take all points to win.
objectives/snatch: Hunt for the Arsenal and Escape with the Black Box
objectives/tdef: Capture and hold the drone at all costs. Score increases with time held.
objectives/tdef_hint: Capture and hold the flag at all costs.
objectives/tjugg: Defend your Juggernaut to become Juggernaut.
objectives/war: Gain points by eliminating enemy players.
objectives/war_hint: Eliminate the enemy at all costs.

perks/ar_acharlie300: This powerful and enhanced rifle from Expedite Firearms is designed to take both 5.56 and ^3subsonic .300 BLK^7 ammunition, providing battlefield-advantage in any situation.
PERKS/AR_AKE: Full-auto energy rifle.  Deploys best-in-class stopping power at a low, dependable fire rate.

perks/ar_akilo105: The Kastov 545 uses intermediate caliber 5.45x39 rounds, allowing for less recoil while maintaining a higher rate of fire.
perks/ar_akilo47: This modern, hard-hitting rifle is the core of the Kastovia Platform. Chambered with large caliber 7.62x39 rounds, a skilled operator will find success with controlled shots.
perks/ar_akilo74: The Kastov-74u is a rifle optimized for short to medium distances. With a shortened receiver and barrels designed for short-range combat, the Kastov-74u gains significant maneuverability at the expense of effective range.

PERKS/AR_ARCLASSIC: Full-auto ballistic rifle.  Celebrated for rapid, powerful fire and an ^5integrated grenade launcher^7.
perks/ar_augolf: The STB 556 is a closed-bolt rifle built around modularity and accuracy, ideal for mid to long-range fights.
perks/ar_fecho: With a blinding fire rate and exceptional maneuverability, in the right hands, this aggressive bullpup rifle can dominate the battlefield.

perks/ar_golf3: A delayed blowback 7.62 receiver with equal parts power and control. Select fire allows precise semi-auto shots and short bursts of devastating full-auto firepower.

perks/ar_malima: A hard-hitting bullpup assault rifle chambered in 7.62x39mm. Highly modular, this weapon system can be adapted to fit a wide range of tactics and combat scenarios.
perks/ar_mcbravo: With an integrated suppressor and slow, high-energy ^3subsonic .300 BLK^7 rounds, the Chimera is adept at close-quarters combat. The ^3.300 BLK Subsonic Ammo^7 features no visible tracers and hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
perks/ar_mcharlie: The M13B features a short-stroke piston system that allows for a high rate of fire and low recoil.
perks/ar_mike16: Tuned for mid to long-range engagements, the M16 features a 3-round burst rifle that has increased range and stability.
perks/ar_mike4: The flagship rifle of the M4 Platform. This reliable workhorse is a jack-of-all-trades that performs well in most combat scenarios.
perks/ar_ralpha: The .300 BLK counterpart to the M13B, this full-auto Assault Rifle is versatile and hard-hitting as a main weapon or sniper support secondary.
perks/ar_scharlie: With a high fire rate and combat flexibility, the TAQ-56 is a full-auto rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm.
perks/ar_schotel: A moderate fire rate, heavy-hitting 7.62 rounds, and controllable recoil make the TAQ-V a solid contender for medium to long-range engagements.
PERKS/AR_SCSIERRA: Compact and maneuverable, the TAC-PRO brings hard-hitting 5.56 to close combat situations. Stopping power and versatility come standard with this Tactique Verte receiver.
PERKS/AR_SDFAR: 3-round burst energy rifle.  Each burst applies extreme stopping power at precise intervals.
perks/br_msecho: A high-powered ^2.458 Battle Rifle^7 that delivers severe damage at medium range.
perks/br_ngsierra: A bullpup, open-bolt rifle chambered in 6.8 Wrath and designed for distance shooting and exceptional damage output.
perks/br_soscar14: Adapt to any situation with this select-fire rifle. Stay in semi-auto for long-distance target shooting or switch to full auto when things get up close and personal.
perks/desc_c4: High explosives that stick to surfaces and can be detonated remotely with [{+frag}] or by double-tapping [{+reload}].
perks/desc_frag_grenade: Hold to control fuse time, remember to release. Produces lethal radius damage upon detonation.
perks/desc_pulse_grenade: Sticky grenade that emits 3 medium damage AoE pulse waves.
perks/desc_semtex: Timed explosive device that starts its countdown on release. Sticks to any surface.
