perks/desc_throwing_knife: Retrievable knife that causes instant death on impact.
perks/desc_trophy: Deployable autonomous defense system that destroys up to three incoming projectiles.
perks/dm_crossbow: Swift and silent, this compound crossbow offers an efficient way to dispatch your enemies. The standard, 20" bolts can be retrieved and cannot be detected by trophy systems.
perks/dm_la700: A bolt-action sniper rifle with a hammer-forged barrel and chambered in .300 magnum.
perks/dm_mike14: The semi-automatic EBR-14 is chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO and balances fire rate with long-range lethality.
perks/dm_mike24: The pillar of the Bryson bolt rifles, the SP-R 208 is a bolt-action rifle designed for precise shots at longer distances.
perks/dm_pgolf1: The LM-S is a highly accurized semi-automatic rifle available to military and police. Precision manufacturing provides unmatched accuracy for long-range engagements.
perks/dm_sa700: Optimized for speed and precision, the SA-B 50 bolt-action rifle features a pistol grip and lightweight frame for increased maneuverability.
perks/dm_sbeta: The Lockwood Mk2 is a high-power, lever-action rifle with old-west sentiments and modern-day aesthetics.
perks/dm_scromeo: The TAQ-M offers long-range support with a 6.5mm sniper round and modular design.
perks/dm_stango25: This hard-hitting DMR from Tempus Armament offers the versatility of the M4 Platform and the velocity and impact of 7.62 rounds. A patient hand and keen eye will result in on-target shots and quick kills.
perks/dm_xmike2010: The SP-X 80 is a .300 magnum sniper rifle designed for long-range target acquisition and elimination.
perks/dmr_m1_classic: Semi-auto ballistic rifle.  An old, reliable service rifle with moderate stopping power and low recoil.  The ^5top-loading clip^7 must be exhausted to reload.
perks/flash_grenade_desc: Produces a blinding flash and deafening noise levels sufficient to daze and disorient anyone within effective radius.
perks/healing_syringe_desc: Injects hemostasis compound that heals wounds quickly.
perks/helmet_desc: Reinforced helmet with extra protection against headshots.
perks/knife_only_desc: A CQC tactical knife.  Standard military issue, employed for fast, quiet, and deadly wetwork.
perks/la_gromeo: Portable infrared surface-to-air missile with a free-fire option. Self-propelled missiles have a higher speed and moderate explosive yield.
perks/la_juliet: Attack vehicles where armor is weakest with the JOKR. This fire-and-forget launcher is portable and drops a high-explosive payload from above.
perks/la_kgolf: From a recoilless rifle, launch a high-velocity, low-damage ultra-precise missile that is devastating against vehicles.
perks/la_mike32: An infantry-carried, revolving grenade launcher that fires 40mm projectiles that explode on impact.
perks/la_rpapa7: An infantry-carried launcher that fires a rocket-propelled grenade for high damage. Unguided missile requires manual aiming.
perks/lm_ahotel: Used for squad support or solo hunting, the HCR 56 lays out full-auto fire from a controllable receiver.
perks/lm_foxtrot: The 556 Icarus is a lightweight squad-support weapon in the M4 Platform. Increased ammo capacity does not significantly impact mobility.
perks/lm_kilo21: Featuring a belt-fed 7.62mm receiver with all the modularity of the Lachmann & Meer platform, the RAPP H offers versatility in the light machine gun class.
perks/lm_mkilo3: The Bruen Mk9 is a fully automatic, air-cooled light machine gun chambered in 5.56. Support your team and pin down the enemy with a high fire rate and overwhelming covering fire.
perks/lm_ngolf7: The belt-fed SAKIN MG38 light machine gun delivers devastating 7.62 rounds at a high fire rate thanks to a short-stroke gas piston.
perks/lm_rkilo: The RPK features a long, heavy barrel, high ammo capacity, and steel receiver capable of sustained full-auto fire without loss in accuracy.
perks/lm_slima: The Reconnaissance Auxiliary Assault Lightweight Machine Gun uses titanium construction, low fire rate and a reciprocating barrel to mitigate the powerful .338 recoil.
PERKS/LMG_LMG03: Full-auto energy weapon.  Delivers high damage with strong recoil.
PERKS/LMG_MAULER: Full-auto heavy ballistic weapon.  An experimental ^5gaussian delinker^7 channels ultra-rapid fire into a tight hip spread.
PERKS/LMG_SDFLMG: Full-auto energy weapon.  Offers a dependable fire rate and ^5high-capacity power cell^7 for sustained output.
perks/me_riotshield_desc: Ballistic-proof and explosive-resistant shield with increased melee damage.
perks/multivisor_desc: Gain multiple vision sets at once (^5Thermal^7, ^5SitRep^7, and ^5Phase-Vision^7).  Times out after ^510 seconds^7.
perks/pi_decho: A powerful semi-automatic pistol. Control the recoil and the ^2.50 cal^7 rounds will do the rest.
perks/pi_dechoauto: This fully automatic .50 GS boasts a thunderous rate of fire and enough power to put an end to anyone foolish enough to cross your path. Hold down the trigger and let this .50 Cal speak for itself.
perks/pi_golf17: A light, semi-auto 9mm pistol with specialized and tactical modification options. The polymer frame keeps the weight down and the integrated rail allows laser attachments.
perks/pi_golf18: The highly specialized, fully automatic trigger assembly of the X13 delivers a staggering 20 rounds per second while sacrificing a great deal of accuracy and effective range.
perks/pi_mike2011: This modern, tactical pistol chambered in 9mm is deadly from the hip and features best-in-class semi-automatic fire rate.
perks/pi_papa220: For close-quarters situations, the P890 semi-auto pistol takes advantage of accuracy, reliability, and a hard-hitting .45 Auto round. The ^3.45 Auto Subsonic Ammo^7 features no visible tracers and hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
perks/pi_stimpistol: Equip a revive pistol capable of reviving downed teammates or yourself. Hits to critical locations may be harmful to hostile targets.
perks/pi_swhiskey: A double-action revolver firing ^2.500 Cal^7 rounds, the Basilisk kicks hard but hits harder. Unstoppable in the right hands.
perks/pi_tango9: Designed to be compact and maneuverable, this machine pistol has a jaw-dropping fire rate and rapid swap speed. A trusted secondary for up-close engagements.
PERKS/PISTOL_EMC: Semi-auto energy pistol.  Reliably delivers consistent stopping power.
PERKS/PISTOL_G18: Semi-auto ballistic pistol.  Allows ultra-fast trigger cycling in a ^5lightweight mold^7 for increased hip fire control.
perks/pistol_g18_classic: Full-auto ballistic pistol.  Delivers the highest fire rate and recoil across all weapon classes.
PERKS/PISTOL_NRG: Full-auto energy pistol.  Features a ^5harmonic microcontroller^7 that accelerates fire rate over time.
perks/power_adrenaline_mist_desc: Device that emits adrenaline inducing mist, giving players higher pain tolerance while surrounded by it.
perks/power_ammo_box_desc: Deploy an ammo station for your allies.
perks/power_attack_drone_desc: Sends out an attack drone. Can manually be called back with [{+frag}]. Self destruct sequence can be initiated by double-tapping [{+reload}].
perks/power_barrier_desc: Fire this ability at teammates to provide them with light armor.  Land a precision shot on the head to give the ally additional protection from ^5headshots^7.
perks/power_biospike_desc: Thrown ballistic knife that explodes on enemy impact.  Can be recovered after use.
perks/power_blackoutgrenade_desc: Stuns enemies, causing vision and hearing loss.
perks/power_blinkknife_desc: Thrown high-tech knife that warps to enemy position on kill.  Can be recovered after use.
perks/power_bouncingbetty_desc: Deployable projectile that launches into the air before detonating.
perks/power_case_bomb_desc: Deploy a High Explosive Case bomb. Volitile bioplasma causes chain reactions
PERKS/POWER_CLUSTERGRENADE_DESC: Cookable grenade that explodes in a series of smaller blasts.
perks/power_comlink_desc: Battle positions updated in visor computer.
PERKS/POWER_CONCUSSION_GRENADE_DESC: Jams enemy minimap, movement, and aiming systems.  Effective against equipment.
perks/power_cone_flash_desc: Fires a blinding wave of force that increases your armor with each target hit.
perks/power_cryo_mine_desc: Magnetic mine that releases a supercoolant cloud, hindering movement systems.
perks/power_dash_desc: Use [{+breath_sprint}] to quickly move in the aimed direction. Forward dashes require the user to be in the air.
perks/power_disc_marker_desc: Throw down a marker for a Maverick VII missile strike.  (Best used outdoors)
perks/power_disruptor_desc: Thrown device that sights in on enemy optics and sends a focused shock at them.  Most effective if the enemy is currently in ADS.
perks/power_distortionfield_grenade_desc: This device deploys an aerial cloaking system that provides visual cover to those that are inside its sphere of influence.  Note that you are still vulnerable to all damage types, including ^5EMP^7 and ^5explosives^7, but you will be harder to pin down.
PERKS/POWER_EMP_GRENADE_DESC: Grenade that disables enemy suit abilities and damages equipment.
perks/power_eng_drone_desc: Deployable drone. Hold [{+smoke}] and press [{+activate}] to cycle between drone states: ^5Defense^7 or ^5Support^7.
perks/power_exploding_drone_desc: Launched aerial drone that explodes on impact or remotely with [{+frag}] or by double-tapping [{+reload}].
perks/power_fear_grenade_desc: Places a mine. Upon detonation, releases nanomachines that hack enemy Visors, causing them to see threats that are not real.
perks/power_forcepush_desc: Release a wave of concussive force that stuns and pushes enemies.
perks/power_hack_knife_desc: Nanomachines infiltrate enemy rigs, turning them to your side for a short time.
perks/power_mortarmount_desc: Fire a devastating mortar off your back. Use indoors at your own risk.
perks/power_opticwave_desc: Brief pulse that personally outlines enemies through walls.
perks/power_overcharge_desc: Increased damage for non explosive weapons.
perks/power_periphvis_desc: Activated sensor array that tracks enemy location by heat signature.
perks/power_phasesplit_desc: Suit bends light creating a hologram decoy of the player that runs out ahead.
perks/power_portal_generator_desc: Create a physical portal that allows anyone to enter phase shift for a short time.
perks/power_portal_grenade_desc: A grenade that applies an extreme reverse gravitational impulse against any enemy within the blast radius.
perks/power_proxybomb_desc: Bouncy grenade that detonates on contact with enemy targets.
PERKS/POWER_SENSORGRENADE_DESC: Bouncy grenade that outlines close enemies. Temporarily disorients and slows enemies on detonation.
perks/power_shard_ball_desc: Sticky grenade that launches itself in the air, scattering a series of explosive shards in all directions.
perks/power_siegemode_desc: Transorm into a stationary turret with strong frontal armor.
perks/power_siphonknife_desc: Siphon power from your enemies and use it to empower your defenses and health regeneration.
perks/power_smokegrenade_desc: Creates a smoke screen that blocks vision and automated targeting systems.
perks/power_sonicsensor_desc: Device that detects enemy sounds via sonic pulses, revealing enemy positions.  ^5Countered by^7 equipping sound nullifying perks (^5Dead Silence^7)
perks/power_speed_strip_desc: Passing through the ^5Velocity Ehancement Field^7 gives the player a temporary boost to speed and cooldown reduction.
perks/power_spider_grenade_desc: Autonomous sticky device that seeks out nearby enemies and explodes.
PERKS/POWER_SPLASH_GRENADE_DESC: Sticky grenade that sprays burning plasma in all directions.
perks/power_split_grenade_desc: Splits into multiple propelled grenades on impact.
perks/power_stealth_mode_desc: Gives all stealth perks for a set time and adds a silencer to your weapon.
perks/power_thermobaric_desc: Fuel-air grenade that creates a large but low damage blast radius and weakens armor.
perks/power_throwing_knife_smokewall_des: Thrown device that deploys a quickly forming ionic smoke wall.  Great for distraction.
perks/power_throwing_reaper_desc: Plasma spear damages and stuns struck enemies.
perks/power_transponder_desc: Thrown device that allows you to instantly teleport to the device's location when activated.
perks/power_trip_mine_desc: Magnetic mine that detonates when an enemy interrupts the beam.
perks/power_virus_grenade_desc: Infects enemy suits, temporarily blocks regenerative systems. The virus can spread to enemies near the virus host.
perks/power_wristrocket_desc: Rocket propelled system that delivers a timed, sticky plastique payload.
perks/sh_charlie725: This break-action shotgun sacrifices ammo capacity for extended range and a tight pellet spread.
perks/sh_mbravo: A reliable, highly customizable pump-action shotgun. Configurable for either close or medium range, the Bryson 800 is synonymous with versatility.
perks/sh_mike1014: A practiced hand can control the Expedite 12's recoil to devastating effect. This semi-auto shotgun features a regulated gas system, ergonomic stock, and standard rail.
perks/sh_mviktor: This mag-fed pump-action shotgun takes room clearing seriously. Detachable magazine speeds up reloads.
perks/sh_tsierra12: A fully automatic 12-gauge shotgun with a high-capacity, helical magazine that carries 15 shells.
perks/sh_vecho: Bringing the power of 12 gauge to the Kastovia Platform, the KV Broadside is the fastest-firing semi-auto firearm in the shotgun class. Destroys targets at close range with impunity.

PERKS/SHOTGUN_SDFSHOTTY: Full-auto energy shotgun.  Rapid fire capability is supported by a ^5high-capacity power cell^7.

perks/shotgun_spas_classic: Pump-action ballistic shotgun.  An esteemed and rugged firearm that trades a slow rechamber rate for incredible range and stopping power.
perks/sm_acharlie45: The ISO Platform's answer to room clearing. This SMG dominates with a high fire rate and the stopping power of .45 Auto rounds.
perks/sm_acharlie9: Sweep the battlefield clean with the high fire rate, maneuverability, and exceptional steadiness of this 9mm SMG.
perks/sm_alpha57: The FSS Hurricane sacrifices range and stopping power for increased ammo capacity and enhanced stability.
perks/sm_apapa: A submachine gun conversion of the rifle receiver, the MX9 submachine gun performs well at close to mid-range. The ^39x19mm Subsonic Ammo^7 features no visible tracers and hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
PERKS/SM_AUGOLF: A modular, fully automatic weapon configured for mobility and close range combat.
perks/sm_aviktor: An enhanced and modern version of the Kastovia Platform, the 9mm Vaznev-9K boasts an aggressively high rate of fire and leads the way in short to mid-range engagements.
perks/sm_beta: With a high rate of fire, straight blowback system, and a unique high-capacity magazine, the Minibak shreds in close-quarters combat. The ^39x18mm Subsonic Ammo^7 features no visible tracers and hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
perks/sm_mpapa5: The Lachmann Sub\xe2\x80\x99s compact, fully automatic 9mm receiver is a masterpiece of stability, mobility, and lethality. The modular system is configurable for a variety of covert and close-quarters operations.
perks/sm_mpapa7: Chambered in 4.6x30mm, the VEL 46 is a maneuverable submachine gun with moderate recoil.
perks/sm_mpapax: An aggressive fire rate and modular frame make the BAS-P perfect for the discerning operator who wants to customize their submachine gun.
perks/sm_papa90: Rapid-fire, a compact polymer frame, and high-velocity ammunition make the PDSW 528 a powerhouse for room clearing.
perks/sm_sdelta: This integrally suppressed, burst-fire submachine gun brings power and stealth to its class with ^3Subsonic Ammo^7 and suppressed-only barrels.
perks/sm_victor: With a blinding fire rate, the Fennec 45 excels at room clearing and holding down the front line. The ^3.45 Auto Subsonic Ammo^7 features no visible tracers and hides kill skulls from the enemy team.

PERKS/SMG_ERAD_SHOTGUN: Full-auto energy firearm.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to switch to ^5Shotgun Mode^7.

PERKS/SMG_RIPPER: Full-auto ballistic firearm.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to toggle ^5assault rifle mode^7.  An integrated ^5hybrid sight^7 enhances longer range engagements.
perks/smg_ump45_classic: Full-auto ballistic firearm.  Popular with old Earth agencies for delivering high stopping power at range despite a low fire rate.
perks/sn_alpha50: Hard-hitting, bolt-action sniper rifle with ^2.50 Cal^7 ammunition.  Its tungsten sabot-tipped bullets are fast and powerful, but require precise shots over long distances.
perks/sn_crossbow: Silent and agile, this high-performance crossbow fires 20.0" bolts with exceptional lethality.  Exclusive customization, distinct functionality, and unique ammunition types put this weapon in a class of its own.  Standard 20.0" bolts are recoverable, and are undetectable by trophy systems.
perks/sn_india: Engineered destruction at its finest, this anti-personnel, bolt-action sniper rifle intervenes in tense situations with hard-hitting .408 rounds.
perks/sn_limax: Featuring a reciprocating barrel that mitigates the recoil of the devastating ^2.50 Cal^7 cartridge, this anti-materiel rifle is built for consistent shots on target to take out anything you aim at.
perks/sn_mromeo: The Multi-Caliber Precision Rifle is a cutting-edge sniper rifle, chambered for the powerful .300 magnum round. This modular bolt-action sniper rifle is ready to adapt to the ever-evolving needs of the operator.
perks/sn_walpha: This semi-auto bullpup sniper rifle features an exceptionally high fire rate and a unique design for best-in-class handling and stability when on the move.
perks/sniper_cheytac_classic: Bolt-action ballistic rifle.  Renowned for superior stability, handling, and unforgiving recoil.
PERKS/SNIPER_KBS: Bolt-action ballistic rifle.  One shot, one kill from the waist up.  Rechambering breaks scope aim.
PERKS/SNIPER_M8: Semi-auto energy rifle.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to activate ^5assault rifle mode^7 for automatic fire and reduced power consumption.
PERKS/SP_ATOMIZER_DESC: Experimental energy based handgun that blasts victims into a cloud of mist. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_BEAM_STEELDRAGON: Powerful energy beam with auto tracking. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_LAUNCHER_CHARGESHOT_DESC: Charge up plasma launcher with extreme splash damage. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_LAUNCHER_LOCKON_DESC: Anti-air launcher. Supports straight dumb fire and locking-on to air targets. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_PENETRATOR_DESC: Highly accurate electromagnetic projectile launcher with increased penetration capability. (No ammo crate refills)
platform/kickedfromparty: You were kicked from the party.
PLATFORM/SEASON_PASS_TITLE_LONG: Call of Duty\xc2\xae: Modern Warfare\xc2\xae II - Season Pass
platform/tu_required: An update is required. You must be signed in to Battle.net and accept the update to play Call of Duty\xc2\xae.
PLAYLIST/BR_UNHINGED_DESC: Recruit enemies and expand your squad. Loot and Kill. Last squad standing wins.
PLAYLIST/CP_MS_LOW_PROFILE_MOD: One In The Chamber: Low Profile
PLAYLIST/MOBILE_BR_REBIRTH_RESURGENCE_DE: Resurgence played across Rebirth Island. Survive to redeploy fallen teammates and earn points to return them faster.Time: 10 minutes
PLAYLIST/MOBILE_BR_STARDARD_BR_DESC: All Operators and Weapons. Loot and kill. Last Operator standing wins.Time: 20 minutes
PLAYLIST/SURVIVAL_DESC: Assemble your team and defend yourselves against waves of increasingly difficult threats, earning the experience and equipment to outlast the enemy.
PLAYLIST/ZONECONTROL_DESCRIPTION: Occupy Zones to score points. Squad with the most points wins.
PMC/ACQUIRE_SPEND_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: We're working to keep AQ's sights on White Lotus, but need to maintain plausible deniability. That means any funds or equipment used in our next operations can't be traced back to us. You'll need to secure cash and use it to purchase weapons and gear.
pmc/american_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on eliminating other operators.
PMC/AMMO_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: We're planning a trap for Al-Qatala and we need a lot of firepower. Delayed resupplies are slowing down our plans. We're sending in teams to recover weapons and gear for the operation. Your job is to secure any ammunition you find and get it back to base.
PMC/AQ_NOTE_1_DESC: Black Mous seems to have taken an interest in our research. For some privacy I hide the drill elsewhere but ideally we need to dispose of it soon. I left a better description for its location in another hidden container. I got the new recruits to bury it off the coast near the Sawah Village. They probably got lazy and just threw it off the park's cliffs.
PMC/AQ_NOTE_2_DESC: To stay under the radar, the drill's not far from where we left the boat. I buried it in a container on the east side of the river close to that dock in Taraq. You'll find it under the electric pylon.
PMC/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has taken defensive positions at the Sa'id mall. They're using it as a point of overwatch onto the Al Mazrah river. As it happens a friend of ours is requesting that we test the durability and effectiveness of some weapon attachments. Make use of his specified attachments against AQ forces in Sa'id City and all enemy operators you find.
PMC/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a FTac Recon with a Thermo-Optic X9 attached in  Sa'id City.
PMC/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a FTac Recon with a 419mm EXF Barrel attached.
PMC/BIOBUNKER_ATTACHMENT_EXTRACT_ALL: Extract all above modifications for weapon reward.
PMC/BIOBUNKER_ATTACHMENT_EXTRACT_BARREL: Find and Extract the Heated Madness Barrel Skin.
PMC/BIOBUNKER_ATTACHMENT_EXTRACT_GRIP: Find and Extract the Heated Madness Underbarrel Skin.
PMC/BIOBUNKER_ATTACHMENT_EXTRACT_MAGAZIN: Find and Extract the Heated Madness Magazine Skin.
PMC/BIOBUNKER_ATTACHMENT_EXTRACT_MUZZLE: Find and Extract the Heated Madness Muzzle Skin.
PMC/BIOBUNKER_ATTACHMENT_EXTRACT_OPTIC: Find and Extract the Heated Madness Optic Skin.
PMC/BLACK_MOUS_INTEL_DESC: Classified documents containing computer records and transactions between Rohan Oil and Black Mous.
pmc/british_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on exploration and travel through the DMZ.
PMC/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_BUY_DESC: Buy a Precision Airstrike from a Shop.
PMC/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_DETAIL_DESC: We need a show of force against AQ. Secure payment for a precision air assets and direct strikes against any enemy targets.
PMC/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_KILL_DESC: Use Precision Airstrikes to kill ^.&&1^7 enemies.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: The final phase of this operation involves sabotaging fuel reserves near Zarqwa Hydroelectric. Accomplishing this mission will tighten the noose around AQ and give us a strategic advantage. Secure vehicles and plant charges at the nearby gas stations. Then climb the northwest radio tower and detonate the charges.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_EXPLODE_DESC: When all charges are set, climb to the second level of the radio tower in Zarqwa Hydroelectric and detonate the charges.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_PARK_DESC: Park a vehicle at all ^.4^7 gas stations in Zarqwa Hydroelectric.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant a charge at each gas station in Zarqwa Hydroelectric with a parked vehicle.
PMC/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is prepping cargo for transport. That cargo is valuable and we have contractees asking for it. Secure the cargo vehicle and move to a designated HLZ where Slasher-2 will meet you to extract the package. Those transport vehicles are worth something on their own as well, so don't let them go to waste. Repair and refuel the vehicle afterwards.
PMC/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_FUEL_REPAIR_DESC: Fully repair and refuel the transport vehicle.
PMC/CAVES_INTEL_DESC: Records of incoming and outgoing shipments of chemicals, oil, opioids, narcotics, and weapons.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you brought back revealed some details of how Al-Qatala is smuggling contraband through the AO. We need to figure out the routes their transports are taking out of Al Mazrah. There are some trucks in the cave complex marked by AQ. Put tracking devices on them. We left them for you in the junkyard dead drop near Al-Sharim Pass. Also there's a server room in a bunker at the caves. Move there and signals intel will hook into it.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Travel to the server rack in the bunker in Sattiq Caves and download the data.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices from the Al-Sharim Pass dumpster dead drop.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_PLANT_DESC: Plant ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices on the AQ trucks in Sattiq Caves in one deployment.
PMC/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DESC: Clear a Stronghold of enemy combatants.
PMC/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DETAIL_DESC: Another faction, the White Lotus, used to hold critical positons at nearby strongholds, that is until Al-Qatala took over Al Mazrah. Informants claim there's actionable intel in those Strongholds. Secure a key from AQ guards on-site and sweep the building for any intel on White Lotus for extraction.
PMC/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_INTEL_DESC: Extract the White Lotus intel found on Stronghold guards.
PMC/COMPLETE_HUNT_EXTRACT_WEAPON_DETAIL_: We keep a close eye on the equipment of our enemies as well as our competitors. Take a contract to hunt enemy operators. Secure their weapons and get them back here for inspection.
PMC/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_CONSOLE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Game Consoles to the same dead drop.
PMC/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: The level of reconnaissance we provide requires consistent maintenance. Secure parts we can use to upgrade our systems. Use the dead drop north of the cemetery for larger hardware. It's in a small village built next to the railroad. Extract the smaller parts yourself.
PMC/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_GPU_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 GPU to the dumpster dead drop near the railroad north of Al Sammam Cemetery.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_DESC: Documents detailing Al-Qatala's various operations, incoming and outgoing shipments, employees, customers, and government contracts.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: After your assault on the quarry, our recon team discovered AQ is using that area as a base of operations for planning and routing their smuggling shipments. A previous worker for the quarry company claims they're keeping their reports in the crane control room. Make entry and extract any intel you find.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the Quarry Operations Folder in the Crane Control Room.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_KEY_DESC: Acquire a key for the Crane Control Room in Al Safwa Quarry.
PMC/DELIVER_EQUIPMENT_MODERNCITY_DELIVER: Deliver ^.&&1^7 pieces of lethal equipment to the dumpster dead drop in the Sarwana Hotel alley, north of the Al Mazrah City Post Office.
PMC/DELIVER_EQUIPMENT_MODERNCITY_DETAIL_: We're running into a shortage of lethal equipment that we need for an upcoming operation. There's a dumpster we selected in Al Mazrah City. It's in the back alley of Sarwana Hotel. You should be able to find it north of the post office, across the river. We're paying some guys to discretely bring back equipment we drop in there. Find the dumpster dead drop and deliver some lethal equipment to it.
PMC/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_DETAIL_DES: The location of our R&D base was compromised. We're moving units out of there but there's too much heavy equipment and intel that we need destroyed. We setup a dead drop near the railroad west of Rohan Oil for the gas. The other items we need are more conspicuous and need to be extracted.
PMC/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_GASCANS_DE: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gas Cans to the dumpster dead drop at the train depot between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
PMC/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_ITEMS_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 Lighters, Comic Books, Bandages, or Documents.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_DESC: Our helicopter that was supposed to bring in supplies for the local population was hit by Al-Qatala SAM fire. The cargo landed in hostile territory and we can't afford risking operators to fetch it. We've struck a deal with locals in exchange for these supplies so we'd like you to deliver what you can find to the dead drops at the marshland's gas station and the one off the bridge in Al Mazrah City.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_FOOD_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Canned Foods to the dumpster dead drop in Al Mazrah City.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_TAPE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 bottles of Purified Water to the dumpster dead drop in Al Mazrah City.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_TOOTHPASTE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 tubes of Toothpastes to the dumpster dead drop at the Mawizeh Marsh gas station.
PMC/DEMOLITION_SAFE_DETAIL_DESC: One of our contractees has intel on high-value safes in the area. They're willing to give up that intel in exchange for a small job. They need you to destroy Al-Qatala's supply sites. Infil and find an AQ burner phone with intel on the supply site locations.
PMC/DOG_TAG_EXTRACT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Legion and White Lotus cannot get in our way for our next critical mission. We need to heavily weaken their forces and push them out of Al Mazrah at least temporarily. Eliminate as many operators as you can and secure their dog tags for psychological damage. While they are busy retreating, that's when we make our next move.
PMC/DOG_TAG_EXTRACT_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed assault rifle.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_BUY_DESC: Purchase an LTV with a turret at a Shop.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy the LTV in Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala still considers White Lotus a low-level threat at this time. We're going to convince them otherwise. Secure an up-armored LTV and use it to engage enemy forces in Ahkdar. After enough damage is done, break contact and drive to the marshlands to destroy the evidence. Our team will leak data tracing the attack back to White Lotus.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_KILL_DESC: Use the LTV turret to kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Ahkdar Village.
PMC/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_DETAIL_DESC: Intel confirms AQ is meeting with members of the Las Almas cartel. These are High Value Targets with information we can use for an upcoming operation. Recon shows AQ is storing up critical equipment within locked compounds for Las Almas. Your task is to eliminate an HVT, sweep them for keys to these compounds, and secure the objectives within them.
PMC/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_LOOT_DESC: Loot a key found on an HVT or elsewhere.
PMC/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_UNLOCK_DESC: Use a key to unlock a locked space.
PMC/ELIM_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete an Eliminate HVT contract in under ^.2^7 minutes.
PMC/ELIM_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has been allocating their best guards to defend the Las Almas smugglers. It seems they're in position to alert their command if they are engaged. You need to locate and neutralize the HVTs with speed and aggression.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_DELIVER_DESC: Deliver the laptop to the dumpster dead drop near the train tracks, north-east of the Al Sammam Cemetery.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We've been tracking a high profile political figure who has been spotted multiple times in the north-west of Al Mazrah, in a farm home near the poppy fields. You'll need a key to enter. Try to make your way into the compound and steal his laptop. Take it to the dumpster dead drop north-east of the cemetery. It's in a small village beside the train tracks. We left a USB device that will install a rootkit on the laptop. Once you're done, place the hacked laptop back where you found it.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Enter the Sattiq Poppy Farmer House and loot the target's laptop.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_PLANT: Plant the hacked laptop back in the Sattiq Poppy Farmer House where it was taken from.
PMC/EXECUTE_KILL_STUNNED_DETAIL_DESC: We're working to exploit AQ's security systems. Their strongholds can provide intel we can use to locate them. We are losing lots of operators to the riot shield guards. Take them out and clear the stronghold. SSE teams will search for the data we need afterwards. Advise taking stun grenades with you.
PMC/EXECUTE_KILL_STUNNED_EXECUTE_DESC: Execute ^.&&1^7 AQ soldiers wielding riot shields.
PMC/EXTRACT_MEDS_DETAIL_DESC: A few of our operators have sustained injuries from a recent AQ assault. Our medical supplies in the FOB are running low and we can't risk a transport vehicle getting hit on the road. We need you to go in and secure some light medical supplies.
PMC/EXTRACT_PHOTOS_DETAIL_DESC: There's some evidence of Al-Qatala's involvement in the Piccadilly attack found within the AO. Find the evidence and get it back to us. Any intel involving our organization should be extracted as well.
PMC/EXTRACT_PHOTOS_INTEL_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 pieces of Black Mous Intel.
PMC/EXTRACT_TACTICALS_DETAIL_DESC: R&D for a planned operation requires that we secure a full restock of tactical equipment and locals are asking for too much payment to smuggle high-tech equipment out of the AO. You're tasked with getting the job done. Gas grenades, flashes, and snapshots. Their future use is on a need to know basis.
PMC/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_DETAIL_DESC: We know of a few commanders leading Al-Qatala's forces. Take a contract to reveal intel on their locations and eliminate the targets. One of them has been seen with a case of valuable weaponry. Find it and get to extraction.
PMC/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_STREAK_DETAIL_D: We've been maintaining high surveillance on AQ's command structure. The Armored Commander is protecting valuable weapons cases. We need you to secure the targets and get them extracted. No casualties are allowed.
PMC/FACTION_INTEL_DESC: Documents containing information on active and inactive members of the White Lotus faction.
PMC/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: Intel is following a lead on AQ operations in the radiated zone. We'll be tasking squads into those areas for kill/capture missions, and they'll need protective gear for those operations. Locate durable gas masks in the area, as well as any additional funds you can find. Prove that the gear works by staying in the AO until the very last exfil arrives.
PMC/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil ^.&&1^7 times using the final exfil with ^.60k^7 cash.
PMC/FORT_LOOT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala has taken an interest in the southern coastal fortress. Our intel just shows it as a historic site. We need some operators to scout it out.
PMC/FORT_LOOT_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FORT_LOOT_KILL_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 caches in Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for some documentation regarding Al-Qatala's computer systems for a future operation. We tracked it to the sewers underneath the southern coastal fortress. There's a security system at play there. Once you enter the sewers you'll only have a few minutes to disable the security system. There's seven electrical breakers throughout the sewer that you need to reroute before the security system triggers and reinforcements are called in. After you deal with the security system, extract the system architecture.
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_DISARM_DESC: Reroute the ^.&&1^7 security devices in under ^.4:00^7 minutes to unlocked the System Architecture's container
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the System Architecture Documentation
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to the sewer under Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FUEL_REPAIR_DESC: Fuel and repair vehicles at ^.&&1^7 gas stations.
PMC/FUEL_REPAIR_LOOT_GAS_CANS_DETAIL_DES: A future operation requires that you have some experience with fueling and repairing vehicles at gas stations. Secure any gas cans you find and practice refueling your vehicle en-route. Bring some back for us as well.
PMC/FULL_BACKPACK_LOADOUT_DESC: Exfil with a full backpack and a full loadout ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC/FULL_BACKPACK_LOADOUT_DETAIL_DESC: Fuel is becoming more scarce in Al Mazrah, so every infil needs to be worth the risk. Secure a complete haul before exiting the area. That means a full large backpack and loadout including lethals, tacticals, a field upgrade, a killstreak, a self-revive kit, a gas mask, and a full set of armor plates.
PMC/GEIGER_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: Hopefully you've seen the news about the attack on the nuclear plant. Word is that AQ was responsible. Multiple local informants claim they're hiding the evidence in buried barrels in the AO. One of our contractees is offering a payout for securing that intel. They'll provide you with Geiger counters. Use them to locate the nuclear material.
PMC/GEIGER_LOOT_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 items from the radioactive caches.
pmc/german_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on completing activities and eliminating enemy AI.
PMC/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: A friend of ours had business in Al Mazrah before the AQ occupation. He has a special request for you to bring back a very personal item he left behind. He was staying in room 302 of a hotel in Sawah Village.
PMC/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the golden .50 GS from Room 302 in the Sawah Hotel.
PMC/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_UNLOCK_DESC: Unlock Room 302 in the top floor of the Sawah Hotel.
PMC/GOLD_DELIVERY_BARS_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gold Bars to the dumpster dead drop south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC/GOLD_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: Our friend is asking for lucrative valuables in exchange for his services and his cash. Locate gold items and get them to the junkyard dead drop north of the Al Malik airport. These will keep us funded for months to come.
PMC/GOLD_DELIVERY_SKULL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gold Skulls to the dumpster dead drop south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC/GPS_TRACKER_DESC: A disposable satphone for GPS tracking.
PMC/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: You might remember the dumpster dead drop we setup near the mall. We placed a GPS tracker in the dead drop. We need you to use the GPS to help us update our topographical maps of the area. We'll need frequent sample points across the AO to accurately krige together into workable data. Take the tracker from the dead drop, visit all of the major points of interest, and return with it.
PMC/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Loot the GPS Tracker from the dumpster dead drop near the Sa'id City Mall.
PMC/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to every POI while carrying the GPS Tracker in one deployment.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: Our higher ups have reduced our total budget for explosive equipment after an accident with one of the burn pits in our base. Well we still require a supply of light explosives. Bring mines and claymores to the dead drop on the railroad between the quarry and the oil processing plants. Our courier has a large asking price for the thermite grenades so we'd rather you deliver them all at once to the dumpster dead drop at the Sarwana Hotel, north of the Al Mazrah City Post Office. I trust you'll be able to carry fragmentation grenades on your person without us needing to hire more delivery drivers.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_FRAG_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 Frag Grenades in one deployment.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_MINES_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Proximity Mines or Claymores to the dumpster dead drop in between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_THERMITE_DES: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Thermite Grenades to the dumpster dead drop in Al Mazrah City in one deployment.
PMC/HACK_KILL_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for better data on the geography of Al Mazrah for future operations. Activate some UAV Towers so we can conduct topographical surveys with the UAV. Try to keep a low profile and take out any nearby hostiles that might interfere.
PMC/HACK_KILL_UAV_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies pinged by UAV Towers.
PMC/HACKED_LAPTOP_DESC: A laptop with kernel-level key logging software installed.
PMC/HACKED_USB_DESC: A thumb drive installed with malware and data logging software.
PMC/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_DETAIL_DESC: The Sattiq Cave operation revealed three major sites of operations for AQ. We are looking for more intel on their operations and who's helping them. Your targets are the warehouse in the quarry, the post office, and the US embassy. Secure all three objectives and we'll send in SSE teams after to sweep for intel.
PMC/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_EMBASSY_DESC: Unlock and clear the US Embassy Main Building in the same deployment.
PMC/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_POSTOFFICE_DE: Unlock and clear the Downtown Post Office in the same deployment.
PMC/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_WAREHOUSE_DES: Unlock and clear the Kushaak Construction Warehouse.
PMC/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala has been taking potential informants in as hostages. Our associates would like you to protect them and will pay a hefty price if you can extract them safely. Find and secure the hostage, bring them to an HLZ and extract with the hostage to ensure their survival.
PMC/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with the hostage evac helo.
PMC/HOSTAGE_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete ^.3^7 Rescue Hostage contracts, each in under ^.2:00^7 minutes.
PMC/HOSTAGE_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has captured our high-level sources. The information they provide is crucial for an upcoming operation. Any delay and AQ will be able to take action against their information. Move fast to secure our hostages.
PMC/HUMANITARIAN_EXTRACT_BANDAGE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Bandages to the dumpster dead drop in Sa'id City.
PMC/HUMANITARIAN_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: Some portion of the Al Mazrah water supply was contaminated and we have reason to think Legion was involved. We've moved some ill and injured civilians into an old hospital a few klicks up north along the river, but it's missing some supplies that would help aid them. Retrieve them for us. We have a driver ready to pick up light items from the dead drop at the mall.
PMC/HUNT_STREAK_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 Hunt PMC Unit contracts without dying.
PMC/HUNT_STREAK_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking to investigate the equipment of our opposition in greater detail. We'll need you to take out a multitude of enemy operators. Do this without taking heavy casualties. We need our reputation maintained.
PMC/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: You're one of few who we think is up for these kinds of confidential tasks. You're probably familiar with the hydroelectric facilities on the river. There are some wells that lead into the internal treatment process and exit directly back into the river. Throw some Gas Grenades down into those wells. Distribute the gas evenly among the wells to help the chemical compounds better dissolve.
PMC/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Acquire ^.&&1^7 Gas Grenades in one deployment.
PMC/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_THROW_DESC: Throw ^.&&1^7 Gas Grenades into the open water wells in Zarqwa Hydroelectric in one deployment.
PMC/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_NO_WEAPONS_DETAIL: Operators who work with us must be experts in escape and evasion. Infil into the AO empty handed and make it to extraction without picking up a weapon.
PMC/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_NO_WEAPONS_EXFIL_: Exfil in the same deployment without picking up any weapons.
PMC/INTEL_BOSS_DETAIL_DESC: We received information on Al-Qatala commanders operating in the area. Targeting these individuals will help disrupt AQ's command structure. We need you to secure intel on a commander to locate their current position. Then move to neutralize the target.
PMC/INTEL_BOSS_END_DESC: Complete an Secure Intel contract to reveal the location of an enemy Commander.
PMC/INTEL_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete ^.5^7 contracts each in less than ^.1:00^7 minute.
PMC/INTEL_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: White Lotus is gaining support from the local population. We need to get ahead of them, or we could lose access to informants and critical intel. We need their primary contractees on our side. Secure contract work in the area and get the job done fast. Show the people of Al Mazrah who they should align with.
PMC/IRRADIATED_DRILL_DESC: A drill emitting trace amounts of radiation. Evidence leads to this drill being used to enter the attacked nuclear plant.
PMC/IRRADIATED_WATCH_DESC: An Al-Qatala member's watch emitting trace amounts of radiation.
PMC/KILL_ARMORED_ARMOR_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 armored enemies in Sawah Village.
PMC/KILL_ARMORED_DETAIL_DESC: Our operators have been getting hit hard by Al-Qatala forces and they're reporting that someone is giving AQ access to better gear. We're looking to target various highly armed forces. We'll be waiting for AQ to receive a restock of their equipment which we'll be tracking to see who's supplying them.
PMC/KILL_ARMORED_RIOT_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies wielding riot shields in Al Mazrah City.
PMC/LARGE_CASH_VALUABLES_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract with a single backpack carrying ^.$200,000^7 in cash and valuables.
PMC/LARGE_CASH_VALUABLES_EXTRACT_DETAIL_: We need funds to secure additional surveillance and reconnaissance systems for future operations. We need it fast and without the costs of too many exfiltrations. Secure a haul worth at least 200k for us in one go.
PMC/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: The Zaya Observatory holds the high ground over Al Mazrah, making it a strategic target in the area. Recently, AQ has engaged Legion and Black Mous operators at this location, which gives us the initiative. You're cleared hot on all AQ forces and enemy operators. Equip an LMG, set up at the observatory, and thin the herd. Fire at range and with precision to best conceal your position.
PMC/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a 556 Icarus with a VLK Koloss Flash Hider, a FTac SB, a Vortex-90, and a Corio Precio Factory attached in Zaya Observatory at 150+ meters.
PMC/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_HEADSHOTS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with headshots with a 556 Icarus with a Vortex-90, a FTac SB, and a Bipod v9 Grip attached.
PMC/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a 556 Icarus with a Bipod v9 Grip, a VLK Koloss Flash Hider, and a Corio Precio Factory attached at 100+ meters.
PMC/LMG_KILLS_ARMOR_ARMORED_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 armored enemies with an HCR 56.
PMC/LMG_KILLS_ARMOR_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Sharim Pass is a major position for Al-Qatala to have overwatch onto the railway, the river, and the airport. An informant was taken hostage by AQ. We are undergoing a night operation for our team to infil through the river, secure the target, and bring them to the airport where our bird will get them out. Your job is to weaken the forces at Al-Sharim Pass before that operation can commence.
PMC/LMG_KILLS_ARMOR_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with an HCR 56 at Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC/LOCKED_STRONGHOLD_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala is getting too comfortable within their strongholds for our liking. We'd like to put some pressure on them and force a mistake from their command. Show them their locks and blockades won't keep them safe. They'll be forced to begin moving critical targets out of their strongholds and that's when we strike.
PMC/LOCKED_STRONGHOLD_KILLS_PING_DESC: Snapshot ^.&&1^7 enemies in locked Strongholds using a Snapshot Grenade.
PMC/LOOT_CACHE_EXFIL_ITEM_DETAIL_DESC: Our recon teams reported AQ storing supplies in multiple caches in the area. We need access to these caches to learn what intel and equipment they're supplying fighters with. Your objective is to locate the caches and secure their contents.
PMC/LOOT_EXTRACT_DOG_TAGS_DETAIL_DESC: Another group is moving against us. We believe Black Mous may be involved. Go to Rohan Oil and search for intel on them. Secure dog tags of any operators that get in your way and we'll find any intel we can on who is working for them.
PMC/LOOT_EXTRACT_DOG_TAGS_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract ^.&&1^7 enemy Dog Tags.
PMC/LOOT_EXTRACT_DOG_TAGS_INTEL_DESC: Loot and extract ^.&&1^7 pieces of Black Mous Intel from Rohan Oil.
PMC/LOOT_PC_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you acquired on White Lotus revealed key operators in their employment. We're setting up computer systems to store and organize the data we continue to track on the White Lotus and its operations. Locate and secure good data storage from PCs.
PMC/LOOT_SELL_LIQUOR_DETAIL_DESC: A friend of Black Mous has an appreciation for the finer things in life. Specifically he's asking for Al Mazrah wine. Usually he's picky but times are tough and he'll pay well for any bottles you might find.
PMC/LOOT_SELL_LIQUOR_SELL_DESC: Sell ^.&&1^7 Liquor or Wine Bottles at a Shop.
PMC/LOOT_SUPPLY_DROPS_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 airplane supply drops in one deployment.
PMC/LOOT_SUPPLY_DROPS_DETAIL_DESC: Cargo shipments flying over the AO are carrying good gear for Al-Qatala. Secure it quickly before any hostile operators can. We'll learn what resupplies are being requested and exactly what weaknesses we can exploit for future operations.
PMC/MALL_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is using the Sa'id mall as a en-route resupply location when smuggling narcotics to and from the port. Weaken their hold on it so we can land rotor-wing aircraft onto the parking garage for an upcoming operation. Secure the mall and keep it clear of any hostile forces.
PMC/MALL_KILLS_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill 20 enemies in the Sa'id City mall without being downed.
PMC/MALL_KILLS_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill 3 operators in the Sa'id City mall.
PMC/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_BATTERY_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Car Batteries to the dumpster dead drop north of Al Malik International.
PMC/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_CABLE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Jumper Cables to the dumpster dead drop at the Mawizeh Marsh gas station.
PMC/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_DETAIL_DESC: One of our convoy trucks hit an IED. It's gone but the other vehicles in proximity are still repairable. We're running short on a few components. Deliver them to the gas station off the bridge in the marshlands. The batteries will be harder to smuggle out of the AO. Take those to the dumpster at the junkyard in that village north of the airport.
PMC/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_TORCH_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Blow Torches to the dumpster dead drop at the Mawizeh Marsh gas station.
PMC/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for intel regarding a recent AQ attack on one of our FOBs. We need you to take one of their helicopters to the secure helipad near the port. Once you touch down, download and extract the flight path data.
PMC/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Download the Light Helo's flight path data.
PMC/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the Light Helo's flight path data.
PMC/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_LAND_DESC: Land a Light Helo at the Hafid Port helipad.
PMC/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: We've been sustaining heavy casualties from RPGs as Al-Qatala insurgents have begun to mobilize northwest of Al Mazrah into the mountains. We need material for critical medical care. There's a dumpster dead drop we setup outside the Sa'id City Mall between the main mall building and the parking garage. Deposit low value material there and bring more sensitive medical equipment back on your person.
PMC/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_LIQUOR_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Emergency Rations to a dumpster dead drop near the Sa'id City mall.
PMC/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_STIMS_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Stims to the dumpster dead drop near the Sa'id City mall.
PMC/MODERN_CITY_SNIPE_DETAIL_DESC: We have a non-combatant that we need to transport into Al Mazrah City and back out. Currently AQ forces have mobilized within the city. We need a sniper team to clear the city without letting the opposition know our plans.
PMC/MODERN_CITY_SNIPE_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Al Mazrah City by headshot with a sniper rifle.
PMC/MODERN_CITY_SNIPE_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators in Al Mazrah City with a sniper rifle.
PMC/MOVING_VEHICLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: We're planning a chemical transportation for our future mission using the railway to the docks in Sarrif Bay. The cargo is critically sensitive and we can't have enemy eyes on it. Some Al-Qatala bases of operations along the route pose a threat. Eliminate a few of them with a drive-by. Hopefully that'll keep them indoors for a while.
PMC/MOVING_VEHICLE_KILL_LEAN_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while leaning out of a moving vehicle at Sarrif Bay.
PMC/MOVING_VEHICLE_KILL_ROOF_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the roof of a moving vehicle at Al Sharim Pass.
PMC/MULTI_STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is holding defensive positions in multiple strongholds in the area. We need to cripple their infrastructure. Locate and secure these strongholds. We need you to hit up a few of them in succession to really put a dent in their supply chain.
PMC/MULTIPLE_CONTRACT_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DE: Our work with the civilians has cost us. We're getting stretched for funds and we need to recuperate in as short a time as possible. You're tasked with completing contract work without wasting too much time or resources.
PMC/NO_RUSHING_STORY_DESTROY_DESC: Shoot down ^.&&1^7 reinforcement choppers at Al Malik Terminal with a SAKIN MG38 with a 150-Round Box Magazine and a Soshki bipod.
PMC/NO_RUSHING_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're going after AQ's narcotics network, directly. The target is Al Malik Airport, that's a hot spot where aircraft have been traced to smuggling operations. Secure a high-capacity, high-caliber weapon for this job. Your primary objective is to eliminate personnel and enemy helos on site.
PMC/NO_RUSHING_STORY_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at Al Malik Terminal with a SAKIN MG38 with a 150-Round Box Magazine and a Soshki bipod.
PMC/OBSERVATORY_DMR_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed designated marksman rifle with headshots in Zaya Observatory at a range of less than 3 meters.
PMC/OBSERVATORY_DMR_DETAIL_DESC: There's high enemy activity near the Zaya Observatory. AQ is using the equipment to interfere with our radio signals. Take a suppressed weapon and quickly clear the observatory. Stay up close to maximize each shot's damage.
PMC/OILFIELD_CAMERA_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We've noticed heavy AQ activity around Rohan Oil. Numerous transports have gone through the road leading under the railroad. Set up tactical cameras in the area so we can get Positive ID on who's working with them.
PMC/OILFIELD_CAMERA_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Setup a Tactical Camera pointing at the underpass in Rohan Oil.
PMC/OILFIELD_CAMERA_STORY_SNAPSHOT_DESC: Snapshot ^.&&1^7 enemies in Rohan Oil with a Tactical Camera.
PMC/ONE_MATCH_EXTRACT_KILLSTREAKS_DESC: Exfil with ^.&&1^7 Killstreaks in one deployment.
PMC/ONE_MATCH_EXTRACT_KILLSTREAKS_DETAIL: That intel you brought back revealed a critical target in AQ's operations. We will need air support for a new operation to hit AQ where it hurts. Secure killstreaks and get to extraction.
PMC/ONE_MATCH_SAFES_EXTRACT_CASH_DETAIL_: A source claims AQ is stashing funds in safes around Al Mazrah. They've been making large transactions with Las Almas. You need to put a dent in their operation. Locate their safes in the area and extract with the funds.
PMC/ONE_MATCH_SAFES_EXTRACT_CASH_EXTRACT: Extract ^.100k^7 on a single teammate in one deployment.
PMC/PICKUP_RADIO_KILL_ENEMIES_DETAIL_DES: Working with us means you should know how to exploit enemy radio communications. Use radios dropped from Al-Qatala fighters to eliminate additional targets in the area.
PMC/PICKUP_RADIO_KILL_ENEMIES_PICKUP_DES: Pickup ^.&&1^7 radios dropped by neutralized AQ members.
PMC/PING_PHONE_DESC: Use your Tac-Map and ping a contract phone.
PMC/PING_PHONE_START_CONTRACT_DETAIL_DES: Al-Qatala is using burner phones to coordinate attacks against us. Intel was able to track ones that are still active, but we need to secure them fast. Locate a phone and download its contents. Once decrypted, we can use the data to take on contracts for a payout.
PMC/PIRACY_STORY_BOARD_DESC: Board the cargo ship at Hafid Port.
PMC/PIRACY_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
Remember that flight data you got for us? Well it seems like that wasn't the only time that helicopter landed at the port. Seems like AQ has some special cargo that's been coming in and out of Al Mazrah. Board the cargo ship at Hafid Port and extract the Shipping Manifest.

Board the cargo ship at Hafid Port.
Find and loot the Shipping Manifest.
Extract the Shipping Manifest.
PMC/PIRACY_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Find and loot the Shipping Manifest.
PMC/PLANNING_DIAGRAM_DESC: A diagram used by Al-Qatala for a recent attack in London.
PMC/PLANNING_IMAGE_DESC: An image used by Al-Qatala for a recent attack in London.
PMC/PLANT_USB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: There are three computers we need access to in Al Mazrah. First is at the air traffic control tower at Al-Malik International. Second is the computer in the corner on the first floor of the northern telescope in Zaya Observatory. Third is at the corner desk in the offices of the TV station in Al Mazrah City. We placed thumb drives with special software at the dead drop in the city near the Sarwana Hotel. Secure the thumb drives and plug them into those computers. We'll handle it from there.
PMC/PLANT_USB_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Loot the ^.&&1^7 Hacked Thumb Drives from the dumpster dead drop in the Sarwana Hotel alleyway, south-east Al Mazrah City.
PMC/PLANT_USB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: In one deployment, plant Hacked Thumb Drives in computers at: the air traffic control tower, the north Observatory telescope, and the Al Mazrah City TV Station.
PMC/RADIATION_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: Intel confirms AQ is operating in the radiated zones to mask their movements. We need a stockpile of protective gear for our operators to perform covert missions into irradiated areas undetected and unharmed. Gas masks should be dead dropped. Radiation blockers should be extracted.
PMC/RADIATION_EXTRACT_GASMASK_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gas Masks to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC/RECON_TAG_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Intel shows that Las Almas is connected to that cargo ship docked at the port. We need you to recon the area with a remote drone, get positive ID on any enemy personnel, and eliminate them.
PMC/RECON_TAG_KILL_TAG_DESC: Tag ^.&&1^7 enemies with a Recon Drone at Hafid Port.
PMC/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DESC: Hold [{+ping_wheel,+ping,+actionslot 1}] to request to join with ^.&&1^7 nearby enemy operators.
PMC/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DETAIL_DESC: We need soldiers that aren't hot heads. Defusing hostile engagements, and cooperating with other teams will prove beneficial for both you and our faction. We want you to try joining together with other teams. A bigger team means more firepower for us.
PMC/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: The revolver is a weapon of a true marksman. Al Mazrah policemen were known to use them as sidearms before AQ took over. Prove to us you know your fundamentals with precision fire on any enemy combatants.
PMC/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with headshots using a Basilisk.
PMC/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_LOOT_DESC: Acquire a Basilisk, commonly found in police stations.
PMC/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is setting up convoys and patrols along major roadways. We need to impart some psychological warfare to clear the roads for our cargo routes. Use a vehicle to neutralize hostile forces and make it look like it took no damage.
PMC/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_REPAIR_DESC: Fully refuel and repair a vehicle at a gas station.
PMC/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_RUN_DESC: Run over ^.&&1^7 enemies with a vehicle.
PMC/SAM_SHOOT_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is using surface-to-air missiles to protect their resupply shipments. Denying AQ these shipments will aid us in our upcoming operation. Your objective is reroute a SAM site to signals intel. We'll target incoming enemy aircraft while you move to secure equipment from the wreckage.
PMC/SAM_SHOOT_LOOT_SHOOT_DESC: Wait for your captured SAM Site to shoot down an airplane.
PMC/SEPT_VEHICLE_KILL_DESC: Destroy ^.7^7 vehicles in close succession ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC/SEPT_VEHICLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: A future operation requires that we limit AQ's transportation options. You're tasked with destroying any vehicles in the AO immediately. Hit multiple vehicles in quick succession to minimize any noise that AQ might investigate.
PMC/SHIPPING_MANIFEST_DESC: A shipping manifest for a shipment contracted by Rohan Oil.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: A local source informed us that AQ found one of our vehicles destroyed in the marshland, claiming we're responsible for a massacre in Ahkdar. We now have two objectives. Clean up the marshlands and neutralize any operators that could be working against us. This isn't a time for discretion. Get close and let them know who sent you.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a Bryson 800 with a Sawed Off Mod in Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_MELEE_DESC: Melee kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a Bryson 800 with a Vulture Claw Breacher attached.
PMC/SHOTGUN_KILLS_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a Bryson 800 with 8" XRK CQB Barrel.
PMC/SOLO_INFIL_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Show us you can handle yourself. Infil to the AO and get to extraction - all on your own.
PMC/START_CONTRACT_DESC: Find a contract phone and download the intel.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_CLEAR_DESC: Clear ^.3^7 Strongholds each in under ^.15^7 seconds after unlocking the Stronghold.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DES: Aggressive attack will catch Al-Qatala off guard. Locate strongholds and sweep them fast. Show AQ the speed of violence.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_UNLOCK_DES: Unlock a Stronghold door with a keycard.
PMC/STRONGHOLD_INTEL_DESC: Al-Qatala documents containing names of guards, records of supply deliveries, and communication details.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_ELIM_DETAIL_DESC: Some cartel members are working in Al Mazrah. Eliminate the targets. We pride ourselves on anonymity. Be unseen and unheard.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_ELIM_ELIM_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 Eliminate HVT contract targets using suppressed weapons.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_MELEE_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: We need to engage AQ forces without alerting them to what they're fighting against. Maintain silence and the element of surprise. They more unknown loses they take, the more they'll be pressured to mobilize their units away from our targets.
PMC/SUPPRESSED_MELEE_KILLS_SMG_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed Fennec 45 with a Fennec Double Tap Mod attached.
PMC/SYNC_SAMSITE_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala SAM sites in the area are limiting our aerial options. Secure enough at the same time for our resupply aircraft to land at our FOB.
PMC/SYNC_UAV_CONTROL_DESC: Have ^.5^7 UAV towers active at the same time.
PMC/SYNC_UAV_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking to do some covert investigations on the Al Mazrah river. Al-Qatala is using UAV towers for overwatch in the AO. We need AQ blind as we move in to take samples of the water. Secure multiple UAV towers simultaneously. We'll be waiting on your signal.
PMC/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_DESC: Documentation detailing the architecture for the utilities, security, and communications for Al-Qatala computer systems.
PMC/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_DETAIL_DE: Information is power in a combat zone. We need air support and drones to monitor Al Mazrah after a major operation of ours. Find and deliver some encrypted hard drives to us. With the intel you brought back from the fortress sewers, we can decrypt the data to find AQ's weaknesses.
PMC/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_DRONE_DES: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Recon Drones to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_UAV_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 UAVs, advanced UAVs or counter UAVs.
PMC/THERMAL_RANGED_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed MCPR-300 with a Raptor-FVM40 and a SZ 1mW PEQ laser attached at a range of over ^.200m^7.
PMC/THERMAL_RANGED_SNIPER_DETAIL_DESC: We need to thin out our competition with them knowing it's us at play. Equip yourself with a suppressed sniper rifle and engage operators at 200+ meters. The other factions will blame each other for their losses while we push forward with our plans.
PMC/TRACKING_DEVICE_DESC: A device for discretely recording and transmitting GPS positions.
PMC/TRAIN_KILLS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the train.
PMC/TRAIN_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Learn to see the advantages of any situation. Use the train to eliminate enemies in the AO. Its sound can conceal your shots, and it acts as an escape vehicle to get you out of the area fast.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DAMAGE_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapons Stash contract without taking body damage.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DAMAGE_DETAIL_DESC: We want AQ to know that we are untouchable. Secure a weapons stash unscathed and prove you have what it takes for high stakes operations. They'll be pressured into moving more guards to defend their equipment.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DOWN_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala is hiding their most expensive equipment in weapon stashes they keep protected in their strongholds. A contractee has data on their positions. Take the contract and secure the equipment without taking casualties.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DOWN_END_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapon Stash contract without any teammates being downed.
PMC/TRAP_NO_DOWN_START_DESC: Acquire a Raid Weapon Stash contract.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're investigating the nuclear power plant attack. Intel shows there was trace amounts of radiation on a boat docked up north in Taraq. One of our captured AQ members gave up and revealed that the drill used to break into the compound was ditched in a hidden container and that there's two other caches hiding its location. The first one was located west of Taraq in the oasis near the eastern pond. We need to secure that drill as evidence for AQ's involvement in the attack.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Locate the third Hidden Container and extract the Irradiated Drill found inside.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_FIRST_DESC: Locate and loot the first Hidden Container at the oasis west of Taraq.
PMC/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_SECOND_DESC: Locate and loot the second Hidden Container.
PMC/TWO_BIRDS_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters in Al-Safwa Quarry.
PMC/TWO_BIRDS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you brought back revealed AQ held their helos in the quarry before deploying them over the northwestern mountains. Your objective is now to destroy those vehicles. Make enough noise and they'll send in some birds to reinforce the area. That will be your target of opportunity to take down those reinforcements.
PMC/UNHACKED_LAPTOP_DESC: Laptop of an Al Mazrah political figure.
PMC/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 unique contracts in a single deployment.
PMC/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're gearing up for a major operation against AQ and need some last minute funding from our contractees. Locate and complete a variety of contracts in the AO. Our contractors want to see that we're capable of any task put in front of us.
PMC/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 contracts in ^.8^7 unique POIs in one deployment.
PMC/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're expanding our operations and are trying to secure resources to support ourselves. We need you to take on a high volume of contract work throughout the AO.
PMC/UNLOCK_S2_CROWN_PREMIUM: Complete the mission "Stronghold Reacquisition" for the White Lotus faction.
pmc/unlock_s2_legion: Complete the mission "Stronghold Reacquisition" for the White Lotus faction.
PMC/UNLOCK_S4_CROWN:
^BPurchase Call of Duty Modern Warfare II
^R
PMC/UNLOCK_S4_PHALANX: Complete the mission "Icebreaker" for the Black Mous faction.
PMC/UNLOCK_S4_WHITE_LOTUS: Complete the mission "Mysterious Letter" for the Black Mous faction.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_DETAIL_DESC:
We're setting up a new base of operations 15km northeast of Al Mazrah. This should lower our faction's transport costs in the AO. We're missing a few items and we won't be able to quickly get a supply shipment.

We set up a dumpster dead drop at the junkyard in a village north of the airport and south-east of Al-Sharim Pass. Look in the south-east Quadrant of G5 on your Tac-Map. Deliver screwdrivers, light bulbs and drills to the dumpster dead drop. We contracted some local couriers to bring the items to us as soon as possible.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_DRILL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Electric Drill to the Al-Sharim junkyard dead drop.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_LIGHTBULB_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Light Bulbs to the Al-Sharim junkyard dead drop.
PMC/UTILITY_DEADDROP_SCREWDRIVERS: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Screwdrivers to the dumpster dead drop at the junkyard in the village south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: One of our drone feeds showed AQ transporting a narcotics shipment through the Sattiq Cave Complex. Whoever they're in contact with could be the ones moving against us. Infiltrate the caves by boat and clear the site. We know an AQ commander left some documents in a temporary shelter in the riverside caves. Bring them back for us and make it look like they were misplaced.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_ENTER_DESC: Enter the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves by boat.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the Smugging Records in the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a Armored Patrol Boat turret in Sattiq Caves.
PMC/WATER_CAVES_STORY_SWAP_DESC: Place Sensitive Documents at the original location of the Smuggling Records in the same deployment.
PMC/WINE_DELIVERY_AGED_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Aged Wine Bottles to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC/WINE_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: You hopefully remember our friend. His supply has run dry and he's asking for a restock. He's looking for a more vintage selection this time.
PMC/WINE_DELIVERY_WINE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Wine Bottles at any dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/2_POI_TRAVEL_DETAIL_DESC: Good day to you newbie. It's nothing personal and I know you've done your training, but really I don't know who you are, you don't know who I am, so we're even. As a little introduction I got the perfect job for someone I don't fully trust. Such as yourself.  This should be simple but I need someone who's detailed oriented. My squadron tracked a convoy moving a package that came in from the airport and traveled up north to the quarry. Investigate those POIs and get back to me with a full report. I want to know everything you see.
PMC_S2/2_POI_TRAVEL_SECOND_DESC: Travel to Airport in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/ACQUIRE_CASH_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Here's a little test to see if you can handle yourself in the AO. No shame in a simple task. This is a common task for new recruits so we find it appropriate. Secure funding and extract out of the AO. Master this simple task and you'll prove to be a valuable asset.
PMC_S2/ACQUIRE_SPEND_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: We're working to keep AQ's sights on White Lotus, but need to maintain plausible deniability. That means any funds or equipment used in our next operations can't be traced back to us. You'll need to secure cash and use it to purchase weapons and gear.
PMC_S2/AMMO_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: We're planning a trap for Al-Qatala and we need a lot of firepower. Delayed resupplies are slowing down our plans. We're sending in teams to recover weapons and gear for the operation. Your job is to secure any ammunition you find and get it back to base.
PMC_S2/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has taken defensive positions at the Sa'id mall. They're using it as a point of overwatch onto the Al Mazrah river. As it happens a friend of ours is requesting that we test the durability and effectiveness of some weapon attachments. Make use of his specified attachments against AQ forces in Sa'id City and all enemy operators you find.
PMC_S2/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a FTac Recon with a Thermo-Optic X9 attached in  Sa'id City.
PMC_S2/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a FTac Recon with a 419mm EXF Barrel attached.
PMC_S2/BIOLAB_USB_DESC: A thumb drive containing confidential information regarding the DRC and the research done at Building 21.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_GEIGER_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Thanks for the help with those medical documents. It's clear the DRC was doing research with radiation and somehow AQ got their hands on it. But it means that somehow the DRC is involved in the attack on the nuclear power plant, which doesn't bode well. We tracked some nuclear fuel rods in Building 21. The same ones as from the nuclear plant. We're not sure if they're stolen or if they manufactured the rods to begin with. Go back to B21 and secure those fuel rods for us alright?
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_GEIGER_STORY_EQUIP_DESC: Bring a geiger counter into Building 21.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_GEIGER_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the ^.&&1^7 nuclear fuel rods in one deployment.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_GEIGER_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Use the geiger counter to find and take the ^.&&1^7 nuclear fuel rods.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_HARDDRIVE_STORY_DETAIL_DE: Glad to see you got outta the DRC alive. Those fuel rods you procured were all tampered with. Best guess is they were doing research on them, but that suggests they had to get them from someone else. Our best guess is from AQ which would explain how AQ got their hands on the research anyway. In any case, the next step is to figure out who the DRC was working with. We setup a hard drive for you to pick up at the hydroelectric station in Al Mazrah. Plug it into the Building 21 servers and it should download the server data. Be well soldier.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_HARDDRIVE_STORY_DOWNLOAD_: Download the Building 21 server room data onto the hard drive.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_HARDDRIVE_STORY_EXTRACT_D: Extract with the hard drive data.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_HARDDRIVE_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Extract our hard drive in Al Mazrah from the Zarqwa Hydroelectric dead drop.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_A_DESC:
K, we think we finally have found a substance worthy of your objective. The <REDACTED> gas has detrimental short-term effects on the lungs, inducing hypoxia within a minute of mild contact. The compound is able to be produced in mass quantities easily, so I'd like to act quickly. I suspect there's a possible antidote too, but I still need to pinpoint exactly the mechanism it acts on the hemoglobin. 

If it is of your convenience I would be happy to have you visit the DRC again and we'll setup a demonstration. I can say with confidence that you'll be impressed.

- Michal
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_B_DESC:
We hope the additional funds are enough for the new Core Lab. I know Michal you have been good with these things in the past but this is critically important. Urzikstan is already being overrun by the western groups and time is limited. AQ hasn't kept their end of the bargain well and I've had enough of dealing with their leadership. It's not better in the East either. Our old accident has alerted a certain Shadow Company and we must clean and leave no traces. I entrust that you know the stakes.

- Konni
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_C_DESC:
We've received the package and it is exactly as you promised. Our experiments have already begun and already we're seeing a 26% decrease in damage on the subjects protein structures and DNA. Unfortunately on the surface we haven't been able to prevent the burning but it's looking hopeful. 

Not that it's my place, but I'm worried this leads back to us, and ultimately back to my lab. I trust your judgement but those imbeciles don't know a thing about <REDACTED>. One slip up and the eyes of every nation will be on your group. 

- Michal
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INTEL_DESC: Documents and letters covering various operations within the DRC as a whole. The majority are of Russian origin, with a select few in English and Arabic.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INVESTIGATION_STORY_DETAI: Well soldier, you've proven yourself useful to our cause so far. We have a mission that requires someone of your skill set. There's a research center, or rather a military lab, known as the Defense Research Center. There's barely any info on it and we don't have any inside contacts. So naturally we'd like you to be our inside contact.  On the first floor there should be a utility room. That's where they'd be running the power and piping for the whole building. Make a note of everything you see in there, it could all give us a lead. Unfortunate hiccup is that Shadow Company has secured the location, but we'll leave you to figure that part out.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_INVESTIGATION_STORY_LOCAT: Investigate the generator room on F1.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_PLANT_CAMERA_DETAIL_DESC: We need eyes inside the DRC facility. Plant a tactical camera in the core room, then get to the extract point. We'll monitor enemy activity from here.
PMC_S2/BIOLABS_PLANT_CAMERA_PLANT_DESC: Setup a tactical camera in the Building 21 core room.
PMC_S2/BLACK_BOX_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Welcome back. We're still looking over that info you got us from the DRC. I know we haven't been working together for long but we intercepted a Shadow Company plane flying over Al Mazrah. Hopefully you're familiar with it. You could say it landed in the cave complex. On the front dashboard you should be able to download some data from the black box. Retrieve that for us. We also know that they were working with a known corrupted politician. Retrieve anything that links Shadow Company and the politician together.
PMC_S2/BLACK_BOX_STORY_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Download data from the crashed plane's black box.
PMC_S2/BLACK_BOX_STORY_EXFIL_DESC: Extract with the black box data.
PMC_S2/BLACK_BOX_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the politician's letter from the crash site.
PMC_S2/BLACK_MOUS_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A specially encrypted hard drive containing a code injection attack to download data from connected servers.
PMC_S2/BOMB_DELIVERY_CRAFT_DESC: Bring the charge to the Ashika Waterways dead drop with electrical components and a battery to rearm the charge.
PMC_S2/BOMB_DELIVERY_DELIVER_DESC: Dead drop the rearmed charge to the Al Sharim Pass dead drop.
PMC_S2/BOMB_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: A few weeks ago some civilians tried bombing the statue in the central Ahkdar courtyard. It didn't go so well but the explosive is still there just it never went off. We'd like to inspect their handiwork so to say. Get that explosive back and rearm it at the waterways in Ashika Island. We left a small kit for you. Bring it back to Al Sharim Pass. We'll notify some friends when you're done.
PMC_S2/BOMB_DELIVERY_LOOT_DESC: Loot and extract the defused charge from the Ahkdar statue.
PMC_S2/BOSS_WEAPON_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: AQ and Shadow Company are sending in their best fighters to reclaim territory. They're heavy on armor and firepower, but we have the initiative. Track them down and eliminate them.
PMC_S2/BOSS_WEAPON_KILLS_JUGG_DESC: Kill the Armored Commander with the RGL-80.
PMC_S2/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_BUY_DESC: Buy a mortar strike from a Shop.
PMC_S2/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_DETAIL_DESC: We need a show of force against AQ. Secure payment for air assets and direct strikes against any enemy targets.
PMC_S2/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_KILL_DESC: Use mortar strikes to kill ^.&&1^7 enemies.
PMC_S2/CAR_BOMB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: This operation involves sabotaging fuel reserves near Zarqwa Hydroelectric. Accomplishing this mission will tighten the noose around AQ and give us a strategic advantage. Secure vehicles and plant charges at the nearby gas stations. Then climb the northwest radio tower and detonate the charges.
PMC_S2/CAR_BOMB_STORY_EXPLODE_DESC: When all charges are set, climb to the second level of the radio tower in Zarqwa Hydroelectric and detonate the charges.
PMC_S2/CAR_BOMB_STORY_PARK_DESC: Park a vehicle at all ^.4^7 gas stations in Zarqwa Hydroelectric.
PMC_S2/CAR_BOMB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant a charge at each gas station in Zarqwa Hydroelectric with a parked vehicle.
PMC_S2/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is prepping cargo for transport. That cargo is valuable and we have contractees asking for it. Secure the cargo vehicle and move to a designated HLZ where Slasher-2 will meet you to extract the package. Those transport vehicles are worth something on their own as well, so don't let them go to waste. Repair and refuel the vehicle afterwards.
PMC_S2/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_FUEL_REPAIR_DES: Fully repair and refuel the transport vehicle.
