PMC_S2/CAVES_TRACKING_DETAIL_DESC: While we've been fighting Legion, AQ has continued to push their smuggling trade. We need to figure out the routes their transports are taking out of Al Mazrah. There are some trucks in the cave complex marked by AQ. Put tracking devices on them. We left them for you in the dead drop in Al-Sharim Pass along the southeastern cliffs. Also there's a server room in a bunker at the caves. Move there and signals intel will hook into it.
PMC_S2/CAVES_TRACKING_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Travel to the server rack in the bunker in Sattiq Caves and download the data.
PMC_S2/CAVES_TRACKING_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Al-Sharim Pass dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/CAVES_TRACKING_PLANT_DESC: Plant ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices on the AQ trucks in Sattiq Caves in one deployment.
PMC_S2/CEO_LAPTOP_DELIVER_DELIVER_DESC: Take the laptop to the Ashika Beach Club dead drop in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/CEO_LAPTOP_DELIVER_DETAIL_DESC: I hope you're feeling spirited today because you'll want some spirit for this. Fairly simple, you get a laptop from the town hall and put it somewhere else. This sounds easy enough in principal, but don't let your guard down. The laptop is from the Ashika governing agency and we'll need you to include a screwdriver in your package. The target dead drop is behind a gas station right outside the town hall. That area is well guarded by Shadow Company troop, though if you lie low, you stand a chance. Good working with you.
PMC_S2/CEO_LAPTOP_DELIVER_LOOT_DESC: Take the governor's laptop from the Ashika Island town hall.
PMC_S2/CEO_LAPTOP_DELIVER_SCREW_DESC: Deliver a screwdriver into the same dead drop in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/CEO_LAPTOP_DESC: One of the laptops used by an Ashika Island government official.
PMC_S2/CHEMIST_KILL_STORY_DELIVER_DESC: Return the weapon to the same dead drop in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/CHEMIST_KILL_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: And you've returned. That intel you secured on Crown showed they're not actively targeted by AQ. That will change once they think Crown killed a senior commander. We've stashed a Crown weapon in a dead drop in the Sattiq caves near some medical tents. There's a big bright yellow man in the radiation zone. The Chemist he's been called. Be clean and efficient. Return the weapon once the deed is done, and I'll handle it from there. Don't stir up too much noise down there. My men already have enough to deal with and I don't wanna be cleaning up your mess too.
PMC_S2/CHEMIST_KILL_STORY_KILL_DESC: Use the weapon to kill the Chemist in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/CHEMIST_KILL_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Take the weapon from the Sattiq Caves dead drop.
PMC_S2/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DESC: Clear a stronghold of enemy combatants.
PMC_S2/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DETAIL_DESC: Well you've shown that you're mostly a capable asset for us. Hopefully you don't have too much trouble with this next assignment. We used to occupy some strongholds in Al Mazrah which were secured by Al-Qatala forces. We know they setup a deal with another military corporation, Legion. They should have some documents related to the deal in their strongholds. Secure it for us.
PMC_S2/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_INTEL_DESC: Pick up and read the Legion deal intel found on stronghold guards.
PMC_S2/COMPLETE_HUNT_EXTRACT_WEAPON_DETA: We keep a close eye on the equipment of our enemies as well as our competitors. Take a contract to hunt enemy operators. Secure their weapons and get them back here for inspection.
PMC_S2/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_CONSOLE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 game consoles to the same dead drop.
PMC_S2/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: The level of reconnaissance we provide requires consistent maintenance. Secure parts we can use to upgrade our systems. There's a dead drop we setup behind a gas station near the beach club. Deliver large items to the dead drop and extract the smaller parts yourself.
PMC_S2/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_GPU_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 GPU to the Beach Club dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/COUNTER_TEAM_DEFUSE_DESC: Defuse an enemy team's charge at a supply site.
PMC_S2/COUNTER_TEAM_SAM_DESC: Capture an enemy team's SAM Site ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC_S2/COUNTER_TEAM_UAV_DESC: Capture an enemy team's UAV Tower ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC_S2/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: We're still tracking the cargo on the train, though one of our informants puts a high probability on the cargo originating from the quarry up north. Our drone captured an AQ commander meeting with some troops at the quarry crane building. Gain access and gather any intel you find.
PMC_S2/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the quarry operations folder in the crane control room.
PMC_S2/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_KEY_DESC: Acquire a key for the crane control room in Al Safwa Quarry.
PMC_S2/CROWN_INTEL_DESC: These documents don't reveal much. There is official documentation of Crown's legitimacy as a business and organization within the UK. There are trade reports of their involvement with various international entities, with a high concentration in Europe, Africa, and East Asia. Their listed work and employment seems thoroughly detailed though there's a surprising amount of revenue and cash flow for the work they do.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_DELIVER_DESC: Drop the hard drive in the Waterways dead drop on Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_DETAIL_DESC: I could tell you about our plans with that intel you've found, but let's cut to the mission. We hired a driver to return a hard drive to us, and we have not heard back from him. He was travelling north from Ahkdar. Main thing is that you get that hard drive and bring it to a dead drop we've setup in the waterways of Ashika Island. Remember, you're looking for a white dumpster. It goes without saying but Shadow Company keeps that area locked down tight, so you'll need to be covert.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_LOCATE_DESC: Locate the car crash site near the observatory.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_LOOT_DESC: Find and extract the hard drive near the crash site.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_ELECTRONICS_BATTERIES_DES: Place ^.&&1^7 batteries into the same dead drop.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_ELECTRONICS_CABLES_DESC: Place ^.&&1^7 jumper cables in the same dead drop.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_ELECTRONICS_CAR_BATTERY_D: Place ^.&&1^7 car battery into the dead drop near the science center on Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_ELECTRONICS_DETAIL_DESC: Hey there soldier. We had a major incident involving two tanks, a civilian bus, and a refueling truck. That's not your concern though. Your concern is that we need some batteries to rewire some components of the vehicles. Locate the items and deliver them to the dead drop near the Ashika Island science center. Don't take too long.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_EQUIPMENT_MODERNCITY_DELI: Deliver ^.&&1^7 pieces of lethal equipment to the dumpster dead drop in the Sarwana Hotel alley, north of the Al Mazrah City Post Office.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_EQUIPMENT_MODERNCITY_DETA: We're running into a shortage of lethal equipment that we need for an upcoming operation. There's a dumpster we selected in Al Mazrah City. It's in the back alley of Sarwana Hotel. You should be able to find it north of the post office, across the river. We're paying some guys to discretely bring back equipment we drop in there. Find the dumpster dead drop and deliver some lethal equipment to it.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_DETAIL_: The location of our R&D base was compromised. We're moving units out of there but there's too much heavy equipment and intel that we need destroyed. We setup a dead drop near the railroad west of Rohan Oil for the gas. The other items we need are more conspicuous and need to be extracted.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_GASCANS: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gas Cans to the dumpster dead drop at the train depot between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_ITEMS_D: Extract ^.&&1^7 Lighters, Comic Books, Bandages, or Documents.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_KILL_ENEMY_WEAPONS_DELIVE: Deliver ^.&&1^7 enemy operator's weapons to the dead drop in the Ashika Residential district.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_KILL_ENEMY_WEAPONS_DETAIL: You've been a valuable operator to us for some time. Efficient and willing. Now we need you to be willing to do some less than clean work for us. You see other fighters are also valuable to other groups. That makes them valuable targets for us. I'm sure you see where I'm getting at. This isn't the type of work I like to ask for but I put my work before my feelings and so I ask that you bring some intel back from those fighters. I'm sure you will deliver.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_KILL_ENEMY_WEAPONS_EXTRAC: Extract a gold or damascus dog tag.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_KILL_ENEMY_WEAPONS_KILL_D: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with enemy operator's weapons.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_LETTER_DETAIL_DESC: Time is of the essence so no chit-chat. A source in Sarrif Bay was transporting some contraband for us. The contents are not for you to know yet. The delivery is missing and he went AWOL. He's not the type to just abandon us so he probably left a note somewhere. He was travelling from Sawah village to the observatory. Gather whatever you find and stash it in the apartment complex on Ashika Island. Room B7. Hope you come back good and strong. We'll need you for our next big operation.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_LETTER_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the letter from the Sarrif Bay bath house.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_LETTER_PLACE_DESC: Place the letter in room B7 of the Ashika Island apartment complex.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SHADOW_DOCS_DETAIL_DESC: While we're still reviewing those medical documents we have a slightly tricky task for you. There's some documents about Shadow Company's deal for the oil pipeline near the plane crash in Sattiq caves. There's some documents for Shadow Company's internal working somewhere in the Tsuki Castle. The deal documents go to the dumpster dead drop behind the Ashika houses. The internal docouments go to the Zaya Observatory dead drop. Remember stealth and plausible deniability are essential to our group. Don't let us down solder.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SHADOW_DOCS_SABA_DESC: Dead drop Shadow Company internal documents at Zaya Observatory.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SHADOW_DOCS_SEALION_DESC: Dead drop Shadow Company's deal documents in the Residential district in Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_DESC: Welcome back. Now that Legion is sorting through their internal affairs we think it's time to expand. Shadow Company seems to have interest in Ashika Island and we want to know why. First step is to setup a small base for recon close by the island to keep overwatch on their activity. We have a list of items we need for our new pacific base. Gun oil, consumer electronics, and a blow torch. The rest we can fetch ourselves. The dead drop is located in the residential district in Ashika Island. Don't take too long out there.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_FOOD_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 blow torch to the same dead drop.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_TAPE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 videocassette recorders or game consoles to the same dead drop.
PMC_S2/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_TOOTHPASTE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 bottles of gun oil to the dumpster dead drop in the Residential district of Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/DEMOLITION_SAFE_DETAIL_DESC: One of our contractees has intel on high-value safes in the area. They're willing to give up that intel in exchange for a small job. They need you to destroy Al-Qatala's supply sites. Infil and find an AQ burner phone with intel on the supply site locations.
PMC_S2/DESTROY_PLANE_STORY_CALL_DESC: Call in the executive's aircraft from the air traffic control tower in Al Malik International.
PMC_S2/DESTROY_PLANE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Okay friend, this is our time to shine. Legion command is inbound over Al Mazrah. They're in a holding pattern until they get the greenlight. Get to the ATC and bring em in. Wait till they're over and then blast them outta the sky. Your work has been good so far and I hope you understand my cause. Maybe you can join us permanently as we bring Legion to a new age.
PMC_S2/DESTROY_PLANE_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the golden M4.
PMC_S2/DESTROY_VEHICLE_PARTS_PLAYER_TIRE: Pop ^.&&1^7 vehicle tires on moving enemy operator vehicles.
PMC_S2/DESTROY_VEHICLE_PARTS_TIRES_DESC: Pop ^.&&1^7 vehicle tires on moving enemy vehicles.
PMC_S2/DESTROY_VEHICLE_PARTS_WINDOWS_DES: Shatter ^.&&1^7 vehicle windows on moving enemy vehicles.
PMC_S2/DISABLE_UAV_SAMS_SAMSITE_DESC: Disable ^.&&1^7 SAM Sites that are controlled by enemy operators.
PMC_S2/DISABLE_UAV_SAMS_UAV_DESC: Disable ^.&&1^7 UAV Towers that are controlled by enemy operators.
PMC_S2/DOG_TAG_BACKPACK_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract with a backpack full of dog tags.
PMC_S2/DOG_TAG_BACKPACK_EXTRACT_DETAIL_D: We're new to these PMCs and we'd like a better idea of who the other corporations are hiring. Bring us back a backpack full of dog tags. I know it's a bit macabre but we're working under hard circumstances and I assume this will fit within your line of work. Good luck and good hunting.
PMC_S2/DOG_TAG_EXTRACT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Legion and White Lotus cannot get in our way for our next critical mission. We need to heavily weaken their forces and push them out of Al Mazrah at least temporarily. Eliminate as many operators as you can and secure their dog tags for psychological damage. While they are busy retreating, that's when we make our next move.
PMC_S2/DOG_TAG_EXTRACT_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed assault rifle.
PMC_S2/DRIVE_BY_STORY_BUY_DESC: Purchase an LTV with a turret at a Shop.
PMC_S2/DRIVE_BY_STORY_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy the LTV in Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC_S2/DRIVE_BY_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala still considers White Lotus a low-level threat at this time. We're going to convince them otherwise. Secure an up-armored LTV and use it to engage enemy forces in Ahkdar. After enough damage is done, break contact and drive to the marshlands to destroy the evidence. Our team will leak data tracing the attack back to White Lotus.
PMC_S2/DRIVE_BY_STORY_KILL_DESC: Use the LTV turret to kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S2/DRIVERS_NOTE_DESC:
I don't know who it was, they weren't AQ, they sounded like they were speaking Russian. And the equipment they were using I know I haven't seen anything like that. I received the package from the drop off point in the sunken village. I was driving the package through Sarrif Bay and no the AQ guards didn't seem suspicious of me.
Nearing the bridge to Ahkdar shots were fired rapidly at my car. They didn't stop even when I announced that I was a civilian.
I got away leaving the car and package behind. I ran back to Sarrif Bay and met the AQ members who heard the shots. By the time they ran over to the attack site the shooters were gone and the car was destroyed, package included.
PMC_S2/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_DETAIL_DESC: Intel confirms AQ is meeting with members of the Las Almas cartel. These are High Value Targets with information we can use for an upcoming operation. Recon shows AQ is storing up critical equipment within locked compounds for Las Almas. Your task is to eliminate an HVT, sweep them for keys to these compounds, and secure the objectives within them.
PMC_S2/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_LOOT_DESC: Loot a key found on an HVT or elsewhere.
PMC_S2/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_UNLOCK_DESC: Use a key to unlock a locked space or locked cache.
PMC_S2/ELIM_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete an Eliminate HVT contract in under ^.2^7 minutes.
PMC_S2/ELIM_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has been allocating their best guards to defend the Las Almas smugglers. It seems they're in position to alert their command if they are engaged. You need to locate and neutralize the HVTs with speed and aggression.
PMC_S2/ESPIONAGE_STORY_DELIVER_DESC: Deliver the laptop to the dumpster dead drop in the Sattiq Caves complex.
PMC_S2/ESPIONAGE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We've been tracking a high profile political figure who has been spotted multiple times in the north-west of Al Mazrah, in a farm home near the poppy fields. You'll need a key to enter. Try to make your way into the compound and steal his laptop. Take it to the dumpster dead drop north-east of the cemetery. It's in a small village beside the train tracks. We left a USB device that will install a rootkit on the laptop. Once you're done, place the hacked laptop back where you found it.
PMC_S2/ESPIONAGE_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Enter the Sattiq Poppy Farmer House and loot the target's laptop.
PMC_S2/ESPIONAGE_STORY_PLANT: Plant the hacked laptop back in the Sattiq Poppy Farmer House where it was taken from.
PMC_S2/EXECUTE_KILL_STUNNED_DETAIL_DESC: We're working to exploit AQ's security systems. Their strongholds can provide intel we can use to locate them. We are losing lots of operators to the riot shield guards. Take them out and clear the stronghold. SSE teams will search for the data we need afterwards. Advise taking stun grenades with you.
PMC_S2/EXECUTE_KILL_STUNNED_EXECUTE_DESC: Execute ^.&&1^7 AQ soldiers wielding riot shields.
PMC_S2/EXFIL_SABA_SEALION_STREAK_SABA_DE: Exfil in Al Mazrah and Ashika Island without squad wiping. (Al Mazrah)
PMC_S2/EXFIL_SABA_SEALION_STREAK_SEALION: Exfil in Al Mazrah and Ashika Island without squad wiping. (Ashika Island)
PMC_S2/EXFIL_STREAK_DESC: Successfully exfil from ^.&&1^7 deployments in a row.
PMC_S2/EXFIL_STREAK_DETAIL_DESC: This might seem like an odd task, and it frankly is more of a test of ability than a proper job. But our next big operation requires an operator that knows how to get in and out untouched. You'll need to demonstrate a mastery of covert movement through the AO. Show us you can consistently extract safely. Good luck. You'll probably need it.
PMC_S2/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Thank you for retrieving those drug bricks for us. The cartel is getting wildly creative these days. Either way this next operation is fairly straight forward. There's 4 trackers in the south gas station dead drop near the hydroelectric dam in Al Mazrah. Plant them under the wings of 4 exfil helos. We'll be monitoring where our enemies have setup their FOBs. Remember to be out of sight of enemies. Any slip up and they'll know our plans.
PMC_S2/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Take and extract the ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Zarqwa Hydroelectric dead drop.
PMC_S2/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_FINAL_DESC: Plant a tracker on the final exfil chopper.
PMC_S2/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant a tracker on ^.&&1^7 enemy exfil choppers.
PMC_S2/EXPERIMENT_HARDDRIVE_DESC: An encrypted hard drive containing a copy of some data from the DRC.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_ARMOR_DETAIL_DESC: We'll need armor reserves to maintain op-tempo. Secure any plate carriers and armor you find in the AO, then proceed to extraction.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_ARMOR_PLATES_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 armor plates in one deployment.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_DOGTAGS_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 enemy dog tags from Building 21 in one deployment.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DE: Hard one for you today, but one I think a trooper such as yourself will have fun with. Control of the DRC facility is a priority objective. We can't claim to control anything while enemy operators run around in there. Clear it out and bring back souvenirs.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_BLUE_DESC: Extract the Building 21 intel from the blue locked room in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: While we figure out our next steps we have some knowledge of specific intel in Building 21 that we'd like you to retrieve. You'll need to gain access to a few rooms but that shouldn't be a problem for a fighter like yourself right? Intel places the documents in the red, blue, and black rooms of the facility. Don't let anyone see you take the documents. They are highly confidential.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_GREEN_DESC: Extract the Building 21 intel from the black  locked room.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_RED_DESC: Extract the Building 21 intel from the red locked room in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_KEYCARD_DETAIL_DE: Let's see if you know your stuff. High-level idea is this. There's a facility. The DRC, Defense Research Center. In it there's a specific building, Building 21. We want access to it. The only way you get access to it is with a Building 21 keycard. You've extracted objectives out of the AO before, so I suspect you'll be fine carrying a small card. If you can procure the card for me I'll see it as the beginning of a long career working together.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_ENCRYPTED_HDD_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 encrypted hard drives from Building 21.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_ENCRYPTED_HDD_DETAIL_DESC: You may have stepped into Building 21 a few times already, and if so you know what sort of tech they hide in there. Objective is as simple as it sounds. Bring back hard drives from the building that contain sensitive data. We'll be inspecting what they were up to and it prevents others from using the data for nefarious purposes.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_MEDS_DETAIL_DESC: A few of our operators have sustained injuries from a recent AQ assault. Our medical supplies in the FOB are running low and we can't risk a transport vehicle getting hit on the road. We need you to go in and secure some light medical supplies.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_MISC_ITEMS_CREAM_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 bottles of soothing hand cream.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PERSONALS_DETAIL_DESC: Hello there. I had an informant who was recently just extracted out of Al Mazrah after AQ found him and his family out. He lived on a small terraced farm north of the Sattiq caves. He has some items he requested we bring back for him. While this is a personal job I'm asking of you, Al-Qatala has devastated many of the people in Al Mazrah. This is just one small way to repay them.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PERSONALS_NECKLACE_DESC: Find and extract the friend's heart necklace.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PERSONALS_WATCH_DESC: Find and extract the friend's watch.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PERSONALS_WINE_DESC: Find and extract the friend's photo.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PHOTOS_DETAIL_DESC: There's some evidence of Al-Qatala's involvement in the Piccadilly attack found within the AO. Find the evidence and get it back to us. Any intel involving our organization should be extracted as well.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PHOTOS_INTEL_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 pieces of Black Mous Intel.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: I hope this reaches you well. We have a more relaxing job for you today. There's a hotel room at the Ashika Island hotel that a friend of ours was staying at. He left a little document for us. First step is to get inside that room, it's probably locked. Next step is to stash a special USB we delivered to the dead drop in the underground waterways. So get the documents and place the USB. Our friend will go back to pick it up.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the Al Mazrah shipping intel from room 403 of the Ashika Island hotel.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_LOOT_DESC: Take the Building 21 USB stick from the dead drop in the Waterways.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_PLANT_DESC: Place the Building 21 USB in the hotel room.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_RARE_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: This isn't a task I give to you lightly, but upper executives are forcing my hand. They want someone to retrieve some rare and expensive items for them. I didn't dare ask what for. My men are all busy so I come to you to ask for this favor. You will be compensated well, so I hope it's worth the struggle.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_SHADOW_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: Good work with the blackbox data. We determined that Shadow Company was carrying some more cargo with them. We've located key pieces of Shadow Company documents and data that can shed light on their operations here. The items would've landed around the area of the crash site, though some might have travelled a fair ways away.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_SHADOW_INTEL_DOCUMENTS_DE: Find and extract Shadow Company's deal documents.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_SHADOW_INTEL_LETTER_DESC: Find and extract Shadow Company's letter.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_SHADOW_INTEL_USB_DESC: Find and extract Shadow Company's hard drive.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_TACTICALS_DETAIL_DESC: R&D for a planned operation requires that we secure a full restock of tactical equipment and locals are asking for too much payment to smuggle high-tech equipment out of the AO. You're tasked with getting the job done. Gas grenades, flashes, and snapshots. Their future use is on a need to know basis.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_DETAIL_DESC: We know of a few commanders leading Al-Qatala's forces. Take a contract to reveal intel on their locations and eliminate the targets. One of them has been seen with a case of valuable weaponry. Find it and get to extraction.
PMC_S2/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_STREAK_DETAI: We've been maintaining high surveillance on AQ's command structure. The Armored Commander is protecting valuable weapons cases. We need you to secure the targets and get them extracted. No casualties are allowed.
PMC_S2/FAKE_AQ_INTEL_DESC: Documents discussing AQ's involvement in the Ashika and Al Mazrah cargo ships and how they were used for trafficking drugs to the cartel and throughout East Asia.
PMC_S2/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: Intel is following a lead on operations in the radiated zone. We'll be tasking squads into those areas for kill/capture missions, and they'll need help for those operations. Locate radiation blockers in the area, as well as any additional funds you can find. Prove that the gear works by staying in the AO until the very last exfil arrives.
PMC_S2/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil ^.&&1^7 times using the final exfil with ^.$60k^7 cash.
PMC_S2/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_LOOT_DESC: Acquire a bottle of radiation blockers.
PMC_S2/FINAL_EXFIL_HOSTAGE_DESC: Exfil with the hostage at the final exfil helo.
PMC_S2/FORT_LOOT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala has taken an interest in the southern coastal fortress. Our intel just shows it as a historic site. We need some operators to scout it out.
PMC_S2/FORT_LOOT_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC_S2/FORT_LOOT_KILL_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 caches in Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC_S2/FORT_SEWER_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for some more documentation regarding Al-Qatala's computer systems. We tracked it to the sewers underneath the southern coastal fortress. There's a security system at play there. Once you enter the sewers you'll only have a few minutes to disable the security system. There's seven electrical breakers throughout the sewer that you need to reroute before the security system triggers and reinforcements are called in. After you deal with the security system, extract the system architecture.
PMC_S2/FORT_SEWER_STORY_DISARM_DESC: Reroute the ^.&&1^7 security devices in under ^.4:00^7 minutes to unlock the system architecture's container
PMC_S2/FORT_SEWER_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the system architecture documentation
PMC_S2/FORT_SEWER_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to the sewer under Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC_S2/FUEL_REPAIR_DESC: Fuel and repair vehicles at ^.&&1^7 gas stations.
PMC_S2/FUEL_REPAIR_LOOT_GAS_CANS_DETAIL_: A future operation requires that you have some experience with fueling and repairing vehicles at gas stations. Secure any gas cans you find and practice refueling your vehicle en-route. Bring some back for us as well.
PMC_S2/FULL_BACKPACK_LOADOUT_DESC: Exfil with a full backpack and a full loadout ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC_S2/FULL_BACKPACK_LOADOUT_DETAIL_DESC: Fuel is becoming more scarce in Al Mazrah, so every infil needs to be worth the risk. Secure a complete haul before exiting the area. That means a full large backpack and loadout including lethals, tacticals, a field upgrade, a killstreak, a self-revive kit, a durable gas mask, and a full set of armor plates.
PMC_S2/GEIGER_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: Hopefully you've seen the news about the attack on the nuclear plant. Word is that AQ was responsible. Multiple local informants claim they're hiding the evidence in buried barrels in the AO. One of our contractees is offering a payout for securing that intel. They'll provide you with Geiger counters. Use them to locate the nuclear material.
PMC_S2/GEIGER_LOOT_LOOT_DESC: Take ^.&&1^7 items from the radioactive caches.
PMC_S2/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: A friend of ours had business in Al Mazrah before the AQ occupation. He has a special request for you to bring back a very personal item he left behind. He was staying in room 302 of a hotel in Sawah Village.
PMC_S2/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the golden .50 GS from room 302 in the Sawah Hotel.
PMC_S2/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_UNLOCK_DESC: Unlock room 302 in the top floor of the Sawah Hotel.
PMC_S2/GOLD_DELIVERY_BARS_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gold Bars to the dumpster dead drop south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC_S2/GOLD_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: Our friend is asking for lucrative valuables in exchange for his services and his cash. Locate gold items and get them to the junkyard dead drop north of the Al Malik airport. These will keep us funded for months to come.
PMC_S2/GOLD_DELIVERY_SKULL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gold Skulls to the dumpster dead drop south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC_S2/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We placed a GPS tracker at the burger shop at the observatory. We need you to use the GPS to help us update our topographical maps of the area. We'll need frequent sample points across the AO to accurately krige together into workable data. Take the tracker from the dead drop, visit all of the major points of interest, and return with it.
PMC_S2/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Loot the GPS tracker from the dumpster dead drop in Zaya Observatory.
PMC_S2/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to every POI in Al Mazrah while carrying the GPS tracker in one deployment.
PMC_S2/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DE: Our higher ups have reduced our total budget for explosive equipment after an accident with one of the burn pits in our base. Well we still require a supply of light explosives. Bring mines and claymores to the dead drop on the railroad between the quarry and the oil processing plants. Our courier has a large asking price for the thermite grenades so we'd rather you deliver them all at once to the dumpster dead drop at the Sarwana Hotel, north of the Al Mazrah City Post Office. I trust you'll be able to carry fragmentation grenades on your person without us needing to hire more delivery drivers.
PMC_S2/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_FRAG_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 Frag Grenades in one deployment.
PMC_S2/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_MINES_DES: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Proximity Mines or Claymores to the dumpster dead drop in between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
PMC_S2/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_THERMITE_: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Thermite Grenades to the dumpster dead drop in Al Mazrah City in one deployment.
PMC_S2/HACK_KILL_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for better data on the geography of Al Mazrah for future operations. Activate some UAV Towers so we can conduct topographical surveys with the UAV. Try to keep a low profile and take out any nearby hostiles that might interfere.
PMC_S2/HACK_KILL_UAV_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies pinged by UAV Towers.
PMC_S2/HACK_WHEELSON_DESC: Hack the Wheelson in Ashika Island or in Building 21.
PMC_S2/HACK_WHEELSON_DETAIL_DESC: Shadow Company utilizes multiple defense systems against intruders. One of them is a mobile weapons platform, called a 'Wheelson'. If you can get in range, the signal controlling it can be hacked. We recommend using an EMP or a DDOS first before moving in, though we understand you have your own methods. Not that it's a bad thing, it's one of the reasons we hire you.
PMC_S2/HDD_UPLOAD_STORY_DECRYPT_DESC: Decrypt the hard drive at a computer in Building 21.
PMC_S2/HDD_UPLOAD_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Good to see you again. For your benefit I hope you're well rested for this next operation. Hopefully you still have that hard drive from Ashika Island. Just to be transparent it's a hard drive from Building 21. Thus, we need you to decrypt the hard drive at Building 21. There's a server room in the basement you should be able to hook into. Bring the decrypted hard drive back to Al Mazrah and upload it at the highest upload station to reach our local FOB there. It's a tough operation, which is why we have the utmost trust in you.
PMC_S2/HDD_UPLOAD_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Bring the experiment hard drive into Building 21.
PMC_S2/HDD_UPLOAD_STORY_UPLOAD_DESC: Upload the decrypted hard drive at the Zaya Observatory radio tower in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S2/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_DETAIL_DES: The Sattiq Cave operation revealed three major sites of operations for AQ. We are looking for more intel on their operations and who's helping them. Your targets are Al Malik Terminal, the Mawizeh Resort main building, and the police academy. Secure all three objectives and we'll send in SSE teams after to sweep for intel.
PMC_S2/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_EMBASSY_DE: Unlock and clear the Al Mazrah Police Academy in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_POSTOFFICE: Unlock and clear the Mawizeh Resort Main Building in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_WAREHOUSE_: Unlock and clear Al Malik Terminal.
PMC_S2/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala has been taking potential informants in as hostages. Our associates would like you to protect them and will pay a hefty price if you can extract them safely. Find and secure the hostage, bring them to an HLZ and extract with the hostage to ensure their survival.
PMC_S2/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with the hostage evac helo.
PMC_S2/HOSTAGE_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete ^.3^7 Rescue Hostage contracts, each in under ^.2:00^7 minutes.
PMC_S2/HOSTAGE_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has captured our high-level sources. The information they provide is crucial for an upcoming operation. Any delay and AQ will be able to take action against their information. Move fast to secure our hostages.
PMC_S2/HUMANITARIAN_EXTRACT_BANDAGE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Bandages to the dumpster dead drop in Sa'id City.
PMC_S2/HUMANITARIAN_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: Some portion of the Al Mazrah water supply was contaminated and we have reason to think Legion was involved. We've moved some ill and injured civilians into an old hospital a few klicks up north along the river, but it's missing some supplies that would help aid them. Retrieve them for us. We have a driver ready to pick up light items from the dead drop at the mall.
PMC_S2/HUNT_STREAK_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 Hunt Squad contracts without dying.
PMC_S2/HUNT_STREAK_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking to investigate the equipment of our opposition in greater detail. We'll need you to take out a multitude of enemy operators. Do this without taking heavy casualties. We need our reputation maintained.
PMC_S2/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: You're one of few who we think is up for these kinds of confidential tasks. You're probably familiar with the hydroelectric facilities on the river. There are some wells that lead into the internal treatment process and exit directly back into the river. Throw some Gas Grenades down into those wells. Distribute the gas evenly among the wells to help the chemical compounds better dissolve.
PMC_S2/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Acquire ^.&&1^7 gas grenades in one deployment.
PMC_S2/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_THROW_DESC: Throw ^.&&1^7 gas grenades into the open water wells in Zarqwa Hydroelectric in one deployment.
PMC_S2/INFIL_EXFIL_CUSTOM_DETAIL_DESC: Operations against White Lotus and Black Mous have put a target on us. Command is requesting all teams load up with extra security. Take a custom weapon when you head out. Nothing standard issue on this run.
PMC_S2/INFIL_EXFIL_CUSTOM_EXFIL_DESC: Extract with your customized insured weapon.
PMC_S2/INFIL_EXFIL_CUSTOM_INFIL_DESC: Infil with a customized insured weapon.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_NO_WEAPONS_DET: Operators who work with us must be experts in escape and evasion. Infil into the AO empty handed and make it to extraction without picking up a weapon.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_NO_WEAPONS_EXF: Exfil in the same deployment without picking up any weapons.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_EXTRAC: Extract ^.&&1^7 weapons with at least ^.3^7 attachments each in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_INFIL_: Infil without any teammates without any weapons.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: We need an operator that can work alone and still be dangerous. Get in with nothing and make magic happen. Our next operation will require these skills in movement and combat. Have fun fighter.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil in the same deployment without having picked up any weapons.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_INFIL_DESC: Infil without any teammates and without any weapons.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operator in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_KNIFE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: It's a great day for a challenge isn't it? No teammates, no weapons, I want to see how productive you can be with nothing. Making wine out of water is key in our line of work. Do this and you'll prove you have what it takes to rise in our ranks. Though this should be easy enough for a soldier of your caliber wouldn't you agree?
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_KNIFE_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_PISTOL_EXFIL_DESC: Extract the Weapons Case without having picked up any weapons in the deployment.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SOLO_PISTOL_INFIL_DESC: Infil without any teammates with only a pistol.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SPEND_EXFIL_CASH_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with ^.$&&1^7 on your operator in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/INFIL_SPEND_EXFIL_CASH_SPEND_DESC: Spend ^.$&&1^7 at a Buy Station in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/INSTRUCTIONS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Hey there. Unfortunately I can't give you much intel on this mission. My higher ups have sent someone to deliver a note for you at the dead drop near Al Bagra Fortress. Follow the instructions. I trust you friend.
PMC_S2/INSTRUCTIONS_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Take and read the notes from the Al Bagra Fortress dead drop.
PMC_S2/INTEL_BOSS_DETAIL_DESC: We received information on Al-Qatala commanders operating in the area. Targeting these individuals will help disrupt AQ's command structure. We need you to secure intel on a commander to locate their current position. Then move to neutralize the target.
PMC_S2/INTEL_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete ^.5^7 contracts each in less than ^.1:00^7 minute.
PMC_S2/INTEL_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: White Lotus is gaining support from the local population. We need to get ahead of them, or we could lose access to informants and critical intel. We need their primary contractees on our side. Secure contract work in the area and get the job done fast. Show the people of Al Mazrah who they should align with.
PMC_S2/INVESTIGATE_PLANE_CRASH_DETAIL_DE: There's a plane in the Sattiq caves that was carrying Shadow Company troops over Al Mazrah. We had a part to play in taking it down, but the exact nature of the cargo is unknown to us. Get over there and investigate the crash site. We want to know exactly what Shadow Company is up to and what their next plans are. Stay safe.
PMC_S2/INVESTIGATE_PLANE_CRASH_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Sattiq Caves Complex in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/INVESTIGATE_PLANE_CRASH_LOCATE_DE: Locate and investigate the crash site.
PMC_S2/KILL_ARMORED_ARMOR_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 armored enemies in Sawah Village.
PMC_S2/KILL_ARMORED_DETAIL_DESC: Our operators have been getting hit hard by Al-Qatala forces and they're reporting that someone is giving AQ access to better gear. We're looking to target various highly armed forces. We'll be waiting for AQ to receive a restock of their equipment which we'll be tracking to see who's supplying them.
PMC_S2/KILL_ARMORED_RIOT_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies wielding riot shields in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S2/KILL_BOSS_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: This operation will target the enemy's high command. We're cutting the heads off snakes. Infil to the AO and eliminate two senior commanders in quick succession. Run faster than their bullets and you'll be fine.
PMC_S2/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_CHEMIST_DESC: Kill the Chemist with the M13B.
PMC_S2/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_CHOPPER_DESC: Kill the Helo Commander from a helicopter.
PMC_S2/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_DETAIL_DESC: The best way to wound the enemy is to hit them where it hurts right? That's why we need you to eliminate enemy commanders with their own weapons of choice. I know you're one to work with style so I have confidence that this is up your alley.
PMC_S2/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_TRAPPER_DESC: Kill the Bombmaker with a claymore.
PMC_S2/KILL_HITLOCS_DETAIL_DESC: Are you a good shot? Well I guess I'll find out. Sometimes you don't need to inflict lethal damage to an enemy and sometimes you very quickly need to inflict lethal hits. Strategy and tactics will only get you so far in the exclusion zone. Aim and weapon mastery is still king here so show us what you got.
PMC_S2/KILL_HITLOCS_NECK_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with arm shots with a sniper rifle.
PMC_S2/KILL_LOOT_AQ_DETAIL_DESC: Welcome to Crown. Our mission is to restore order to areas of conflict, through peace or violence- and we're skilled at both. The task here is to take weapons out of the hands of terrorists and ensure they don't fall into the wrong hands again.
PMC_S2/KILL_PLAYERS_SINGLE_MATCH_DETAIL_: Sometimes the best defense is a good offense. Not sure if you watch football but I happen to believe this saying. To aid our defense and secure a foothold in the AO for our upcoming operation we need you to eliminate as many enemy operators as you can. They'll be more hesitant to send any more assets in while we do our work.
PMC_S2/KILL_SHADOWS_AQ_DETAIL_DESC: Good day then lad. In combat, you need to know your enemy. For our group, AQ and the Cartel are two sides of the same coin. To us, they're both just valid targets. Get out there and do what we do best.
PMC_S2/KILL_SHADOWS_AQ_SHADOWS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 Cartel soldiers in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/KILL_TRAPPER_NO_TRIGGER_DESC: Kill the Bombmaker without triggering any traps.
PMC_S2/KILL_TRAPPER_NO_TRIGGER_DETAIL_DE: AQ is using trappers to set up ambushes against our teams. We need you to hunt down one of these targets and eliminate them. Do it without setting off any of his traps or surveillance. Show AQ their tactics don't mean a bloody thing.
PMC_S2/KILL_TRAPPER_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Kill the Bombmaker within ^.60^7 seconds of entering the Tsuki Castle courtyard.
PMC_S2/KILL_TRAPPER_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC: There's a high-value-target near the castle courtyard on Ashika Island. They call him the Bombmaker. You may have gotten to know him already. Get in there and eliminate him fast. Stay sharp down there - this one has a tendency for traps.
PMC_S2/KILL_WHEELSON_NO_DAMAGE_DESC: Kill the Wheelson in Building 21 without taking damage after LPCON Charlie.
PMC_S2/KILL_WHEELSON_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Kill the Wheelson in Building 21 within ^.45^7 seconds after LPCON CHARLIE.
PMC_S2/KILL_WHEELSON_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DES: There's a Shadow Company Wheelson in Building 21. We need you to eliminate it quickly so we can get you out and send in another team for investigation.
PMC_S2/KILLS_AKILO_PLATFORM_BOSSES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 commander with the Kastov platform.
PMC_S2/KILLS_AKILO_PLATFORM_DETAIL_DESC: Our enemies get their weapons from primarily one group, the Kastovs. Now of course we expect you to handle your own gear, but there are times where things don't always go as planned. Knowing how to handle the Kastov system can save your arse when its in a bind. Let's see that you're not a one-trick pony.
PMC_S2/KILLS_AKILO_PLATFORM_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with headshots with the Kastov platform of weapons.
PMC_S2/KILLS_AKILO_PLATFORM_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with the Kastov platform.
PMC_S2/KILLS_CARRY_HOSTAGE_BOSSES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 commander while holding a hostage.
PMC_S2/KILLS_CARRY_HOSTAGE_DETAIL_DESC: AQ was given intel on our attacks against them. In response, they've taken one of our critical informants hostage. You've been tasked as part of a hostage rescue team. Secure the informant and kill any targets you find.
PMC_S2/KILLS_CARRY_HOSTAGE_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while holding a hostage.
PMC_S2/KILLS_CARRY_HOSTAGE_SHIELDS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 riot shield enemies while holding a hostage.
PMC_S2/KILLS_DRILL_CHARGE_DETAIL_DESC: We're happy to share some new equipment with you. One new piece of tech we're working with is the drill charge. This thing will bore a hole through almost any surface - even shields, which makes it my personal favorite. Get out there and see what it can do alright.
PMC_S2/KILLS_DRILL_CHARGE_SHIELDS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 riot shield wielding enemies with a drill charge.
PMC_S2/KILLS_ENEMY_WEAPON_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with enemy operator's weapons.
PMC_S2/KILLS_ENEMY_WEAPON_DETAIL_DESC: We like to build up a sense of plausible deniability in our work. As far as anyone knows Black Mous was never in Al Mazrah, right? To keep this illusion alive we need you to use weapons you find off of other as your main tools. Keeps anyone from being able to trace our whereabouts.
PMC_S2/KILLS_HITLOCS_2_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with shots to the hands.
PMC_S2/KILLS_HITLOCS_2_SHIELD_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 riot shield wielding enemies with shots to the torso.
PMC_S2/KILLS_IN_HELI_DETAIL_DESC: Alright there? You might have experience shooting operators in a helicopter from your previous operation, but a sharpshooter can take aim while in motion against any target thrown at em. Correct me if I'm wrong but you consider yourself to be a sharpshooter? Well then you best show us.
PMC_S2/KILLS_IN_HELI_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a helicopter in one deployment.
PMC_S2/KILLS_IN_HELI_SHIELDS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 riots shield enemies from a helicopter.
PMC_S2/KILLS_LACHMANN_PLATFORM_DETAIL_DE: Our work in the UK and Europe broadly has us utilize the Lachmann platform. An incredibly reliable weapon system though it takes some getting used to. Use the Lachmann weapon system and engage targets at close-range and a distance. After your training we could lend you some of our gear in exchange.
PMC_S2/KILLS_LACHMANN_PLATFORM_ENEMIES_D: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a range of under 5 meters with the Lachmann weapons platform.
PMC_S2/KILLS_LACHMANN_PLATFORM_RANGED_DE: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators from a range of over ^.50^7 meters with the Lachmann platform.
PMC_S2/KILLS_LACHMANN_PLATFORM_SUPPRESSE: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed Lachmann platform weapon.
PMC_S2/KILLS_MIKE4_PLATFORM_DETAIL_DESC: Americans love their M4s don't they. Well you'll be working with (or against) quite a few of them in the field so you best get used to their weapons. Use an M4 weapon system to hit targets at a distance. The more effective our range is, the more lethal we are as a team. Personally I can't stand their gear but it's a useful skill to have trained anyhow.
PMC_S2/KILLS_MIKE4_PLATFORM_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operator with the M4 platform.
PMC_S2/KILLS_MIKE4_PLATFORM_RANGED_DESC: Kill  ^.&&1^7 enemies from a range of over ^.75^7 meters with M4 platform of weapons.
PMC_S2/KILLS_MULTI_POI_CAVES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Sattiq Cave Complex in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/KILLS_MULTI_POI_DETAIL_DESC: There's Al-Qatala and Shadow Company forces stationed along the oil pipeline from Rohan Oil's oilfields down to their containers at the port. We'd like to secure a piece of the pie and damage their structure in the process. Take out targets along the pipeline.
PMC_S2/KILLS_MULTI_POI_OILFIELD_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Rohan Oil in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/KILLS_TWO_TRAINS_CARGO_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the cargo train.
PMC_S2/KILLS_TWO_TRAINS_DETAIL_DESC: Our operatives gained access to tracking systems on board the cargo trains. White Lotus planted them to hunt for Legion, but we're seeing additional activity. Scout the area and kill anyone you find while on board.
PMC_S2/KILLS_TWO_TRAINS_PASSENGER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the passenger train.
PMC_S2/KILLS_UNIQUE_WEAPON_CLASS_DESC: Kill an enemy with ^.&&1^7 different weapon classes in one deployment.
PMC_S2/KILLS_UNIQUE_WEAPON_CLASS_DETAIL_: Morning to you. Thanks again for retrieving that manifest for us. While we look into it, it's a good time for you to get some training in working with different weapon systems. I know you've done your basic training but training at base and real combat are quite different wouldn't you say. We need a flexible operator who knows how to handle themselves in any situation.
PMC_S2/KILLS_VEHICLE_EXPLOSION_DETAIL_DE: We're looking to test the capabilities of various vehicles in Al Mazrah. Specifically we need you to use their fuel reserves to eliminate targets. How you might ask? Great question. Plant C4 onto a vehicle. Drive it towards some baddies. And kaboom. You seeing the picture? Alright then, have at it.
PMC_S2/KILLS_VEHICLE_EXPLOSION_HELI_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the explosion from C4 detonated helicopter.
PMC_S2/KILLS_VEHICLE_EXPLOSION_VEHICLE_D: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the explosion from a C4 detonated vehicle.
PMC_S2/KONNI_DEAL_NOTE_DESC:
Good regards,

I hope this becomes the beginning of a long and mutually beneficial relationship. I understand your group is in need of funds. As it happens I am in need of labour. The kind your group is known for. I will speak of the details in person, but I assume you already know of the type of work involved with our group. I am currently stationed near Al Mazrah. Meet me.

K
PMC_S2/KONNI_INTEL_DESC: Pages full of photographs, documents, transcriptions, and letters involving a Russian group named Konni. There are many horrific tragedies attibuted to the largely unknown organization. While there's no substantial evidence linking any real events to Konni, there are many doubtful ties with events across the globe and through every imaginable form of warfare. There is no known form of how or where they operate. There's no information on any current or former operatives. All that is truly known is their existence.
PMC_S2/KONNI_LAPTOP_DESC: A normal looking laptop. It looks brand new.
PMC_S2/LARGE_CASH_VALUABLES_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract with a single backpack carrying ^.$200,000^7 in cash and valuables.
PMC_S2/LARGE_CASH_VALUABLES_EXTRACT_DETA: We need funds to secure additional surveillance and reconnaissance systems for future operations. We need it fast and without the costs of too many exfiltrations. Secure a haul worth at least 200k for us in one go.
PMC_S2/LEGION_DEAL_INTEL_DESC:
We've negotiated with them for a better price for the Kastovs, but I'm getting worried about their interest in the drugs and the oil. They seem like they know too much about our trade and I suspect they are keeping their hands close. None the matter, they offer what we need so the deal is beneficial. I just ask for you to stay on guard around them.

- Your Commander
PMC_S2/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: The Zaya Observatory holds the high ground over Al Mazrah, making it a strategic target in the area. Recently, AQ has engaged Legion and Black Mous operators at this location, which gives us the initiative. You're cleared hot on all AQ forces and enemy operators. Equip an LMG, set up at the observatory, and thin the herd. Fire at range and with precision to best conceal your position.
PMC_S2/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a 556 Icarus with a VLK Koloss Flash Hider, a FTac SB, a Vortex-90, and a Corio Precio Factory attached in Zaya Observatory at 150+ meters.
PMC_S2/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_HEADSHOTS_DES: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with headshots with a 556 Icarus with a Vortex-90, a FTac SB, and a Bipod v9 Grip attached.
PMC_S2/LMG_ATTACHMENT_KILL_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a 556 Icarus with a Bipod v9 Grip, a VLK Koloss Flash Hider, and a Corio Precio Factory attached at 100+ meters.
PMC_S2/LMG_KILLS_ARMOR_ARMORED_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 armored enemies with an HCR 56.
PMC_S2/LMG_KILLS_ARMOR_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Sharim Pass is a major position for Al-Qatala to have overwatch onto the railway, the river, and the airport. An informant was taken hostage by AQ. We are undergoing a night operation for our team to infil through the river, secure the target, and bring them to the airport where our bird will get them out. Your job is to weaken the forces at Al-Sharim Pass before that operation can commence.
PMC_S2/LMG_KILLS_ARMOR_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with an HCR 56 at Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC_S2/LOCKED_STRONGHOLD_KILLS_DETAIL_DE: Al-Qatala is getting too comfortable within their strongholds for our liking. We'd like to put some pressure on them and force a mistake from their command. Show them their locks and blockades won't keep them safe. They'll be forced to begin moving critical targets out of their strongholds and that's when we strike.
PMC_S2/LOCKED_STRONGHOLD_KILLS_PING_DESC: Snapshot ^.&&1^7 enemies in locked Strongholds using a Snapshot Grenade.
PMC_S2/LOOT_CACHE_EXFIL_ITEM_DETAIL_DESC: Our recon teams reported AQ storing supplies in multiple caches in the area. We need access to these caches to learn what intel and equipment they're supplying fighters with. Your objective is to locate the caches and secure their contents.
PMC_S2/LOOT_CASH_EXFIL_CACHE_DESC: Sell a valuable item at a buy station.
PMC_S2/LOOT_CASH_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Learn how the economy works in denied areas. Exchanging items for the right gear and equipment could save your life.
PMC_S2/LOOT_CASH_EXFIL_LOOT_DESC: Buy an item at a buy station.
PMC_S2/LOOT_EXTRACT_DOG_TAGS_DETAIL_DESC: Another group is moving against us. We believe Black Mous may be involved. Go to Rohan Oil and search for intel on them. Secure dog tags of any operators that get in your way and we'll find any intel we can on who is working for them.
PMC_S2/LOOT_EXTRACT_DOG_TAGS_EXTRACT_DES: Loot and extract ^.&&1^7 enemy Dog Tags.
PMC_S2/LOOT_EXTRACT_DOG_TAGS_INTEL_DESC: Loot and extract ^.&&1^7 pieces of Black Mous Intel from Rohan Oil.
PMC_S2/LOOT_PC_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you acquired on White Lotus revealed key operators in their employment. We're setting up computer systems to store and organize the data we continue to track on the White Lotus and its operations. Locate and secure good data storage from PCs.
PMC_S2/LOOT_SELL_LIQUOR_DETAIL_DESC: A friend of Black Mous has an appreciation for the finer things in life. Specifically he's asking for Al Mazrah wine. Usually he's picky but times are tough and he'll pay well for any bottles you might find.
PMC_S2/LOOT_SUPPLY_DROPS_DESC: Open ^.&&1^7 airplane supply drops in one deployment.
PMC_S2/LOOT_SUPPLY_DROPS_DETAIL_DESC: Cargo shipments flying over the AO are carrying good gear for Al-Qatala. Secure it quickly before any hostile operators can. We'll learn what resupplies are being requested and exactly what weaknesses we can exploit for future operations.
PMC_S2/MALL_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is using the Sa'id mall as a en-route resupply location when smuggling narcotics to and from the port. Weaken their hold on it so we can land rotor-wing aircraft onto the parking garage for an upcoming operation. Secure the mall and keep it clear of any hostile forces.
PMC_S2/MALL_KILLS_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Sa'id City Shopping Centre without being downed.
PMC_S2/MALL_KILLS_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators in the Sa'id City Shopping Centre.
PMC_S2/MALL_PLACE_BOMB_DESC: Place ^.&&1^7 C4 in the same location.
PMC_S2/MALL_PLACE_DETAIL_DESC: One of our assault teams will hit an AQ stronghold tonight. Your objective is to stash additional gear at the Sa'id mall, so it's ready for them when the attack kicks off. There's a little back area in the Enfer store. Stash the items there and get out undetected. Good hunting.
PMC_S2/MALL_PLACE_DRILL_DESC: Place an electric drill in the same location.
PMC_S2/MALL_PLACE_OIL_DESC: Place ^.&&1^7 bottle of gun oil in the back of the Enfer store at the Sa'id Shopping Centre.
PMC_S2/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_BIOLAB: Extract the weapon case from Building 21 without dying.
PMC_S2/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_DETAIL: Hello again. We have word of multiple weapon cases being transported through the AO and we'd like to know their contents. Bring a few back to us and we'll see about your payment.
PMC_S2/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_SABA_D: Extract the weapon case from Al Mazrah without dying.
PMC_S2/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_SEALIO: Extract the weapon case from Ashika Island without dying.
PMC_S2/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_BATTERY_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Car Batteries to the dumpster dead drop north of Al Malik International.
PMC_S2/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_CABLE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Jumper Cables to the dumpster dead drop at the Mawizeh Marsh gas station.
PMC_S2/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_DETAIL_DESC: One of our convoy trucks hit an IED. It's gone but the other vehicles in proximity are still repairable. We're running short on a few components. Deliver them to the gas station off the bridge in the marshlands. The batteries will be harder to smuggle out of the AO. Take those to the dumpster at the junkyard in that village north of the airport.
PMC_S2/MECHANICS_DEADDROP_TORCH_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Blow Torches to the dumpster dead drop at the Mawizeh Marsh gas station.
PMC_S2/MEDICAL_DOCS_STORY_DESC: Extract all ^.&&1^7 medical documents from the Al Mazrah hospitals in one deployment.
PMC_S2/MEDICAL_DOCS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We spotted Shadow Company PMCs entering multiple hospitals in the area. Radio traffic we intercepted suggests they're looking for records of radiation exposure. They likely have knowledge on what The Chemist is storing there. Whatever they want, we want it first. Check the hospitals in Al Mazrah City, Sawah Village, and the one west of the oilfields. That's where we've seen the Chemist move to. If there's any documents to be found it's likely to be found there.
PMC_S2/MEDICAL_INTEL_DESC: Documents containing studies and reports of various radiation poisoning cases. Arabic notes are scribbled across many of the pages. Some pages are from studies from the DRC. Some pages are clearly poor translations. Many are of attempts to block or even cure the effects of high-exposure radiation poisoning.
PMC_S2/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for intel regarding a recent AQ attack on one of our FOBs. We need you to take one of their helicopters to the secure helipad near the port. Once you touch down, download and extract the flight path data.
PMC_S2/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Download the Light Helo's flight path data.
PMC_S2/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the Light Helo's flight path data.
PMC_S2/MEDIUM_BIRD_STORY_LAND_DESC: Land a Light Helo at the Hafid Port helipad.
PMC_S2/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: We've been sustaining heavy casualties from RPGs as Al-Qatala insurgents have begun to mobilize northwest of Al Mazrah into the mountains. We need material for critical medical care. There's a dumpster dead drop we setup outside the south gas station in Zarqwa Hydroelectric. Deposit low value material there and bring more sensitive medical equipment back on your person.
PMC_S2/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_LIQUOR_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 AFAKs or large medical bags to the same dead drop.
PMC_S2/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_STIMS_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 revive pistols to the dumpster dead drop in Zarqwa Hydroelectric
PMC_S2/MODERN_CITY_SNIPE_DETAIL_DESC: We have a non-combatant that we need to transport into Al Mazrah City and back out. Currently AQ forces have mobilized within the city. We need a sniper team to clear the city without letting the opposition know our plans.
PMC_S2/MODERN_CITY_SNIPE_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Al Mazrah City by headshot with a sniper rifle.
PMC_S2/MODERN_CITY_SNIPE_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators in Al Mazrah City with a sniper rifle.
PMC_S2/MOVING_VEHICLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: We're planning future missions on Ashika Island and we're concerned about Shadow Company interference. Eliminate a few of them with a drive-by. Hopefully that'll keep them indoors for a while.
PMC_S2/MOVING_VEHICLE_KILL_LEAN_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while leaning out of a moving vehicle at Town Center.
PMC_S2/MOVING_VEHICLE_KILL_ROOF_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the roof of a moving vehicle at Beach Club or Power Plant.
PMC_S2/MULTI_STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_DETAIL_DES: AQ is holding defensive positions in multiple strongholds in the area. We need to cripple their infrastructure. Locate and secure these strongholds. We need you to hit up a few of them in succession to really put a dent in their supply chain.
PMC_S2/MULTIPLE_CONTRACT_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL: Our work with the civilians has cost us. We're getting stretched for funds and we need to recuperate in as short a time as possible. You're tasked with completing contract work without wasting too much time or resources.
PMC_S2/NO_RUSHING_STORY_DESTROY_DESC: Shoot down ^.&&1^7 reinforcement choppers at Al Malik Terminal with a SAKIN MG38 with a 150-Round Box Magazine and a Soshki bipod.
PMC_S2/NO_RUSHING_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're going after AQ's narcotics network, directly. The target is Al Malik Airport, that's a hot spot where aircraft have been traced to smuggling operations. Secure a high-capacity, high-caliber weapon for this job. Your primary objective is to eliminate personnel and enemy helos on site.
PMC_S2/NO_RUSHING_STORY_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at Al Malik Terminal with a SAKIN MG38 with a 150-Round Box Magazine and a Soshki bipod.
PMC_S2/OBSERVATORY_DMR_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed designated marksman rifle with headshots in Zaya Observatory at a range of less than 3 meters.
PMC_S2/OBSERVATORY_DMR_DETAIL_DESC: There's high enemy activity near the Zaya Observatory. AQ is using the equipment to interfere with our radio signals. Take a suppressed weapon and quickly clear the observatory. Stay up close to maximize each shot's damage.
PMC_S2/OILFIELD_CAMERA_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We've noticed heavy AQ activity around Rohan Oil. Numerous transports have gone through the road leading under the railroad. Set up tactical cameras in the area so we can get Positive ID on who's working with them.
PMC_S2/OILFIELD_CAMERA_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Setup a Tactical Camera pointing at the underpass in Rohan Oil.
PMC_S2/OILFIELD_CAMERA_STORY_SNAPSHOT_DE: Snapshot ^.&&1^7 enemies in Rohan Oil with a Tactical Camera.
PMC_S2/ONE_MATCH_EXTRACT_KILLSTREAKS_DES: Exfil with ^.&&1^7 killstreaks in one deployment.
PMC_S2/ONE_MATCH_EXTRACT_KILLSTREAKS_DET: That intel you brought back revealed a critical target in AQ's operations. We will need air support for a new operation to hit AQ where it hurts. Secure killstreaks and get to extraction.
PMC_S2/ONE_MATCH_SAFES_EXTRACT_CASH_DETA: A source claims AQ is stashing funds in safes around Al Mazrah. They've been making large transactions with Las Almas. You need to put a dent in their operation. Locate their safes in the area and extract with the funds.
PMC_S2/ONE_MATCH_SAFES_EXTRACT_CASH_EXTR: Extract ^.100k^7 on a single teammate in one deployment.
PMC_S2/PARK_BOAT_PLANT_DETAIL_DESC: ISR located enemies grouping in Sa'id City. They're staging for a raid on the DRC. While this happens we'd like to send in a scouting team at night. Prep a boat and gas for them to exfil early in the morning. Stash it on the south side of Sa'id City near the walled shore.
PMC_S2/PARK_BOAT_PLANT_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Sa'id City in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/PARK_BOAT_PLANT_PARK_DESC: Park an RHIB along the walled shore across the river south of Sa'id City.
PMC_S2/PARK_BOAT_PLANT_PLANT_DESC: Place a gas can in the Sattiq Caves dead drop in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/PICKUP_RADIO_KILL_ENEMIES_DETAIL_: Working with us means you should know how to exploit enemy radio communications. Use radios dropped from Al-Qatala fighters to eliminate additional targets in the area.
PMC_S2/PICKUP_RADIO_KILL_ENEMIES_PICKUP_: Pickup ^.&&1^7 radios dropped by neutralized AQ members.
PMC_S2/PING_KILL_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: For a simple combat test we need to know you can communicate and kill with efficiency. Track down threats and eliminate them. Show the locals we're on their side, and remind our enemies they are still being hunted.
PMC_S2/PING_KILL_LOOT_LOOT_DESC: Pick up ^.&&1^7 weapon in a deployment.
PMC_S2/PING_PHONE_DESC: Use your Tac-Map with [{togglemap,togglescores}] and ping a contract phone.
PMC_S2/PING_PHONE_START_CONTRACT_DETAIL_: Al-Qatala is using burner phones to coordinate attacks against us. Intel was able to track ones that are still active, but we need to secure them fast. Locate a phone and download its contents. Once decrypted, we can use the data to take on contracts for a payout.
PMC_S2/PIRACY_STORY_BOARD_DESC: Board the cargo ship at Hafid Port.
PMC_S2/PIRACY_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Remember that flight data you got for us? Well it seems like that wasn't the only time that helicopter landed at the port. Seems like AQ has some special cargo that's been coming in and out of Al Mazrah. Board the cargo ship at Hafid Port and extract the Shipping Manifest.
PMC_S2/PIRACY_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Find and take the shipping manifest.
PMC_S2/PLACE_SMUGGLING_TUNNELS_BANDAGES_: Place ^.&&1^7 bandage in the smuggling tunnels in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/PLACE_SMUGGLING_TUNNELS_DETAIL_DE: You know those smuggling tunnels? We have some civilians moving through that area looking for supplies. Stash some food and water for them in there. There's a room in there for making explosives. Stash the items in the corner of that room and slip out undetected so Al-Qatala doesn't realize our dead drop location.
PMC_S2/PLACE_SMUGGLING_TUNNELS_MRES_DESC: Place ^.&&1^7 emergency rations packet in the smuggling tunnels in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/PLACE_SMUGGLING_TUNNELS_WATER_DES: Place ^.&&1^7 water bottle in the smuggling tunnels.
PMC_S2/PLANT_CRAFTED_MEDS_DETAIL_DESC: We're short on medical supplies and need a restock for our civilian hospital up north. Locate the requested items and get them to extraction.
PMC_S2/PLANT_FAKE_DOCS_DETAIL_DESC: Our intel confirms Shadow Co is attempting to coordinate with AQ on an upcoming operation. We're going to supply the PMCs with bad intel and use it to our advantage. The documents are in a dead drop near Sa'id Mall. Take them to the castle on Ashika Island and leave them inside the Shadow HQ.
PMC_S2/PLANT_FAKE_DOCS_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the fake Al-Qatala documents from the Zaya Observatory dead drop.
PMC_S2/PLANT_FAKE_DOCS_PLACE_DESC: Stash the fake Al-Qatala documents on the central security desk in top room of the Ashika Island castle.
PMC_S2/PLANT_MICROPHONE_DETAIL_DESC: We need eyes and ears inside of Shadow Company's base on Ashika Island. We prepped a radio transmitter for you in a dead drop. Take it to the top of Tsuki Castle under their desk so we can listen in.
PMC_S2/PLANT_MICROPHONE_LOOT_DESC: Take the discrete radio transmitter from the Beach Club dead drop.
PMC_S2/PLANT_MICROPHONE_PLANT_DESC: Plant the radio transmitter under the central security desk at the top of the Tsuki Castle.
PMC_S2/PLANT_RESEARCH_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Hopefully you've seen the news of Legion being exposed for their corruption. Today is a good day to celebrate our accomplishments. Legion did a number on the water supply of Al Mazrah and we have reason to believe they've used Russian gas, poisoning the civilians. One of our fireteams captured a Shadow Company operative who let up information on the Ashika science center. He said there's documents pertaining to the science center's research on the gas. Stash that and a gas can in the smuggling tunnels. We'll get a civilian to retrieve them at night and leave via the Al Mazrah river.
PMC_S2/PLANT_RESEARCH_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the research documents from the Ashika science center.
PMC_S2/PLANT_RESEARCH_STORY_GAS_DESC: Place a gas can in the smuggling tunnels.
PMC_S2/PLANT_RESEARCH_STORY_PLACE_DESC: Place the research docs in the smuggling tunnels.
PMC_S2/PLANT_TUNNEL_CAMERA_DETAIL_DESC: Our intel shows that AQ has taken over an old tunnel complex used for smuggling goods and storing contraband. We want to know what they're using it for. The tunnels are located in a small village community in between the hydroelectric dam and Al Mazrah City. Find a way in and gather all intel available.
PMC_S2/PLANT_TUNNEL_CAMERA_PLACE_DESC: Place tactical cameras watching ^.&&1^7 of the entrances in one deployment.
PMC_S2/PLANT_USB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: There are three computers we need access to in Al Mazrah. First is at the air traffic control tower at Al-Malik International. Second is the computer in the corner on the first floor of the northern telescope in Zaya Observatory. Third is at the corner desk in the offices of the TV station in Al Mazrah City. We placed thumb drives with special software at the dead drop in the city near the Sarwana Hotel. Secure the thumb drives and plug them into those computers. We'll handle it from there.
PMC_S2/PLANT_USB_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Take the ^.&&1^7 hacked thumb drives from the dumpster dead drop near the Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC_S2/PLANT_USB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: In one deployment, plant hacked thumb drives in computers at: the air traffic control tower, the north Observatory telescope, and the Al Mazrah City TV Station.
PMC_S2/PMC_INSTRUCTIONS_DESC:
We killed the hired courier to deliver this confidential message. Our leaders are interested in working for the Konni Group, but I know what happens to those poor bastards. We're gonna give them what they want. First step is to masquerade as Konni. My squadron tracked a civilian taking a laptop from a dead drop, delivering it to the Ashika Island Hotel. We found him dead a day later and I have no doubt as to who's handiwork it was. 

Locate Konni Laptop and dead drop it here.
Dead drop a Building 21 keycard here as well.

-Your trusted legionary
PMC_S2/PMC_UAV_TOWER_ACTIVATE_DETAIL_DES: Al-Qatala has deployed UAV towers at many points of interest around the DMZ. These towers provide critical intel on the surrounding areas. Activate them and route the signal to base so we can gain an informational advantage.
PMC_S2/POI_VEHICLE_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: AQ has learned about the DRC and wants to join the gold rush. We can't allow them to interfere. Target their transportation so we can contain the threat.
PMC_S2/POI_VEHICLE_KILLS_TECHOS_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 armored AQ patrol trucks near the oasis west of Taraq.
PMC_S2/POLITICIANS_LETTER_DESC:
Hello,
I now write to you since I know you have a way of getting things done. And I have a problem where I need things done. Suffice to say Al-Qatala has not been receptive of my proposal and they have broken our agreement to sell to the cartels. 
Here's the deal. Take the pipeline back. That mean's the oilfields, the caves, and the port. SC gets 15%.
PMC_S2/RADIATION_BOMB_STORY_CRAFT_DESC: Craft a radioactive charge with a nuclear fuel rod, a C4 and electrical components at any dead drop in Al Mazrah or Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/RADIATION_BOMB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Remnants of Legion are using the gas to hide their movement and deter counterattacks. All they've done is underestimate our capabilities. Construct a charge from the materials we've left for you. Plant it in the radiation zone and confirm detonation.
PMC_S2/RADIATION_BOMB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant the charge in the radiation.
PMC_S2/RADIATION_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: Intel confirms AQ is operating in the radiated zones to mask their movements. We need a stockpile of protective gear for our operators to perform covert missions into irradiated areas undetected and unharmed. Gas masks should be dead dropped. Radiation blockers should be extracted.
PMC_S2/RADIATION_EXTRACT_GASMASK_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gas Masks to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/RADIO_UPLOADS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Good to see you in one piece. Hopefully you're a bit more comfortable working in Al Mazrah and Ashika Island. We tracked the cargo that AQ was transporting northwest of Al Mazrah. They eventually unloaded it onto trucks and continued moving west arriving at a large port where we suspect the trade will occur. We're going to leak the intel we have of Legion's plan. We'll supply a hard drive and you just need to take the Legion deal intel to some upload stations. Once it's out that Legion was planning to trade with a well known insurgent organization, assume hell will break loose for Legion's C suite.
PMC_S2/RADIO_UPLOADS_STORY_SABA_DESC: Upload Legion deal intel at the Zaya Observatory radio tower in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S2/RADIO_UPLOADS_STORY_SEALION1_DESC: Upload Legion deal intel at the Oganikku radio tower in Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/RADIO_UPLOADS_STORY_SEALION2_DESC: Upload Legion deal intel at the Residential radio tower in Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/RECON_TAG_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Intel shows that Las Almas is connected to that cargo ship docked at the port. We need you to recon the area with a remote drone, get positive ID on any enemy personnel, and eliminate them.
PMC_S2/RECON_TAG_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at Hafid Port with a suppressed weapon.
PMC_S2/RECON_TAG_KILL_TAG_DESC: Tag ^.&&1^7 enemies with a recon drone at Hafid Port.
PMC_S2/REFUEL_VEHICLE_DETAIL_DESC: Find a vehicle and get familiar with navigating the terrain. Commit entry and exit routes to memory. Just remember to keep a full tank.
PMC_S2/REFUEL_VEHICLE_PING_DESC: Ping a vehicle on the Tac-Map.
PMC_S2/REFUEL_VEHICLE_REFUEL_DESC: Fully refuel and repair a vehicle at a gas station.
PMC_S2/REFUEL_VEHICLE_USE_DESC: Find and then use a gas can from your backpack while in a vehicle to refuel it.
PMC_S2/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DESC: Hold [{+ping_wheel,+ping,+actionslot 1}] to request to join with ^.&&1^7 nearby enemy operators.
PMC_S2/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DETAIL_DESC: We need soldiers that aren't hot heads. Defusing hostile engagements, and cooperating with other teams will prove beneficial for both you and our faction. We want you to try joining together with other teams. A bigger team means more firepower for us.
PMC_S2/RESEARCH_INTEL_DESC: Research discussing the studies of and various treatments to Russian gas poisoning. There was a large surge in locals reporting similar symptoms: feeling burning in the lungs and extreme fatigue. It was concluded that the gas acts on the pulmonary capillaries and eventually restricts blood oxidation anywhere from mild to lethal levels. Patients were reported to not recover from exposure for multiple years. In the most extreme cases, civilians experience hypoxia-induced brain damage.
PMC_S2/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_DETAIL_DE: The revolver is a weapon of a true marksman. Al Mazrah policemen were known to use them as sidearms before AQ took over. Prove to us you know your fundamentals with precision fire on any enemy combatants.
PMC_S2/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with headshots using a Basilisk.
PMC_S2/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_LOOT_DESC: Acquire a Basilisk, commonly found in police stations.
PMC_S2/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is setting up convoys and patrols along major roadways. We need to impart some psychological warfare to clear the roads for our cargo routes. Use a vehicle to neutralize hostile forces and make it look like it took no damage.
PMC_S2/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_REPAIR_DESC: Fully refuel and repair a vehicle at a gas station.
PMC_S2/RUN_OVER_REPAIR_RUN_DESC: Run over ^.&&1^7 enemies with a vehicle.
PMC_S2/SABA_SHIPPING_INTEL_DESC: Documents logging the ingoing and outgoing cargo shipments of Al Mazrah. There's a series of documents recording shipments from over 10 years ago, and then a series of documents from the past 5 years. In many shipments to and from Mexico and Russia, the total recorded cargo is light for the size of the ship being used. A series of Russian ships from 14 years ago are recorded to have sunken without definite cause.
PMC_S2/SAM_SHOOT_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is using surface-to-air missiles to protect their resupply shipments. Denying AQ these shipments will aid us in our upcoming operation. Your objective is reroute a SAM site to signals intel. We'll target incoming enemy aircraft while you move to secure equipment from the wreckage.
PMC_S2/SAM_SHOOT_LOOT_SHOOT_DESC: Wait for your captured SAM Site to shoot down an airplane.
PMC_S2/SEALION_BREAKER_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: In the underground waterways of Ashika Island, Shadow Company is guarding a cache which our intel says contains a hard drive we need access to. Reroute the electrical breakers along the waterways to unlock the cache and extract the hard drive. We'll need it for a future operation.
PMC_S2/SEALION_BREAKER_STORY_EXTRACT_DES: Extract the hard drive from the marked cache.
PMC_S2/SEALION_BREAKER_STORY_LOCATE_DESC: Enter the Ashika Island Waterways tunnel.
PMC_S2/SEALION_BREAKER_STORY_REROUTE_DES: Reroute at least ^.&&1^7 electrical breakers in the Waterways within ^.180^7 seconds.
PMC_S2/SEALION_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A hard drive containing a record of various security systems of the Ashika Island infrastructure for the power plant, the water treatment facility, and the science center.
PMC_S2/SEALION_INTEL_DESC: Information regarding the general geography and history of Ashika Island. A large amount of the documents are focused on the science center and many printed articles about the lab directors and their funding. There's old news stories of a mysterious disease spreading amongst the population of the island.
PMC_S2/SEALION_INTEL_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: A source contacted us with critical information on enemy factions. They've stashed three intel drops in Ashika Island and we need to get them extracted fast.
PMC_S2/SEALION_INTEL_STORY_INTEL1_DESC: Find and extract the Shadow Company USB stick from the Ashika Island Beach Club observatory deck.
PMC_S2/SEALION_INTEL_STORY_INTEL2_DESC: Find and extract the Ashika Island intel from the underground Waterway.
PMC_S2/SEALION_INTEL_STORY_INTEL3_DESC: Find and extract the Crown intel from the Ashika power plant.
PMC_S2/SELL_UNIQUE_ITEMS_DESC: Sell ^.&&1^7 unique valuables in one deployment
PMC_S2/SELL_UNIQUE_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: A great operator knows how to turn a profit. Get items to a buy station and cash them in for us. Show us that you're a great operator.
PMC_S2/SEPT_VEHICLE_KILL_DESC: Destroy ^.7^7 vehicles in close succession ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC_S2/SEPT_VEHICLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: A future operation requires that we limit AQ's transportation options. You're tasked with destroying any vehicles in the AO immediately. Hit multiple vehicles in quick succession to minimize any noise that AQ might investigate.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_COMPANY_INTEL_DESC: Documents regarding the financial records of Shadow Company and their many front companies in different countries. A large part of the documents record the various agents working for Shadow Company though all personal information has been redacted. It is clear that Shadow Company has been operating at a deficit for around a year taking on multiple liabilities and debts.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_COMPANY_USB_DESC: A thumb drive holding data from a Shadow Company agent.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_DEAL_INTEL_DESC: Here's the updated deal. All of Al Mazrah for 25% of the value of the oil. Accounting for say, 2.500 shadows, that's brings us to still hundreds of thousands of dollars per day in operational profits. Of course that will take time so we negotiated a deal. We receive an initial payment of $500,000 for the funding of our new base outside Al Mazrah. Then we work on just the core locations for the pipeline for only 5% with another 5% for paying off that initial payment. After the rest is under control then it goes from 15% increasing with interest until 25% after 3 years.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A hard drive containing data and programs for various database and security operations for a forward operating base.
PMC_S2/SHADOW_LETTER_DESC: Hey Charlie, I'm just gonna handwrite this old school style cause we both know how the superiors would react.
