We're indeed taking a plane to the FOB and we're gonna want the LZ to be cleared ahead of time. You just secure the area so we can land safely. The last thing I want is a firefight with AQ around a bunch of fuel-filled birds.
PMC_S2/SHOTGUN_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: I'm sure you're already familiar, but Shadow Company's occupation of Ashika Island poses a threat to our pacific FOB. A few Shadow patrols have been spotted near our base. We'd like to clear some of them out. and keep them out of the waters. Don't lead them back to us. Take an unconventional weapon and fire from a distance to conceal your allegiance. Good luck and good hunting.
PMC_S2/SHOTGUN_KILLS_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Ashika Island with a Lockwood 300 with 12 gauge slugs, a Matuzek 812 barrel, a Bryson Series XII choke, and a Schlager 3.4x optic at a range of over 12 meters.
PMC_S2/SHOTGUN_KILLS_MELEE_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with headshots at a range of over 12 meters with the same shotgun.
PMC_S2/SHOTGUN_KILLS_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators at a range of over 12 meters.
PMC_S2/SIGNAL_EXFILS_FINAL_DETAIL_DESC: The enemy uses exfil helos as a way to ambush operators. Call for exfil at each point, but do not board. Scan for threats and eliminate any you find. Get to the final LZ when you're done.
PMC_S2/SIGNAL_EXFILS_FINAL_EXFIL_DESC: Extract on the final exfil in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/SIGNAL_EXFILS_FINAL_SIGNAL_DESC: Signal all ^.&&1^7 exfils in Al Mazrah in one deployment.
PMC_S2/SINGLE_UAV_TOWER_KILLS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in one UAV tower activation.
PMC_S2/SINGLE_UAV_TOWER_KILLS_DETAIL_DES: Some of our recon towers have been compromised. We need them back online and the area cleared of all threats.
PMC_S2/SOLO_INFIL_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Show us you can handle yourself. Infil to the AO and get to extraction - all on your own.
PMC_S2/SPEND_MULTI_BUYSTATIONS_DESC: Spend ^.$6000^7 at ^.&&1^7 different buy stations in one deployment.
PMC_S2/START_CONTRACT_DESC: Find a contract phone and download the intel.
PMC_S2/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_CLEAR_D: Clear ^.3^7 strongholds each in under ^.20^7 seconds after unlocking the stronghold.
PMC_S2/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_: Aggressive attack will catch Al-Qatala off guard. Locate strongholds and sweep them fast. Show AQ the speed of violence.
PMC_S2/SUNKEN_SHIP_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We've located sunken ships off the coasts of Al Mazrah and Ashika Island. These ships were sabotaged and we need to find out how. Locate the ships and bring back any items you find. We believe there should be some drug bricks being transported by the cartel on board. Don't worry about the eastern-most ship in the Al Mazrah waters. We already know about that one.
PMC_S2/SUNKEN_SHIP_STORY_SABA_DESC: Extract the ^.&&1^7 contraband packages from the sunken ships in Al Mazrah in one deployment.
PMC_S2/SUNKEN_SHIP_STORY_SEALION_DESC: Extract the ^.&&1^7 contraband packages from the sunken ships in Ashika Island in one deployment.
PMC_S2/SUPPRESSED_ELIM_DETAIL_DESC: Some cartel members are working in Al Mazrah. Eliminate the targets. We pride ourselves on anonymity. Be unseen and unheard.
PMC_S2/SUPPRESSED_ELIM_ELIM_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 Eliminate HVT contract targets using suppressed weapons.
PMC_S2/SUPPRESSED_MELEE_KILLS_DETAIL_DES: We need to engage AQ forces without alerting them to what they're fighting against. Maintain silence and the element of surprise. They more unknown loses they take, the more they'll be pressured to mobilize their units away from our targets.
PMC_S2/SUPPRESSED_MELEE_KILLS_SMG_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed Fennec 45 with a Fennec Double Tap Mod attached.
PMC_S2/SWIMMING_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: We're seeing increased activity on the shores of Al Mazrah and Ashika Island. Our enemies cannot gain a foothold, or our resupplies are at risk. Use the water for concealment and eliminate targets.
PMC_S2/SWIMMING_KILLS_SABA_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while underwater in Al Mazrah
PMC_S2/SWIMMING_KILLS_SEALION_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while swimming in Ashika Island.
PMC_S2/SWIMMING_PLAYER_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Use the water to move within effective range of enemies. You're cleared hot on all targets.
PMC_S2/SWIMMING_PLAYER_KILLS_SURFACE_DES: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from the surface of the water with a TAQ-M with 6.5mm high velocity rounds, a Luca Bandera scope, and a LR1:7 20.5" barrel.
PMC_S2/SWIMMING_PLAYER_KILLS_UNDERWATER_: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators from the surface of the water.
PMC_S2/SYNC_SAMSITE_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala SAM sites in the area are limiting our aerial options. Secure enough at the same time for our resupply aircraft to land at our FOB.
PMC_S2/SYNC_UAV_CONTROL_DESC: Have ^.5^7 UAV towers active at the same time.
PMC_S2/SYNC_UAV_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking to do some covert investigations. Al-Qatala is using UAV towers for overwatch in the AO. Secure multiple UAV towers simultaneously. We'll be waiting on your signal.
PMC_S2/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_DETAIL: Information is power in a combat zone. We need air support and drones to monitor Al Mazrah after a major operation of ours. Find and deliver some encrypted hard drives to us. With the intel you brought back from the fortress sewers, we can decrypt the data to find AQ's weaknesses.
PMC_S2/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_DRONE_: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Recon Drones to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/TECH_KILLSTREAK_EXTRACTION_UAV_DE: Extract ^.&&1^7 UAVs, advanced UAVs or counter UAVs.
PMC_S2/THERMAL_RANGED_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed MCPR-300 with a Raptor-FVM40 and a SZ 1mW PEQ laser attached at a range of over ^.200m^7.
PMC_S2/THERMAL_RANGED_SNIPER_DETAIL_DESC: We need to thin out our competition with them knowing it's us at play. Equip yourself with a suppressed sniper rifle and engage operators at 200+ meters. The other factions will blame each other for their losses while we push forward with our plans.
PMC_S2/TRACK_BIOLABS_CARGO_DETAIL_DESC: Shadow Company transported goods into and out of the DRC on cargo trucks. We stashed some trackers in Building 21. Place them underneath the trucks and get out safely.
PMC_S2/TRACK_BIOLABS_CARGO_LOOT_DESC: Take ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Building 21 dead drop.
PMC_S2/TRACK_BIOLABS_CARGO_PLANT_DESC: Plant a tracking device under each of the ^.&&1^7 cargo trucks in the parking garage.
PMC_S2/TRACK_SUBMARINES_DETAIL_DESC: There are two submarines we've taken an interest in and we'd like to be prepared in case they come into use. We believe Shadow Company may be using the ports of Hafid and Ashika to transport DRC equipment. A courier prepared two dead drops with trackers for you. One in the southeast of Al-Sharim Pass and one in the town center of Ashika Island. Get trackers on the submarines and we'll see where they lead. Good luck out there.
PMC_S2/TRACK_SUBMARINES_LOOT_DESC: Take the ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Town Center or Al Sharim Pass dead drops.
PMC_S2/TRACK_SUBMARINES_PLANT_SABA_DESC: Plant a tracker on top of the submarine in Hafid Port.
PMC_S2/TRACK_SUBMARINES_PLANT_SEALION_DE: Plant a tracker on top of the submarine in the Ashika Island Waterways.
PMC_S2/TRACK_TRAIN_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Good work getting us that intel on the Legion deal. It seems that Al-Qatala is using the Al Mazrah rail to transport their contraband. We'd like to know where they're heading, and that might give us critical intel on where the deal takes place. We setup some tracking devices in a dead drop near the Al Bagra Fortress. They're near a house to the southeast. Take the trackers and plant them on the wooden cargo containers on the cargo train.
PMC_S2/TRACK_TRAIN_STORY_LOCATE_DESC: Navigate onto the cargo train in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/TRACK_TRAIN_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Take ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the dead drop in Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC_S2/TRACK_TRAIN_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant at least ^.&&1^7 trackers on the cargo containers on the train.
PMC_S2/TRAIN_KILLS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies while on the train.
PMC_S2/TRAIN_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Learn to see the advantages of any situation. Use the train to eliminate enemies in the AO. Its sound can conceal your shots, and it acts as an escape vehicle to get you out of the area fast.
PMC_S2/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Intel located an ammo cache at the embassy in Al Mazrah City. Crown has been active in that area, so this is a priority target. We've stashed an explosive device in the tunnel near Zaya Observatory. Use the device on the ammo cache and destroy it.
PMC_S2/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_EXPLODE_DESC: Wait for the charge to detonate near the supply site.
PMC_S2/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Pickup the charge in the closed tunnel near Zaya Observatory.
PMC_S2/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Transport and drop the charge near the supply site at the U.S. Embassy in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S2/TRAP_NO_DAMAGE_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapons Stash contract without taking body damage.
PMC_S2/TRAP_NO_DAMAGE_DETAIL_DESC: We want AQ to know that we are untouchable. Secure a weapons stash unscathed and prove you have what it takes for high stakes operations. They'll be pressured into moving more guards to defend their equipment.
PMC_S2/TRAP_NO_DOWN_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala is hiding their most expensive equipment in weapon stashes they keep protected in their strongholds. A contractee has data on their positions. Take the contract and secure the equipment without taking casualties.
PMC_S2/TRAP_NO_DOWN_END_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapon Stash contract without any teammates being downed.
PMC_S2/TRAP_NO_DOWN_START_DESC: Acquire a Raid Weapon Stash contract.
PMC_S2/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We're investigating the nuclear power plant attack. Intel shows there was trace amounts of radiation on a boat docked up north in Taraq. One of our captured AQ members gave up and revealed that the drill used to break into the compound was ditched in a hidden container and that there's two other caches hiding its location. The first one was located west of Taraq in the oasis near the eastern pond. We need to secure that drill as evidence for AQ's involvement in the attack.
PMC_S2/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Locate the third Hidden Container and extract the Irradiated Drill found inside.
PMC_S2/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_FIRST_DESC: Locate and loot the first Hidden Container at the oasis west of Taraq.
PMC_S2/TREASURE_HUNT_STORY_SECOND_DESC: Locate and loot the second Hidden Container.
PMC_S2/TWO_BIRDS_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters in Al-Safwa Quarry.
PMC_S2/TWO_BIRDS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you brought back revealed AQ held their helos in the quarry before deploying them over the northwestern mountains. Your objective is now to destroy those vehicles. Make enough noise and they'll send in some birds to reinforce the area. That will be your target of opportunity to take down those reinforcements.
PMC_S2/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 unique contract types in a single deployment.
PMC_S2/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're gearing up for a major operation against AQ and need some last minute funding from our contractees. Locate and complete a variety of contracts in the AO. Our contractors want to see that we're capable of any task put in front of us.
PMC_S2/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 contracts in ^.8^7 unique POIs in one deployment.
PMC_S2/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're expanding our operations and are trying to secure resources to support ourselves. We need you to take on a high volume of contract work throughout the AO.
PMC_S2/UTILITY_DEADDROP_DETAIL_DESC:
We're setting up a new base of operations 15km northeast of Al Mazrah. This should lower our faction's transport costs in the AO. We're missing a few items and we won't be able to quickly get a supply shipment.

We set up a dumpster dead drop at the junkyard in a village north of the airport and south-east of Al-Sharim Pass. Look in the south-east Quadrant of G5 on your Tac-Map. Deliver screwdrivers, light bulbs and drills to the dumpster dead drop. We contracted some local couriers to bring the items to us as soon as possible.
PMC_S2/UTILITY_DEADDROP_DRILL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Electric Drill to the Al-Sharim junkyard dead drop.
PMC_S2/UTILITY_DEADDROP_LIGHTBULB_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Light Bulbs to the Al-Sharim junkyard dead drop.
PMC_S2/UTILITY_DEADDROP_SCREWDRIVERS: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Screwdrivers to the dumpster dead drop at the junkyard in the village south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.
PMC_S2/WATER_CAVES_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: One of our drone feeds showed AQ transporting a narcotics shipment through the Sattiq Cave Complex. They're likely in contact with Legion again. Infiltrate the caves by boat and clear the site. We know an AQ commander left some documents in a temporary shelter in the riverside caves. Bring them back for us and make it look like they were misplaced.
PMC_S2/WATER_CAVES_STORY_ENTER_DESC: Dock a boat at the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves.
PMC_S2/WATER_CAVES_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the smuggling records in the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves.
PMC_S2/WATER_CAVES_STORY_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with an armored patrol boat turret in Sattiq Caves.
PMC_S2/WATER_CAVES_STORY_SWAP_DESC: Place sensitive documents at the original location of the smuggling records in the same deployment.
PMC_S2/WINE_DELIVERY_AGED_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 aged wine bottles to any dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S2/WINE_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: You hopefully remember our friend. His supply has run dry and he's asking for a restock. He's looking for a more vintage selection this time.
PMC_S2/WINE_DELIVERY_WINE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 wine bottles at any dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S3/AQ_TRAIN_MANIFEST_DESC: A list of cargo being transported via the Urzikstan railway by Al-Qatala. It claims to contain industrial mechanical parts, explosive chemicals, poppy seeds, and fertilizer. It seems to be front for illegal contraband smuggling where the northern railways allow AQ to distribute weapons and drugs to Europe and South Asia.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_EXTRAC: Clear ^.&&1^7 restricted zones in the Koschei Complex

As I'm sure you've noticed, AQ and the cartel have been hunkered down in some restricted sections of the bunker. Well today is the day there's no more restrictions. Your mission is to clear those areas. The soldiers in there will likely carry some evidence of what they were looking for. Bring that back for us will you?
Extract intel found on soldiers in the restricted zones.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_GEIGER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_D: One of our soldiers was investigating the bunker's barracks when his geiger counter started crackling. It seems there's something irradiating the water, and based on what we know about this bunker, it's likely some form of nuclear fuel. Your mission is to retrieve that nuclear material. Try not to stay in the water too long for us.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_GEIGER_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_: Extract the ^.&&1^7 fuel rods in one deployment.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_GEIGER_EXTRACT_INFIL_DE: Enter the Koschei Complex with a geiger counter.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_GEIGER_EXTRACT_LOOT_DES: Find the ^.&&1^7 nuclear fuel rods in the flooded barracks.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_KILL_AQ_CARTEL_AQ_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 AQ soldiers in the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_KILL_AQ_CARTEL_CARTEL_D: Kill ^.&&1^7 cartel soldiers in the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S3/BIOBUNKER_KILL_AQ_CARTEL_DETAIL_D:
With AQ and the cartel hiding in those tunnels, our recon and stealth abilities are limited. I think it's time we get some payback for Phantom 5.

Move in and eliminate those bastards till the tunnels run red.
PMC_S3/CARTEL_DOSSIER_DESC:
From S.C. Phantom 5-2:
Day 3:
We've been keeping watch of all incoming and outgoing shipments. Mostly cartel, Dutch and Russian ships. We've procured their manifests. Primarily explosives, weapons, money laundering, and narcotics.
Day 4: Al-Qatala is taking the cartel up north. Again that damned bunker keeps being talked about. We're moving in to continue reconnaissance.
PMC_S3/CARTEL_INTEL_DESC:
To: S.C. HQ
From: S.C. Phantom 5-2
Day 1:
Las Almas has just arrived at the Hafid Port from a cargo ship. They seem to be allied with AQ forces. They unloaded 20 large wooden boxes containing Kastovs. Al-Qatala handed over payment in the form of U.S dollars. 
Day 2:
Our initial drones recorded word of Russian bunkers. They were talking about an entrance to it that dug straight into the Defense Research Division. Current working theory is that it's somehow connected to the DRC, but this bunker isn't on any of our intel.
PMC_S3/CARTEL_LAPTOP_DESC: A simple, cheap laptop used by a high ranking cartel soldier.
PMC_S3/CARTEL_WAREHOUSE_KEY_DESC: ^B^?#x0eeaf2060abe5269b.#x02c145cf8c172c4af^Al Mazrah^R^7 - Key to a Cartel-Occupied Kushaak Warehouse -^B^?#x0eeaf2060abe5269b.#x02c145cf8c172c4af^ C?
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_ACTIVATE_UAV_TOWERS_D: Crown has hacked the UAV towers in the AO and they now send their data back to us. Go activate UAV towers in the combat area so that we may examine the data.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_AMMO_DETAIL_DESC: Crown finds itself short of the ammunition it needs to continue our war efforts. Deliver to us the amount of ammunition we need and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DESC: Crown requires its soldiers to be in prime fighting condition, and that means having enough equipment. We are aware that the AO is scattered with backpacks that allow operators to carry more equipment. Find their drop locations in the AO so that we may direct our soldiers there.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_BUY_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have hacked the combat area buy stations such that when operators buy items, the funds are redirected to us. Go and buy items at the buy stations before our hack is discovered.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: Our battlefield efforts require additional funding. Bring us cash and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_COMPLETE_CONTRACTS_DE: We have several tasks needing completion in the AO, so we dispersed contracts for you to complete there via radio. Go complete them and report back for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_DEAD_DROP_DETAIL_DESC: We need to obtain supplies for our field efforts. Thus we are offering a bounty for items placed in AO dead drops.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DESC: We are paying a premium for every proof of kill that you turn in. Bring us dog tags for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_EXECUTE_OPERATORS_DET: This is a reminder that in the field you must not allow your work for us to be known. The dead tell no tales, so be sure to execute enemy operators that you encounter.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAI: We are tracking weapon serial numbers to collect data on arms manufacturers. We will award you a bounty for extracting weapons from the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_GAS_MASKS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 gas masks from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_GAS_MASKS_DETAIL_DESC: We find that gas masks are an excellent way for our operators to conceal their identities. We need to know where the gas masks are in the AO. Go there and find gas masks.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_AGENTS_DETAIL_DE: We have been receiving threats from paramilitary agents in the field. They are overstepping their boundaries. Go clean a few of them up and show them where their place is.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_AGENTS_EXPLOSIVE: We are offering a reward for killing enemy agents in the field with explosive devices. Go kill enemy agents with explosives and report back to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_BOSSES_DETAIL_DE: Crown is trying to gain territory in the field, but enemy commanders are in their strongholds blocking our efforts. Go dispose of them and report back to us for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_KILL_OPERATORS_DETAIL: We are offering a bounty for killing operators in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_OPEN_CONTAINERS_DETAI: We are conducting a large-scale survey of the combat area to try to determine where technology-related loot is most likely to be found. Help us collect data by opening loot caches in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_PLATE_CARRIERS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 plate carriers from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_PLATE_CARRIERS_DETAIL: Our operatives require armor. Scour the AO for armor plate carriers so that we may know where to locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_REVIVE_TEAMMATES_DETA: Crown never leaves dead teammates on the field. Revive your downed teammates and return to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_CROWN_UNLOCK_SAFEHOUSES_DET: Crown needs intel on strongholds in the AO. Unlock strongholds and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_ACTIVATE_UAV_TOWERS_: Phalanx needs to collect intel on where enemies are in the AO so that we may engage them with lethal force. Activating UAV towers will help us obtain this data. Go activate UAV towers in the AO so that we may examine the data.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DES: Phalanx requires its soldiers to be in prime fighting condition, and that means having enough equipment. We are aware that the AO is scattered with backpacks that allow operators to carry more equipment. Find their drop locations in the AO so that we may direct our soldiers there.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: We need to raise funds for our field efforts. Return to us cash you have found in the field and we will send you compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_DEAD_DROP_DETAIL_DES: We need to obtain supplies for our field efforts. Thus we are offering a bounty for items placed in AO dead drops.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXECUTE_OPERATORS_DE: This is a reminder that in the field you must not allow your work for us to be known. The dead tell no tales, so be sure to execute enemy operators that you encounter.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXTRACT_CASE_DETAIL_: Phalanx wants to demonstrate the superiority of its operators to the world. Extract the weapons case from the AO and show the world who is the best.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXTRACT_FOOD_DETAIL_: Our soldiers are running short on food supplies. We will reward you for any food supplies delivered to us on exfil.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_EXTRACT_MEDICINE_DET: Our soldiers require medical supplies to keep them alive on the battlefield. Deliver to us any spare medical supplies you find in the field and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_KILL_AGENTS_HEADSHOT: Phalanx is offering a bounty on any enemy agents killed via headshots. Do so and report back to us for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_KILL_ARMORED_DETAIL_: We have to teach the enemy that they cannot survive, even behind their armor plates. Go destroy enemies with armor plating and show them what our bullets are made of.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_KILL_OPERATORS_DETAI: We are offering a bounty for killing operators in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_OPEN_CONTAINERS_DETA: We are conducting a large-scale survey of the AO to try to determine where weapons-related loot is most likely to be found. Help us collect data by opening loot caches in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_OPEN_SAFE_DETAIL_DES: Phalanx needs intel on what valuable items can be found in safes in the AO. Open a safe and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_PLATE_CARRIERS_DETAI: Our elite fighting force requires armor. Scour the AO for armor plate carriers so that we may know where to locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LEGION_SAM_SITE_DETAIL_DESC: We need air superiority to cover our agents in the field. Go take enemy SAM sites and make sure we control the skies.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_ACTIVATE_UAV_TOWERS_D: We are offering a bounty for UAV towers activated in the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_AMMO_DETAIL_DESC: We believe that reducing the amount of ammunition in the combat zone will reduce the amount of violence there. We will reward you for delivering rounds from the field to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_BUY_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have made a deal with the vendors in the AO that proceeds from every valuable item you buy will be donated to our humanitarian effort. Please go buy items using the AO buy stations to support our efforts.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_COMPLETE_CONTRACTS_DE: We have several tasks needing completion in the AO, so we dispersed contracts for you to complete there via radio. Go complete them and report back for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DESC: We are aware that casualties happen in the field. Please return the dog tags of any killed operators to us so that we may inform their families.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_EXTRACT_FOOD_DETAIL_D: We have identified a famine near the field AO. Please deliver food supply items to us so that we may redirect them to the affected area.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_EXTRACT_MEDICINE_DETA: We want to reduce the fatality rate in the AO. Please secure for us medical supplies so that we may deploy them to areas in need.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAI: Our efforts to reduce violence in the combat area would be improved if there were fewer weapons. Please help us by removing weapons from the AO by extract them on exfil.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_GAS_MASKS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 gas masks from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_GAS_MASKS_DETAIL_DESC: White Lotus has been seeing an increased amount of preventable chemical inhalation injuries in our operators. We want to help by identifying where our operators can find gas masks. Please help by locating gas masks in the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_AGENTS_DETAIL_DE: Enemy factions are recruiting at an alarming rate. We need to thin their numbers. White Lotus is offering a bounty on any enemy agent killed in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_ARMORED_DETAIL_D: White Lotus has detected a worrisome increase in activity of armored enemies in the field. We need to thin their numbers. White Lotus is offering a bounty on any armored enemies killed in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_BOSSES_DETAIL_DE: Enemy commanders in the field have been obstructing our attempts to provide humanitarian assistance to the region. Once they have been removed we can move in.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_KILL_OPERATORS_DETAIL: Enemy field operators employed by other factions have been obstructing our attempts to provide humanitarian assistance to the region. Kill them so that we can assist the civilians in the area.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_PLATE_CARRIERS_DESC: Collect ^.&&1^7 plate carriers from loot caches.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_PLATE_CARRIERS_DETAIL: We want to improve the survival rate of our agents in the field. Please search the AO for armor plate carriers so that we may know where to locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_REVIVE_TEAMMATES_DETA: We want all of our operatives to come back alive. Revive your teammates and we will offer you a bounty.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_SELL_VALUABLES_DETAIL: We have made a deal with the vendors in the AO that proceeds from every valuable item you sell will be donated to our humanitarian effort. Please go sell items using the AO buy stations to support our efforts.
PMC_S3/DAILY_LOTUS_UNLOCK_SAFEHOUSES_DET: One of the rival factions is attempting to falsely accuse us of nefarious deeds. We think some of their leaders are holed up in strongholds in the AO. Please raid those strongholds and disrupt their dishonest activities.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DESC: Black Mous is aware that there are various backpacks available to find in the AO. Locate these backpacks and return to us for a bounty.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_BUY_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have hacked the AO buy stations such that when operators buy items, the funds are redirected to us. Go and buy items at the buy stations before our hack is discovered.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: Our battlefield efforts require additional funding. Bring us cash and we will reward you.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_DEAD_DROP_DETAIL_DESC: We need to obtain supplies for our field efforts. Thus we are offering a bounty for items placed in AO dead drops.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_DOGTAGS_DETAIL_DESC: We are looking for intel on field operators that we can use to blackmail rival factions. Bring us dog tags of defeated enemy operators so that we can find their connections to whatever factions they are working for.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_CASE_DETAIL_DE: We have intel that intel containing dirt about the corrupt leaders of White Lotus has been hidden in the weapon case in the AO. Secure it for us to assist in our efforts to blackmail them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_FOOD_DETAIL_DE: The hypocrites in the leadership of White Lotus have been interfering with our online activities. We hear they are trying to obtain food supplies in the AO. Deny them their food supplies by delivering them to us instead.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_MEDICINE_DETAI: The hypocrites at White Lotus are trying to steal medical supplies from the AO. We want to disrupt their corrupt plans. Extract the medical supplies from the area before their operators can locate them.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAIL: We are tracking weapon serial numbers to collect data on arms manufacturers. We will award you a bounty for extracting weapons from the AO.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_AGENTS_DETAIL_DES: We have been receiving threats from paramilitary agents in the field. They are overstepping their boundaries. Go clean a few of them up and show them where their place is.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_AGENTS_EXPLOSIVES: We are offering a reward for killing enemy agents in the field with explosive devices. Go kill enemy agents with explosives and report back to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_AGENTS_HEADSHOTS_: Black Mous is offering a reward for enemy agents killed via headshots. Go do so and report back to us for compensation.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_KILL_BOSSES_DETAIL_DES: Enemy commanders are obstructing our efforts in the field. Kill them and return to us for a reward.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_OPEN_CONTAINERS_DETAIL: We are conducting a large-scale survey of the combat area to try to determine where intelligence-related loot is most likely to be found. Help us collect data by opening loot caches in the field.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_OPEN_SAFE_DETAIL_DESC: Black Mous needs intel on what valuable items can be found in safes in the AO. Open a safe and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_REVIVE_TEAMMATES_DETAI: The Black Mous Code stipulates that you should never leave a teammate injured on the field. We intend to reward operators who adhere to our code.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_SAM_SITE_DETAIL_DESC: Legion's air support is disrupting our agents in the AO. Capture SAM sites and clear the skies so our agents can move freely.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_SELL_VALUABLES_DETAIL_: We have hacked the AO buy stations such that when operators sell items, that item is redirected to us. Go and sell items at the buy stations before our hack is discovered.
PMC_S3/DAILY_MOUS_UNLOCK_SAFEHOUSES_DETA: Black Mous needs intel on strongholds in the AO. Unlock strongholds and report your findings back to us.
PMC_S3/EXFIL_WITH_FRIEND_BUY_DESC: Purchase a personal exfil at a buy station in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/EXFIL_WITH_FRIEND_DETAIL_DESC:
Hope you're well rested today. You'll need your wits about you for this. We're looking to get in contact with other operators. We need someone who can infiltrate the AO alone as to not appear threatening and who can discretely bring back another operator with them to extract.

Move to a buy station and secure a personal exfil for yourself to keep your escape discrete. Then find an operator to take it with you.
PMC_S3/EXFIL_WITH_FRIEND_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with your personal exfil with another operator in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_BIOBUNKER_WEAPON_CASES_DE: Extract ^.&&1^7 weapon cases in one deployment.
Welcome back. We're investigating what AQ is transporting in their weapons cases. We'd like to get our hands on one from Al Mazrah and one from the Koschei Complex. Can you get us those cases?
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DELIVER_BIOBUNKER_CHEMS_D: We're still overlooking that intel you brought back. Likely the DRD is related to the newer DRC. We'd like to examine the origin of some of the chemical material in the bunker. Can you get us back some sulphuric acid? They won't notice if they're missing any of that.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DELIVER_BIOBUNKER_CHEMS_E: Extract ^.&&1^7 jugs of sulphuric acid from the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DELIVER_BIOBUNKER_CHEMS_S: Dead drop a jug of sulphuric acid in Al Mazrah.
Dead drop a jug of sulphuric acid  in Ashika Island.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_DETAIL_:
We discovered a high security room with a locked in the southern most restricted zone in the alpha cluster sector. As the team entered the room they heard a sound and an alarm was trigger before they were swarmed by AQ and had to leave. In the External Ops. sector we found an upload station that contains data on a security system that referenced Building 21.

If you can access that upload station we can reset the security system which should hopefully unlock that cache. Get us that intel and we can look into how Building 21 is related to these bunkers.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_EXTRACT: Extract the Building 21 intel from the cache.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_LOOT_DE: Open the locked cache in the restricted zone in the alpha cluster.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_RESET_D: Reset the security system at the upload station in the external operations sector.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_PLACE_PLANE_ITEM_DETAIL_D:
One of our men seems to have misplaced some documents that give a better detail into the layout of those bunkers. They were doing reconnaissance on the bunker entrance in the oilfields.

Please do us a solid and get those schematics back for us. You can deliver it to Building 21.
PMC_S3/EXTRACT_PLACE_PLANE_ITEM_EXTRACT_: Find and extract the schematics from the Rohan Oil bunker entrance.
PMC_S3/FIND_OASIS_BUNKER_DESC: Discover what AQ is looking for in the oasis.
PMC_S3/FIND_OASIS_BUNKER_DETAIL_DESC: I'll make this quick, for your sake and mine. We spotted excavator tread tracks moving up towards that oasis west of Taraq. That sandstorm is helping to cover those tracks. Lucky timing I suppose. We need eyes on the ground to see what AQ is digging up. Report back what you find.
PMC_S3/FIND_PYRO_ATC_DESC: Clear the air traffic control tower at A.M International.
PMC_S3/FIND_PYRO_DETAIL_DESC: The Pyro, as he's known, is responsible for the explosives arsenal of Al Qatala. He has a number of key locations that we have tracked his position to. We need you to perform some basic recon on these key locations. Clear the targets and gather any intel you find on the Pyro.
PMC_S3/FIND_PYRO_POSTOFFICE_DESC: Clear the Al Mazrah City post office.
PMC_S3/INFIL_EXFIL_BIOBUNKER_DETAIL_DESC:
Thanks for your help out there soldier. We linked those positions you tracked to an old mining operation conducted in Al Mazrah. No doubt it's that damned bunker. The odd detail is that the operations were all signed off by Russian holding companies.

It seems the official title for the compound is the Koschei Complex. Our intel suggests there's officially some chemical treatment faciltiies down there, but we don't really know the scale of their operations. Take some NVGs and get down there. Bring us back intel on every detail you see.
PMC_S3/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_DETAIL_DESC: There's two commanders leading AQ's soldiers in the bunker. The Sniper and The Rhinoceros. They're holding up in the factory wing. See if you can't go for some poaching.
PMC_S3/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_INFIL_DESC: Enter the factory wing of the bunker.
PMC_S3/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_RUSHER_DESC: Kill The Rhinoceros in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_SNIPER_DESC: Kill The Sniper in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/KILL_TRAPPER_DROP_CROSSBOW_DELIVE: Dead drop the crossbow in any dead drop on Ashika Island.
PMC_S3/KILL_TRAPPER_DROP_CROSSBOW_DETAIL: We have a target we'd like dispatched. The Bomb Maker. You've probably heard of him. Needless to say he hasn't been cooperating with our demands and we'd like him replaced. Deliver us his crossbow to prove he's out of the picture for us will you?
PMC_S3/KILL_VEHICLES_WITH_TRAIN_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 vehicles by having the train collide with them.
PMC_S3/KILL_VEHICLES_WITH_TRAIN_DETAIL_D: Al Qatala and other enemy operators rely on vehicles to move quickly to objectives in the AO. We'd like to attack these vehicle assets discretely. Don't directly take out vehicles, that'll cause too much noise and if you're spotted they'll discover our plan. Use the train to dispatch these targets and they'll be none the wiser about what's happening to their vehicles.
PMC_S3/MODERN_CITY_SANDSTORM_SNIPER_DETA: That sandstorm moving over the city is offering AQ too much cover from our surveillance. We'd rather be safe than sorry if you understand what I'm asking of you. Just get a nice optic and dispatch any targets found within the storm. Hope you come back in one piece.
PMC_S3/MODERN_CITY_SANDSTORM_SNIPER_ENEM: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the sandstorm in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S3/MODERN_CITY_SANDSTORM_SNIPER_OPER: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators or commanders in the sandstorm in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S3/MODERN_CITY_SANDSTORM_SNIPER_UPGR: Upgrade a sniper rifle with a thermal sight.
PMC_S3/PALFA_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: An enemy that fears what you have is a weak enemy. We need to maintain that impression that we are to be feared. Use a heavy chopper to gain an advantage and fire down on critical targets.
PMC_S3/PALFA_KILLS_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 cartel or AQ soldiers with launchers from the heavy chopper.
PMC_S3/PALFA_KILLS_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operator or juggernaut from the heavy chopper.
PMC_S3/PALFA_KILLS_VEHICLES_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 vehicles from the heavy chopper.
PMC_S3/PLACE_BIOBUNKER_TAC_INSERTS_DETAI: The schematics of the tunnel complex reveal more tunnels than our drones have been able to spot. We'd like to send in more soldiers to investigate, but we're gonna need someone to help layout the path. We'll setup some flare sticks for you. Just light them near the chemical plant's egresses so that our teams can find their way from one sector to another. We'll hopefully be able to find out what else hides in these tunnels.
PMC_S3/PLACE_BIOBUNKER_TAC_INSERTS_LOOT_: Take the ^.&&1^7 flare sticks from the Ashika town center dead drop.
PMC_S3/PLACE_BIOBUNKER_TAC_INSERTS_PLACE: Light ^.&&1^7 flares sticks near the entrances into the chemical plant.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_CALLING_CARD_DETAIL_DE: There's a man we don't have much intel on: the Scavenger. He's been spotted multiple times in the AO scavenging supplies off of KIA operators. Surveillance reports he leaves some kind of note at his scavenging targets. Use them to track and eliminate the target.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_CALLING_CARD_EXTRACT_D: Find and extract ^.&&1^7 Scavenger calling cards.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_CARTEL_INVESTIGATION_D: This is highly confidential information, so we don't ask this of you lightly. One of our teams was placed in charge of reconnaissance over the Hafid Port. We lost contact with them. Satellite intel places Las Almas cartel members at the port. We need you to perform an initial sweep to eliminate any cartel targets and secure any contraband you find from them.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_CARTEL_INVESTIGATION_L: Locate the cartel in Al Mazrah.
Find and extract ^.&&1^7 large contraband packages.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_DEALMAKER_BARTER_DESC: Trade for a secure backpack at a buy station.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_DEALMAKER_COLLECT_DESC: Store an electric drill, a gas can, and a golden skull in your backpack at the same time.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_DEALMAKER_DETAIL_DESC: Failure is inevitable at some point, but our soldiers know how to minimize losses. That's where you come in. One of our American associates procured a backpack with secured containment and a signal beacon that we can use to retrieve the contents after an unsuccessful deployment. We need you to test the capabilities of his equipment. He's asking for some items in return for the backpack, so secure those objectives and bring them to a buy station. Good luck then.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_UPGRADED_ARSENAL_ATTAC: Attach a suppressor onto a weapon at a workbench near a buy station.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_UPGRADED_ARSENAL_DETAI:
Hello. I know you're probably wondering who we are and why we need your assistance, but secrecy is of our utmost importance right now. I'm sure you can understand that. We have some higher-order requests for you, but first we need to ascertain your skills. Your task is to demonstrate your mastery of stealth, precision, and efficiency.

We have two primary targets we'd like you to dispatch: the Las Almas cartel, and Al-Qatala soldiers. Any other operators you meet are fair game too. Show us that you can utilize suppressed weapons to fire from a concealed position and survive.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_UPGRADED_ARSENAL_EXTRA: Extract with ^.&&1^7 suppressed weapons in one deployment.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_UPGRADED_ARSENAL_KILL_: Kill ^.&&1^7 cartel or AQ soldiers with a suppressed weapon.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_ZERO_TOLERANCE_DETAIL_: Hopefully you remember that sniper team of ours, Phantom-5, that we lost contact with. They were supposed to have left some intel in our planned dead drop at the caves medical tents. We'd like you to secure it. We also are looking for some concrete evidence of the cartel's presence at the port. Try to figure out what they're doing with AQ. Get to it.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_ZERO_TOLERANCE_EXTRACT: Find and extract the cartel recon report from the Sattiq Caves dead drop.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_1_ZERO_TOLERANCE_PHOTOGR: Get a shot of a cartel soldier in a tactical camera.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_20_20_ACOG_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 cartel or AQ soldiers with a Kastov 762 with a VLK 4.0 Optic equipped in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_20_20_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you brought revealed the severity of the situation at hand with the cartel and AQ working together. But we still need to investigate the exact nature and purpose of their alliance. This is what we need you for. Your job is to cause enough chaos that the cartel and AQ slip up. Fire at targets from varying ranges and positions to confuse the enemy. We'll then send in ISR teams to analyze their operations.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_20_20_REFLEX_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 cartel or AQ soldiers with a Kastov 762 with a DF105 Reflex Sight equipped.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_20_20_THERMAL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 cartel or AQ soldiers with a Kastov 762 with a DrexSom Prime-90 thermal optic equipped in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_DARK_WATER_CARTEL_DESC: Find the cartel warehouse key from the eastern-most sunken ship in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_DARK_WATER_DETAIL_DESC:
We've moved a lot of assets to target cartel objectives. One of our UAVs captured a cartel officer bringing a laptop to one of their warehouses in the south of the port. He then took an RHIB to move to the airport where they were awaiting a drug transportation plane. En-route they instructed a soldier to dive down into the eastern most of the sunken ships. After a few minutes he resurfaced and we engaged the boat with 25mm gunship fire neutralizing all targets.

We were unable to find the key to their warehouse which we believe was left underwater in the sunken ship. We need you to go down to retrieve the key and gain access to their storage facility. We believe the laptop is still in there, which could help provide valuable intel.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_DARK_WATER_INTEL_DESC: Find and extract the cartel laptop from the warehouse.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_FAIR_FIGHT_KILL_DESC: Kill the Scavenger with a weapon of the same class as the one you dropped in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_FAIR_FIGHT_SCAVENGER_P: Have the Scavenger pickup the weapon from the ground in the same deployment.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_FRIENDLY_FIRE_DETAIL_D:
Well done with that dossier. It's clear the cartel is selling explosives to AQ, likely for that bunker they're after. We'd like to put a stop to this. The Pyro is one of Al Qatala's greatest assets when it comes to their explosives arsenal. We'd like to see him neutralized.

He'll have guards so you'll need to take them all out to leave no witnesses. Make it look like an explosives accident. They won't buy it but it'll give us time.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_2_HEAVY_CHOPPER_DETAIL_D:
One of our evac helos withstained a fuel leak and was abandoned in the AO. It's bingo on fuel and inoperable at this time. If AQ or the cartel gain access to the helo eyes will be directed at our organization for providing such expensive equipment for the enemy. We can't let that happen. Find fuel for the heavy chopper, refuel the bird, and pilot it out of the AO. You will have our upmost graditude for this task.

We tracked a Crown shipment of heavy chopper fuel that they distributed to various locations along the Al Mazrah railway. Intel suggests there could be remaining fuel at either the Rohan Oil train station, the Hafid Port station, the AM International hangers, in the Sattiq smuggling caves, or on the cargo train itself.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_DRY_EYES_KILL_DESC: Kill 10 operators in the sandstorm in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_DRY_EYES_UPGRADE_DESC: Upgrade a sniper rifle with a thermal sight.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_EXCAVATION_DETAIL_DESC:
Thank god you're here. We've recieved an emergency distress signal that we believe to be from our sniper team. The signal originated from the Al Mazrah Mall tower. We further triangulated the position to the balcony of the Mikhail Hong & Partners firm overlooking the city park.

We know they were tracking the cartel to the entrances to the bunker they're after. It's likely they left something to help find the bunker. We've prepped trackers at the Al Bagra dead drop. Your objective is to find the entrances to the bunker and plant trackers nearby. Good luck out there soldier.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_EXCAVATION_INTEL_DESC: Find and read the sniper team's note.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_EXCAVATION_PLANT_DESC: Plant the ^.&&1^7 trackers, one at each bunker entrance.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_EXCAVATION_READ_DESC: Take the ^.&&1^7 trackers from the Al Bagra Fortress dead drop.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_GEAR_UP_DETAIL_DESC: Welcome back. We're planning a seige on major AQ objectives in the north of Al Mazrah. Your group is known for your consistency with arming yourself with high-efficiency, tactical equipment, isn't that right? Well we'd like some operators from your group to assist, so can you gear up enough operators for the seige? I'm asking for at least 3 with a large backpack, a 3 plate carrier, a durable gas mask, a self revive kit, and a killstreak.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_GEAR_UP_OPERATORS_2_DE: Fully gear up your 2nd active duty operator.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_GEAR_UP_OPERATORS_3_DE: Fully gear up your 3rd active duty operator.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_GEAR_UP_OPERATORS_DESC: Fully gear up your 1st active duty operator.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_LOCK_PICK_BARTER_DESC: Trade for a skeleton key in either Al Mazrah, Ashika Island, or Building 21.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_LOCK_PICK_DETAIL_DESC:
Hello again. So it seems our sniper team was actively investigating the cartel's activity. They left some information in the dead drop, but it seems unlikely that they left nothing else. Standard proceedure is to keep all notes in a dossier. Their hideout was in Ahkdar Village. They stationed themselves in an abandoned building north of the fabric dyeing district. You should be able to find it overlooking the large courtyard with the dyeing vats.

Unfortunate news is that we can't contact them and so we don't have a key to the building. We'd also rather not break the door down and expose our hideout to AQ. Open it up with a skeleton key and extract that dossier for us.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_LOCK_PICK_UNLOCK_DESC: Use a skeleton key to unlock the sniper team's hideout in Ahkdar Village.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_MOVING_TARGET_DETAIL_D:
Good to see you again. Looks like you'll need a suitable weapon to engage with the increasingly aggressive enemy operators storming through the AO. We've purchased some explosive sniper rounds that you will find highly effective against armored operators. We're willing to trade you a sniper rifle capable of eliminating operators in just one shot.

We need you to procure the manifest for Al-Qatala's cargo on the Al Mazrah train. Bring it to Ashika Island and we'll have ourselves a deal.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_MOVING_TARGET_DRILL_DE: Drill the safe on the train.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_MOVING_TARGET_LOOT_DES: Take and extract the train manifest from the safe.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_MOVING_TARGET_TRADE_DE: Use the train manifest to trade for the MCPR-300 at a buy station in Ashika Island.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_NOISEMAKER_DELIVER_DES: Deliver it to Observatory dead drop.
PMC_S3/REDACTED_3_NOISEMAKER_LOOT_DESC: Loot volatile decoy grenade from Residential dead drop.
PMC_S3/SC_CARTEL_NOTES_DESC:
This is S.C. Phantom 5-1. We've been found out and we're taking fire from the cartel. 5-2 is KIA, and I'm probably next.
We tracked the cartel to the entrances of the bunker they were looking for. There's 3 of them. One's under the railroad in the oilfields. There's another they're trying to open up under the bridge going between Taraq Village and AM City. The last one's in the nearby underground parking garage.
I hear them coming up the stairs. It's goodbye from me. If you ever find this, thanks for never sending that evac you fuckers.
PMC_S3/SCAV_KILL_ENEMY_WEAPON_DESC: Kill the Scavenger with a weapon dropped by an enemy operator.
PMC_S3/SCAV_KILL_ENEMY_WEAPON_DETAIL_DES: The Scavenger seems to utilize weapons from other enemy operators and he's taken out some of our own soldiers. We'd like to give him a taste of his own medicine. What I'm asking you isn't necessarily above board, but some of those soldiers were my friends, and I'd like the see the man responsible put to justice. Find him, kill him, and show others what happens to those to attack our group.
PMC_S3/SECURE_SUPPLIES_COMPLETE_DESC: Complete a Secure Supplies contract in ^.2:30^7 minutes.
PMC_S3/SECURE_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_DESC: Our contractee is sending a payout to any fireteams that can secure a list of supplies in the AO. Find a burner phone with intel on AQ's supply stashes and move in to secure them. Time is of the essence here so haul ass.
PMC_S3/SHOPKEEPER_INTEL_DESC:
AQ and the cartel have discovered our work. There's some evidence in those bunkers that needs to be destroyed, and we can't have it traced back to us. Anything related to the nuclear testing or gas is to be dispatched. See that the evidence is destroyed. We'll be expecting you to work quickly.

- K
PMC_S3/SHOPKEEPER_TRADE_DETAIL_DESC:
We received a distress signal from an ex-Crown operator. He seems to have been abandoned in the bunker. He claims that Crown tried to have him killed, and he's a bit on edge about us as well.

He says he's willing to provide items and intel given proper compensation. He has some items he needs down there. Get him what he wants and hopefully he'll open up to us.
PMC_S3/SHOPKEEPER_TRADE_EXTRACT_DESC: Purchase ^.&&1^7 item from the shopkeeper's secure buy station.
PMC_S3/SHOPKEEPER_TRADE_READ_DESC: Locate the shopkeeper and read his list of items.
PMC_S3/STIM_PISTOL_ENEMY_DESC: Revive a downed enemy with a revive pistol.
PMC_S3/STIM_PISTOL_ENEMY_DETAIL_DESC: Back again then huh? No matter, we have a mission for you to develop your people skills. We need you to be able to deescalate conflicts and cooperate with other operators. Go out there and show us that you're not hot-headed and that you can successfully disengage active conflicts.
PMC_S3/TRADE_EXTRACT_SHOPKEEPER_INTEL_CA: Deliver a cat statue to the shopkeeper.
PMC_S3/TRADE_EXTRACT_SHOPKEEPER_INTEL_DE: We've been maintaining communications with the shop keeper. He's an eccentric fellow to say the least. There's some rather odd items he's looking for. I suppose he wants to decorate since he refused our offer to extract him out of the bunker. Maybe all those chemicals got to his head? Either way he has some intel on Crown to provide. Get that intel back for us.
PMC_S3/TRADE_EXTRACT_SHOPKEEPER_INTEL_DO: Deliver a dog bank to the shopkeeper.
PMC_S3/TRADE_EXTRACT_SHOPKEEPER_INTEL_EX: Take and extract the shopkeeper's intel.
PMC_S4/A_NEW_ENEMY_DESC: This new enemy is extremely careful with intel but they must keep records somewhere. Until we can narrow down a more specific target, it's the shotgun approach. Extract any drives and documents that you can from Vondel and we'll have our experts sort them out.
PMC_S4/AQ_BUNKER_NOTE_NOTE:
[In Arabic]

1. Meet the Mexicans at the port.
2. Get a good deal for C4 and Kastovs. (Use oil as leverage if needed)
3. Accompany them to the bunker entrance.
4. Get inside and find the objective.
PMC_S4/AQ_TIMED_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 AQ soldiers within ^.10^7 seconds of each kill.
PMC_S4/AQ_TIMED_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Hello there. We're looking to clean out AQ forces in Al Mazrah. Prove your worth by taking out combatants in rapid succession. Good hunting lad.
PMC_S4/ARMS_DEALERS_BUY_DESC: Buy a SP-X 80 from a Buy Station.
PMC_S4/ARMS_DEALERS_DESC: Being this close to uncovering the enemy's identity, we can't let other operators interrupt our progress. Remove some rival pieces from the board. You don't want to be overwhelmed in close-quarters, so eliminate the possibility by acquiring a rifle that will let you take them out from a distance. Minimize risk, maximize damage.
PMC_S4/ARMS_DEALERS_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators or commanders with a SP-X 80.
PMC_S4/ATTACH_SUPPRESSOR_KILL_ATTACH_DES: Attach a suppressor to a weapon at a workbench, found near buy stations.
PMC_S4/ATTACH_SUPPRESSOR_KILL_DETAIL_DES: In the field you'll want to know how to find and utilize higher-grade equipment. Find some cash and proceed to a buy station. Use the workbench to attach a suppressor to your weapon system. You can test out your new gear the best way you know how to.
PMC_S4/ATTACH_SUPPRESSOR_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed weapon.
PMC_S4/BASIC_TRAINING_DESC: By now you should be getting familiarized with the landscape. High or low, use the urban environment to your advantage and eliminate threats. We'll send in a team, once you're done, to secure their radios. This could give us a window into how they're coordinating.
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_DARK_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: We need to clear the chemical treatment plant for an upcoming operation. We don't want AQ to know what equipment we have access to so that means no night optics. This might seem like an odd request but I'm sure a soldier of your caliber will have no issues right?
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_DARK_KILLS_FIRE_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with fire in the chemical plant.
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_DARK_KILLS_NO_NVGS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies without using NVGs in the chemical plant.
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_KEYCODE_STORY_DETAIL_DE: Hello again. There's a locked room in the Koschei Complex Alpha Cluster that requires entering a keycode to open. We know there's a map in that room we need access to. Use a R4D detector to gain access to the room and extract the map for us.
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_KEYCODE_STORY_ENTER_DES: Unlock the keypad-locked room in the Koschei Complex Alpha Cluster with an R4D detector.
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_SAFE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Thanks to you we now understand that Crown was involved in the construction of the DRC and Building 21. An informant said that there's a safe in the bunker Factory Wing that the Rhino and the Sniper are defending. We suspect it contains intel on Crown's involvement with the Koschei Complex. There's a diamond-tipped drill reportedly found in a keypad-locked room in the Alpha Cluster. Figure out how to get that drill, open that safe, and extract the contents.
PMC_S4/BIOBUNKER_SAFE_STORY_DRILL_DESC: Drill the safe in the Factory Wing using the diamond-tipped drill found in the keypad-locked room in the Alpha Cluster.
PMC_S4/BIOLABS_EVIDENCE_NOTE:
[In Russian]
These tunnels have proven useful for our work and as such I propose to you a new center for our work back in the homeland. Transportation costs are going to bury us at this rate, and a modern center for science will aid in our future plans. We can build a compound of research buildings, each of which is seemingly innocent from the outside. We just need to ensure they don't exist on any public records. And then underground we will build a large connecting series of tunnels where our real work can commence.

- Michal
PMC_S4/BIOLABS_INVESTIGATION_STORY_DETAI: Well soldier, you've proven yourself useful to our cause so far. We have a mission that requires someone of your skill set. There's a research center, or rather a military lab, known as the Defense Research Center. There's barely any info on it and we don't have any inside contacts. So naturally we'd like you to be our inside contact.  On the first floor there should be a utility room. That's where they'd be running the power and piping for the whole building. Make a note of everything you see in there, it could all give us a lead. Unfortunate hiccup is that Shadow Company has secured the location, but we'll leave you to figure that part out.
PMC_S4/BIOLABS_INVESTIGATION_STORY_LOCAT: Investigate the generator room on F1.
PMC_S4/BOMB_DELIVERY_CRAFT_DESC: Bring the charge to the Ashika Waterways dead drop with electrical components and a battery to rearm the charge.
PMC_S4/BOMB_DELIVERY_DELIVER_DESC: Dead drop the rearmed charge to the Al Sharim Pass dead drop.
PMC_S4/BOMB_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC: A few weeks ago some civilians tried bombing the statue in the central Ahkdar courtyard. It didn't go so well but the explosive is still there just it never went off. We'd like to inspect their handiwork so to say. Get that explosive back and rearm it at the waterways in Ashika Island. We left a small kit for you. Bring it back to Al Sharim Pass. We'll notify some friends when you're done.
PMC_S4/BOMB_DELIVERY_LOOT_DESC: Loot and extract the defused charge from the Ahkdar statue.
PMC_S4/BOSS_WEAPON_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Enemy factions are sending in their best fighters to reclaim territory. They're heavy on armor and firepower, but we have the initiative. Track them down and eliminate them. Shadow Company has put a target on Velikan as well. Supposedly he's gone rogue.
PMC_S4/BOSS_WEAPON_KILLS_GETAWAY_DESC: Kill the Bullfrog with the RGL-80.
PMC_S4/BOSS_WEAPON_KILLS_JUGG_DESC: Kill the Juggernaut with the RGL-80.
PMC_S4/BREATH_EASY_DESC: Accessing the waterways in Vondel opens up new tactical possibilities so you need to be comfortable diving. Train yourself with a rebreather and it could end up saving your life one day.
PMC_S4/BREATH_EASY_USE_DESC: Using a rebreather, stay underwater for 35 consecutive seconds.
PMC_S4/BUILDING_21_UNENCRYPTED_HARD_DRIV: A Hard Drive found abandoned in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/BUILDING_TENSIONS_EXTRACT_DESC: Successfully extract in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/BUILDING_TENSIONS_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 PMC enemies in Vondel using a Kastov 74u in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/BUILDING_TENSIONS_LOOT_DESC: Loot a Kastov 74u from an Al-Qatala enemy.
PMC_S4/BUNKER_BLUEPRINTS_DESC: A Russian folder of documents describing the logistical layout of a bunker under Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/BUNKER_ENTRANCE_CAMERA_PLANT_DETA: We have surveillance on the oasis bunker entrance, but we need cameras for the others. Plant cameras at each of the three and don't let any enemy operators see you. Good luck.
PMC_S4/BUNKER_ENTRANCE_CAMERA_PLANT_MODE: Plant a tactical camera in the airlock at the Al Mazrah City bunker entrance.
PMC_S4/BUNKER_ENTRANCE_CAMERA_PLANT_OILF: Plant a tactical camera in the airlock at the Rohan Oil bunker entrance.
PMC_S4/BUNKER_ENTRANCE_CAMERA_PLANT_WART: Plant a tactical camera in the airlock at the Taraq bunker entrance.
PMC_S4/BUNKER_SAFE_NOTE_NOTE:
[In Russian]
And so it is official. We will build the DRC based on the success of the DRD and its success in chemical weaponry. We must keep this highly confidential. Especially Building 21 and what we intend to do with it.

- K
PMC_S4/CALL_EXFIL_HELI_CALL_DESC: Call in an exfil chopper at an exfil site marked with green smoke.
PMC_S4/CALL_EXFIL_HELI_DETAIL_DESC:
Hopefully this isn't your first time into the exclusion zone, but all of our contractors need to be seasoned in the art of exfiltration. We've hired a team to help get you out when you're ready.

Find a designated exfil site on your map. It'll be marked with green smoke. Fire a flare and we'll call in a team to extract you.
PMC_S4/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is prepping cargo for transport. That cargo is valuable and we have contractees asking for it. Secure the cargo vehicle and move to a designated HLZ where Slasher-2 will meet you to extract the package. Those transport vehicles are worth something on their own as well, so don't let them go to waste. Repair and refuel the vehicle afterwards.
PMC_S4/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_FUEL_REPAIR_DES: Fully repair and refuel the transport vehicle.
PMC_S4/CAVES_TRACKING_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is continuing to push their smuggling trade. We need to figure out the routes their transports are taking out of Al Mazrah. There are some trucks in the cave complex marked by AQ. Put tracking devices on them. We left them for you in the dead drop in Al-Sharim Pass along the southeastern cliffs. Also there's a server room in a bunker at the caves. Move there and signals intel will hook into it.
PMC_S4/CAVES_TRACKING_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Travel to the server rack in the bunker in Sattiq Caves and download the data.
PMC_S4/CAVES_TRACKING_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Al-Sharim Pass dumpster dead drop.
PMC_S4/CAVES_TRACKING_PLANT_DESC: Plant ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices on the AQ trucks in Sattiq Caves in one deployment.
PMC_S4/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DETAIL_DESC: Our enemies are storing their most confidential information and equipment in strongholds. You'll need to be proficient in clearing out these stronghold compounds. Get a keycard to gain access off of enemies or at a buy station. Then kill all hostiles in the stronghold and secure any notable intel or equipment you find.
PMC_S4/COLLECTION_PLATE_DESC: Some of our fireteams have come in contact with the Peacekeepers. The enemy's weaponry is chewing through our armor so we'll need plenty in reserve. Clearing the city of the Peacekeepers will be a marathon, not a sprint. Make protection a priority.
PMC_S4/COMPLETE_SQUAD_MISSIONS_DETAIL_DE: We have some operators in the field that we need you to assist. Recruiting valuable fighters to our cause is invaluable so even if you assist with work for other factions, as long as they know who sent you it'll be beneficial.
PMC_S4/CROSS_TOWN_DESC: Intel shows Peacekeeper activity near both the Castle and Cruise Terminal. They could be holding weapon caches and resupplies. We need recon on both locations. Any information about their supply chain could be crucial to shutting them down.
PMC_S4/CROSS_TOWN_VISIT_CASTLE_DESC: Visit the Castle in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/CROSS_TOWN_VISIT_MUSEUM_DESC: Visit the Cruise Terminal in Vondel.
PMC_S4/CUT_THE_HEAD_ACTIVATE_DESC: Activate the ^.&&1^7 laptops in the Market in under 2 minutes with the encryption key.
PMC_S4/CUT_THE_HEAD_DESC: Coordinates for a key Peacekeeper base have been confirmed and intel suggests it holds exactly what we're looking for. Data this sensitive will require an encryption key. Acquiring one should enable you to access and transfer the data directly. Make sure to bring the key back, it's an invaluable tool. Remember, we only have one shot at this. Time to uncover exactly who we've been fighting.
PMC_S4/CUT_THE_HEAD_SEARCH_DESC: Trade for the encryption key at a buy station.
PMC_S4/DARK_WATER_CARTEL_DESC: Find the cartel warehouse key from the easternmost sunken ship in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/DARK_WATER_DETAIL_DESC:
We've moved a lot of assets to target cartel objectives. One of our UAVs captured a cartel officer bringing a laptop to one of their warehouses in the south of the port. He then took an RHIB to move to the airport where they were awaiting a drug transportation plane. En route they instructed a soldier to dive down into the easternmost of the sunken ships. After a few minutes he resurfaced and we engaged the boat with 25mm gunship fire neutralizing all targets.

We were unable to find the key to their warehouse which we believe was left underwater in the sunken ship. We need you to go down to retrieve the key and gain access to their storage facility. We believe the laptop is still in there, which could help provide valuable intel.
PMC_S4/DARK_WATER_INTEL_DESC: Find and extract the cartel laptop from the warehouse.
PMC_S4/DAY_AT_THE_ZOO_DESC: The Vondel Zoo was undergoing renovations when the chaos started, making it an opportune safehouse for the Peacekeepers. Clear the zoo of enemy presence and we may be able to take advantage of such a recognizable local landmark in the future.
PMC_S4/DAY_AT_THE_ZOO_VISIT_DESC: Travel to the Zoo in Vondel.
PMC_S4/DEAD_DROP_PYRO_INTEL_DELIVER_DESC: Dead drop the Pyro's intel in Vondel.
PMC_S4/DEAD_DROP_PYRO_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: The Pyro in Al Mazrah has been a thorn in our neck. He has some intel we'd like taken off of him and put into our hands. I'm sure you understand the picture. Deliver the intel to any dead drop in Vondel and we'll secure it.
PMC_S4/DEAD_DROP_WEAPONS_STORY_DETAIL_DE: The poor civilians of Vondel are currently struggling in camps on the outskirts of the city. We'd like to acquire some items to help aid them. Deliver these items to any dumpster dead drop in Vondel and we'll pick them up. We set up one dead drop outside of the restaurant in the zoo. You're doing a great service.
PMC_S4/DEAD_DROP_WEAPONS_STORY_KILLSTREA: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 killstreak to any Vondel dead drop.
PMC_S4/DEAD_DROP_WEAPONS_STORY_LETHALS_D: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 lethals to any Vondel dead drop.
PMC_S4/DEAD_DROP_WEAPONS_STORY_WEAPONS_D: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons to any Vondel dead drop.
PMC_S4/DEFUSE_ENEMY_CHARGE_DESC: Defuse an enemy team's charge at a supply site.
PMC_S4/DEFUSE_ENEMY_CHARGE_DETAIL_DESC: Enemy operators have been sabotaging some of our plans. We'd like you to perform some counter-sabotage. What do you say?
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_DELIVER_DESC: Drop the hard drive in the Waterways dead drop on Ashika Island.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_DETAIL_DESC: An informant sent us a hard drive with some intel on Ashika Island's history. We hired a driver to return the hard drive to us, and we have not heard back from him. He was traveling north from Ahkdar. Main thing is that you get that hard drive and bring it to a dead drop we've setup in the waterways of Ashika Island. Remember, you're looking for a white dumpster.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_LOCATE_DESC: Locate the car crash site near the observatory.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CAR_CRASH_LOOT_DESC: Find and extract the hard drive near the crash site.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CHEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We have some chemical items we'd like you to find and dead drop to us. Sulphuric acid, hydro peroxide, and iodine radiation blockers. Any dead drop should work as long as you let us know where to pick them up.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CHEMS_H2O2_DESC: Dead drop a bottle of hydrogen peroxide.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CHEMS_IODINE_DESC: Dead drop a bottle of radiation blockers.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_CHEMS_SULFUR_DESC: Dead drop a bottle of sulfuric acid.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_EXPLOSIVE_CHARGE_DELIVER_: Take the charge and deliver it to the shopkeeper in Koschei Complex.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_EXPLOSIVE_CHARGE_DETAIL_D: We'd like to send the shopkeeper a little present. There's a timed charge in Zaya Observatory. Take it to a dead drop to neutralize the timer and bring it to the shopkeeper. Should be the fun kind of surprise.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_EXPLOSIVE_CHARGE_DISARM_D: Deliver the charge to a dead drop to neutralize the timer.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_EXPLOSIVE_CHARGE_LOOT_DES: Find and take the explosive charge from the Zaya Observatory tunnel entrance.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_KEYS_STATUE_DETAIL_DESC: The Koschei shopkeeper has an odd request for us to deliver him some items. You can dead drop them anywhere in Al Mazrah. Shadow Company agreed to take them from Al Mazrah into the bunker. Stay frosty.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_KEYS_STATUE_KEYS_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 Koschei Complex keys in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_KEYS_STATUE_STATUE_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 cat statue in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_LETTER_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
Phalanx received our message thanks to you. We have a request for them. In exchange they're looking to get a tracking device from us that we can monitor.

Get the letter and the device from the dead drop outside of the restaurant in the Vondel Zoo. Bring them to their dead drop at the university between the art center and the gas station. Good luck out there.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_LETTER_STORY_LETTER_DESC: Deliver the letter of introduction to the Phalanx dead drop at the university.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_LETTER_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Pickup the letter of introduction and tracker from the Vondel Zoo dead drop.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_LETTER_STORY_TRACKER_DESC: Deliver the tracking device to the same Phalanx dead drop.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_RUSSIAN_DOCS_STORY_DELIVE: Deliver Spetsnaz Documents to the Phalanx dead drop near the Vondel university.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_RUSSIAN_DOCS_STORY_DETAIL: Welcome back. Phalanx clued us into some potential critical intel in the Koschei Complex. We know the bunker is of Soviet origin but supposedly there are some documents which might link the bunker to known Russian Spetsnaz groups. The documents are rumored to have been spotted in the Alpha Cluster near the back walkway overlooking the servers. Find those documents and get them to Phalanx's Vondel dead drop for them to look at.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_RUSSIAN_DOCS_STORY_LOOT_D: Find the Spetsnaz Documents in the Koschei Complex Alpha Cluster.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_DESC: Welcome back. As we continue to expand our base in the Japanese islands, we'll need some items of interest. Gun oil, consumer electronics, and some pieces of key intel. The rest we can fetch ourselves. The dead drop is located in the residential district in Ashika Island. Don't take too long out there.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_ELECTRONICS_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 VCRs or game consoles to the same dead drop.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_GUNOIL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 bottle of gun oil to the dead drop in the Ashika residential district.
PMC_S4/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_INTEL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 pieces of Legion deal intel to the same dead drop.
PMC_S4/DELTA_DRIVE_POI_CALL_JLTV_DESC: Call in our LTV vehicle drop behind the castle in Vondel.
PMC_S4/DELTA_DRIVE_POI_DETAIL_DESC: Shadow Company is asking that we do a favor for them in exchange for some intel. They've prepared a LTV with radar capabilities that they need you to drive through key points of interest in Vondel to help triangulate a signal. We've prepared a vehicle drop behind the castle in Vondel. Look for the blue smoke.
PMC_S4/DELTA_DRIVE_POI_POI_ONE_DESC: Drive the vehicle to the market in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/DELTA_DRIVE_POI_POI_TWO_DESC: Drive the vehicle to the fire station in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/DELTA_HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_CLEA: Unlock and clear the Vondel aquarium.
Unlock and clear the Vondel city hall in the same deployment.
Unlock and clear the cruise terminal in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/DELTA_HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_DETA: The enemy combatants in Vondel are held up in some key strongholds we need you to clear: the aquarium, city hall, and cruise terminal. These three provide them with powerful resupply locations and good defenses against our operators. Now be quick and dispatch those targets.
PMC_S4/DELTA_SYNC_UAV_DESC: Have ^.2^7 UAV towers active at the same time in Vondel.
PMC_S4/DELTA_SYNC_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: I'm sure you've heard of the horrible situation in Vondel. We'd like more reconnaissance in Vondel to know who we're up against. Activate multiple UAV towers at a time so our air assets can navigate the area.
PMC_S4/DEMOLITION_SAFE_DETAIL_DESC: One of our contractees has intel on high-value safes in the area. They're willing to give up that intel in exchange for a small job. They need you to destroy Al-Qatala's supply sites. Infil and find an AQ burner phone with intel on the supply site locations.
PMC_S4/DEMOLITION_SAFE_END_DEMO_DESC: Complete a Destroy Supplies contract to locate nearby safes.
PMC_S4/DISGUISED_TRAPPER_KILL_DETAIL_DES: The Ashika Bomb Maker is causing some trouble for us. We want you to show him he won't be safe from Black Mous. Get into that castle and neutralize him and his forces without sustaining critical damage.
PMC_S4/DISGUISED_TRAPPER_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill the bomb maker from within 5m without being downed since entering the perimeter.
PMC_S4/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_DETAIL_DESC: Intel confirms AQ is meeting with members of the Las Almas cartel. These are High Value Targets with information we can use for an upcoming operation. Recon shows AQ is storing up critical equipment within locked compounds for Las Almas. Your task is to eliminate an HVT, sweep them for keys to these compounds, and secure the objectives within them.
PMC_S4/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_LOOT_DESC: Take a key found on an HVT or elsewhere.
PMC_S4/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_UNLOCK_DESC: Use a key to unlock a locked space or locked cache.
PMC_S4/ENCR_KEY_DESC: An encryption key needed to access carefully protected files
PMC_S4/ENTER_KILL_BIOBUNKER_DETAIL_DESC: We have plans to have a few of our operators investigate the Koschei Complex. We'd like you to perform an initial clearing of the target. Get in there and neutralize all hostile tangos.
PMC_S4/ENTER_KILL_BIOBUNKER_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S4/EXFIL_LARGE_TEAM_DETAIL_DESC: We need you to help recruit some operators to our faction's line of work. Infil alone and find others to work with to extract. Hopefully the other operators treat you well.
PMC_S4/EXFIL_LARGE_TEAM_EXFIL_DESC: Extract with at least ^.6^7 total operators at once in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Now that we have intel on the entrances to the bunker we need to ensure Al Mazrah's secured. We need to know the locations of where enemy faction's exfils are going. There's 4 trackers in the south gas station dead drop near the hydroelectric dam in Al Mazrah. Plant them under the wings of 4 exfil helos. We'll be monitoring where our enemies have setup their FOBs. Remember to be out of sight of enemies. Any slip up and they'll know our plans.
PMC_S4/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Take and extract the ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Zarqwa Hydroelectric dead drop.
PMC_S4/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_FINAL_DESC: Plant a tracker on the final exfil chopper.
PMC_S4/EXFIL_TRACKING_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant a tracker on ^.&&1^7 enemy exfil choppers.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_BLUE_DESC: Extract the Building 21 intel from the blue locked room in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: While we figure out our next steps we have some knowledge of specific intel in Building 21 that we'd like you to retrieve. You'll need to gain access to a few rooms but that shouldn't be a problem for a fighter like yourself right? Intel places the documents in the red, blue, and black rooms of the facility. Don't let anyone see you take the documents. They are highly confidential.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_GREEN_DESC: Extract the Building 21 intel from the black locked room.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_INTEL_RED_DESC: Extract the Building 21 intel from the red locked room in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_BIOLABS_KEYCARD_DETAIL_DE: Let's see if you know your stuff. High-level idea is this. There's a facility. The DRC, Defense Research Center. In it there's a specific building, Building 21. We want access to it. The only way you get access to it is with a Building 21 keycard. You've extracted objectives out of the AO before, so I suspect you'll be fine carrying a small card. If you can procure the card for me I'll see it as the beginning of a long career working together.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_DETAIL_:
Shadow Company sold some intel to us. They discovered a high security room with a locked cache in the southernmost restricted zone in the alpha cluster sector. There's supposedly some security system that will trigger an alarm. In the External Ops. sector there's an upload station that contains data referencing Building 21.

If you can access that upload station we can reset the security system which should unlock that cache. Get us that intel and we can look into how Building 21 is related to these bunkers.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_EXTRACT: Extract the Building 21 evidence from the cache.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_LOOT_DE: Open the locked cache in the restricted section in the Alpha Cluster.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_DRD_BIOLABS_INTEL_RESET_D: Reset the security system at the upload station in the External Ops Section.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: We got into contact with a Russian whistleblower. He's willing to exchange some intel. There's a hotel room at the Ashika Island hotel that he was staying at. He left a little document for us. First step is to get inside that locked room. Next step is to stash a special USB we delivered to the dead drop in the underground waterways. So get the documents and place the USB. Our source will go to pick it up.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the Al Mazrah shipping intel from room 403 of the Ashika Island hotel.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_LOOT_DESC: Take the Building 21 USB stick from the dead drop in the Waterways.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_PLANT_INTEL_PLANT_DESC: Place the Building 21 USB in the hotel room.
PMC_S4/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_NO_DAMAGE_DE: Extract a weapons case without having taken health damage in that deployment.

We're in need of a weapons case and we can't have any Black Mous casualties. We need someone who can retrieve a weapons case without sustaining any damage. I'm hoping that you're that strong operator? Good hunting soldier.
PMC_S4/EYES_AND_EARS_COMPLETE_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 types of contracts in one deployment.
PMC_S4/EYES_AND_EARS_DESC: Too many enemy operations are happening right under our nose, but each one we shut down sends a warning to others that we're coming. Disrupt multiple operations in quick succession, before they know what's happening.
PMC_S4/EYES_AND_EARS_EXFIL_DESC: Take final exfil in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/FALSE_GAS_RESEARCH_NOTES_NOTE: The animals seem to have ingested some dangerous poison, though the exact nature of it is unknown. More research will need to be done here.
PMC_S4/FEARLESS_ACTIVATE_DESC: Activate a UAV tower while carrying a Weapon Case.
PMC_S4/FEARLESS_CLEAR_DESC: Clear the Fire Station Fortress in Vondel while carrying a Weapon Case.
PMC_S4/FEARLESS_COMPLETE_DESC: Extract with a Weapon Case in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/FEARLESS_DESC: Black Mous is narrowing down a primary location for sensitive Peacekeeper data, but we'll only have one shot to move on the coordinates. We need to provoke a similar response, document the results, and then analyze the enemy's response tactics. It has to be a brazen assault that can't be ignored. Your objective is to attack a high-profile target and record the enemy activity that results. And you're going to have to do it with a target firmly on your back. With the resulting intel, we'll be ready to hit the enemy where it hurts.
PMC_S4/FINAL_COUNTDOWN_DESC: There's no room for failure in the upcoming operation. We need to select our most elite operators for the job. Show your mettle by entering the fray all alone, and come back with more weapons than you started with. We believe you're up to the task, now prove us right.
PMC_S4/FINAL_COUNTDOWN_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract with the final exfil with three weapons dropped by enemy operators in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/FIRE_ARM_REGULATION_DEPOSIT_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 weapons to Vondel dead drops in a single deployment.
