PMC_S4/FIRE_ARM_REGULATION_DESC: Even after we've breached all of their security and acquired the sensitive data we're after, we still need to get it out of the city safely. Disarming forces across the city will mitigate potential obstacles in our way. Confiscate their weapons, bringing the guns to dead drops, so we can get them out of Vondel.
PMC_S4/FLARE_STICK_DESC: A small, light stick that can be ignited to mark an area with light and smoke.
PMC_S4/FROGICIDE_DESC: Allies are investigating possible links to the Peacekeepers that could explain their supply of resources, including TAVs. We can't risk them fortifying more vehicles and tightening their grip. One Bullfrog rolling around the streets of Vondel is enough. Set off some fireworks and leave them nothing but the wreckage.
PMC_S4/FROGICIDE_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy 3 Tactical Amphibious Vehicles in under 5 seconds.
PMC_S4/FULL_SWEEP_HEMLOCK_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the Iso Hemlock.
PMC_S4/FULL_SWEEP_X13_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the X13 Auto.
PMC_S4/GAS_RESEARCH_NOTES_NOTE: I've looked over the cases of the Russian gas inhalation. It seems the Russian gas that was first used on that Japanese island has an even more potent form. Or at least some other substance acts as a catalyst to the gas increasing the potential injury it causes and causing the gas to attack the lungs in much shorter time spans. The animals that somehow ingested the dissolved gas were harmed much more than my calculations predict. And I have a hunch as to what the catalyst is.
PMC_S4/GAS_SAMPLE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Now that we've located the gas sample from Vondel, we can compare it with a sample from Koschei Complex. We got intel from an AQ soldier that there's a Koschei gas sample somewhere in the south of the DRD. Find it and take it to the external ops. A machine directly right of the main entrance should be able to compare the similarity of the samples. If they're the same product then we know whoever is occupying Vondel was involved with the Koschei Complex and the creation of this Russian gas.
PMC_S4/GAS_SAMPLE_STORY_INFIL_DESC: Infil into the Koschei Complex with the Vondel Gas Sample.
PMC_S4/GAS_SAMPLE_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Find the Koschei Complex gas sample in the south of the DRD.
PMC_S4/GAS_SAMPLE_STORY_VALIDATE_DESC: Validate the chemical similarity between the Vondel gas sample and Koschei Complex gas sample at the machine in the External Ops. sector.
PMC_S4/GEAR_UP_DETAIL_DESC: Welcome back. We're planning a siege on major AQ objectives in the north of Al Mazrah. Your group is known for your consistency with arming yourself with high-efficiency, tactical equipment, isn't that right? Well we'd like some operators from your group to assist, so can you gear up enough operators for the seige? I'm asking for at least three with a large backpack, a three plate carrier, a durable gas mask, a self revive kit, and a killstreak.
PMC_S4/GEAR_UP_OPERATORS_2_DESC: Fully gear up active duty operator 2.
PMC_S4/GEAR_UP_OPERATORS_3_DESC: Fully gear up active duty operator 3.
PMC_S4/GEAR_UP_OPERATORS_DESC: Fully gear up active duty operator 1.
PMC_S4/GO_FOR_A_DRIVE_DELIVER_ITEM_DESC: Deliver the loaded hard drive to the dead drop at the Zoo in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/GO_FOR_A_DRIVE_DESC: Black Mous needs data from Vondel, and we've identified a specific vehicle as a mobile command center likely to hold it. You'll need to take control of the vehicle while downloading the data onto an encrypted hard drive. The enemy is sure to notice such a valuable target being hijacked so be ready for resistance. Our partners believe they can use this data to help us locate key enemy locations, so delivering that drive safely to the dead drop is crucial.
PMC_S4/GO_FOR_A_DRIVE_DRIVE_DESC: Drive a Chop Top in Vondel for two consecutive minutes while carrying the encrypted hard drive.
PMC_S4/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We placed a GPS tracker at the burger shop at the observatory. We need you to use the GPS to help us update our topographical maps of the area. We'll need frequent sample points across the AO to accurately krige together into workable data. Take the tracker from the dead drop, visit all of the major points of interest, and return with it.
PMC_S4/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Loot the GPS tracker from the dumpster dead drop in Zaya Observatory.
PMC_S4/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to every POI in Al Mazrah while carrying the GPS tracker in one deployment.
PMC_S4/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala has been taking potential informants in as hostages. Our associates would like you to protect them and will pay a hefty price if you can extract them safely. Find and secure the hostage, bring them to an HLZ and extract with the hostage to ensure their survival.
PMC_S4/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with the hostage evac helo.
PMC_S4/HUNTER_COMPLETE_SINGLE_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 Hunt contracts in one deployment.
PMC_S4/HUNTER_DESC: If the Peacekeeper infiltration has more support behind it than we thought, we need to push even harder and test for weaknesses. Hunt and eliminate targets to make it perfectly clear that no one who stands against us is safe.
PMC_S4/INFIL_EXFIL_BIOBUNKER_DETAIL_DESC:
Thanks to your efforts Phalanx was able to track an AQ transport moving into an underground facility. Intel suggests that it's a Soviet bunker complex constructed in Al Mazrah many years ago.

The official title for the compound is the Koschei Complex. The official documents only mention some sort of chemical treatment facilities down there, but we don't really know the scale of their operations. Bring NVGs with you. Any intel you bring back could be beneficial to our cause.
PMC_S4/INFIL_GIVE_SCAV_WEAPON_DETAIL_DES: There's a target known as the Scavenger who's been spotted in Vondel. We'd like to eliminate any variables. To lure him out take in a strong weapon and leave it near an enemy's corpse for him to find.
PMC_S4/INFIL_GIVE_SCAV_WEAPON_GIVE_DESC: Drop the weapon near an enemy operator's corpse.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_NO_WEAPONS_DET: Operators who work with us must be experts in escape and evasion. Infil into the AO empty-handed and make it to extraction without picking up a weapon.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_NO_WEAPONS_EXF: Exfil in the same deployment without picking up any weapons.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_DETAIL: We have some new members that we don't have guns for. Get them some decent weaponry and we'll talk about payment. And try to maintain a low profile will you?
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_EXTRAC: Extract ^.&&1^7 weapons with at least ^.3^7 attachments each in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_EXTRACT_WEAPONS_INFIL_: Infil without any teammates and without any weapons.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC: We need an operator that can work alone and still be dangerous. Get in with nothing and make magic happen. Our next operation will require these skills in movement and combat. Have fun fighter.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil in the same deployment without having picked up any weapons.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_INFIL_DESC: Infil without any teammates and without any weapons.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_KILL_EXFIL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operator in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_KNIFE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: It's a great day for a challenge isn't it? No teammates, no weapons, I want to see how productive you can be with nothing. Making wine out of water is key in our line of work. Do this and you'll prove you have what it takes to rise in our ranks. Though this should be easy enough for a soldier of your caliber wouldn't you agree?
PMC_S4/INFIL_SOLO_KNIFE_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/INTEL_BOSS_DETAIL_DESC: We received information on Al-Qatala commanders operating in the area. Targeting these individuals will help disrupt AQ's command structure. We need you to secure intel on a commander to locate their current position.
PMC_S4/INTERROGATE_CHEMIST_STORY_DETAIL_: Thanks for the assistance in Vondel. Shadow Company gave us some intel that the Chemist was spotted there. It's highly likely then that Russian gas is either being transported or is somehow involved in the occupation of Vondel. Dispatch the target and take any intel you find off of him to try to find a sample of the gas. Good hunting soldier.
PMC_S4/INTERROGATE_CHEMIST_STORY_INTERRO: Find and take the Chemist's intel off of him.
PMC_S4/INTERROGATE_CHEMIST_STORY_LOOT_DE: Follow the chemist's intel to find a sample of the Russian gas in Vondel.
PMC_S4/INTRO_LETTER_NOTE:
It seems our intentions are aligned. The forces in Vondel are clearly malicious and almost certainly tied to the ongoings in Al Mazrah and Ashika Island. I suggest we ally together against this new threat. Lest it be who we both fear the most. You can maintain access to Vondel while we give you access back into AM and B21.

- Black Mous
PMC_S4/IR_BEACON_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: It's been good working with you so far but now's the test to test your skills. One of our night operations teams placed a beacon on some rocks off the northern coast of Ashika Island. Your job is to move that beacon to the top of Tsuki Castle. Somewhere where it'll be visible overhead for our Shadow Company surveillance night operation.
PMC_S4/IR_BEACON_STORY_LOOT_IR_BEACON_DE: Take the IR beacon left on the rocks off the northern coast of Ashika Island.
PMC_S4/IR_BEACON_STORY_PLACE_IR_BEACON_D: Plant the IR beacon on the roof of Tsuki Castle.
PMC_S4/KEYPAD_ROOM_INTEL_DESC: A series of documents describing the chemical formulations of the Russian gas.
PMC_S4/KEYPAD_ROOM_INTEL_NOTE:
Our recent research indicates that we can catalyze the biological reaction to the gas. I implore you to come see the state of our work. You'll be thoroughly impressed I'm sure.

- Michal
PMC_S4/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_WEAPON_DETA: Phalanx is paying to eliminate some Al Qatala commanders in the Koschei Complex. They have a requirement that you use a specific weapon. I believe they're hoping that AQ traces the attack back to Phalanx. I don't try to understand their methods though and neither should you. What you need to do is take their weapon and get down into that bunker.
PMC_S4/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_WEAPON_LOOT: Take the weapon from the Phalanx dead drop.
PMC_S4/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_WEAPON_RUSH: Kill the Rhino with the weapon.
PMC_S4/KILL_BIOBUNKER_BOSSES_WEAPON_SNIP: Kill the Sniper with the weapon.
PMC_S4/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_DETAIL_DESC: The best way to wound the enemy is to hit them where it hurts right? That's why we need you to eliminate enemy commanders with their own weapons of choice. I know you're one to work with style so I have confidence that this is up your alley.
PMC_S4/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_JUGG_DESC: Kill the Juggernaut with an LMG.
PMC_S4/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_RUSHER_DESC: Kill the Rhino with a pistol.
PMC_S4/KILL_COUNTER_BOSSES_SNIPER_DESC: Kill the Sniper with a sniper rifle.
PMC_S4/KILL_KONNI_HEADSHOT_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 of the unknown forces in Ashika Island or Vondel with a suppressed pistol with headshots.
PMC_S4/KILL_KONNI_HEADSHOT_DETAIL_DESC: It's time we neutralize some of these enemy occupants in Vondel. We need to maintain a low disposition. Fire effectively with a discrete weapon.
PMC_S4/KILL_SEALION_SOLDIERS_DETAIL_DESC: Good day. Hopefully this mission marks the beginning of a fruitful relationship between you and our faction. We're looking to take a stake in Ashika Island. We'd like for you to clear out some of the enemy forces on site and bring back some proof. Do this for us and you'll prove your worth.
PMC_S4/KILL_TRAPPER_CROSSBOW_DESC: Kill the Bomb Maker with a crossbow.
PMC_S4/KILL_TRAPPER_CROSSBOW_DETAIL_DESC: Shadow Company's Bomb Maker has caused some trouble for us, and for SC themselves by the sounds of it. We'd like him out of the picture. Use a more discrete weapon that can't be traced back to us will you?
PMC_S4/KILLS_IN_HELI_DETAIL_DESC: Alright there? You might have experience shooting operators in a helicopter from your previous operation, but a sharpshooter can take aim while in motion against any target thrown at 'em. Correct me if I'm wrong but you consider yourself to be a sharpshooter? Well then you best show us.
PMC_S4/KILLS_IN_HELI_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a helicopter in one deployment.
PMC_S4/KILLS_IN_HELI_PLAYERS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operator or commander from a helicopter.
PMC_S4/KILLS_IN_HELI_SHIELDS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 riots shield enemies from a helicopter.
PMC_S4/KILLS_MULTI_POI_CAVES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Sattiq Cave Complex in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/KILLS_MULTI_POI_DETAIL_DESC: There's Al-Qatala and Shadow Company forces stationed along the oil pipeline from Rohan Oil's oilfields down to their containers at the port. We'd like to secure a piece of the pie and damage their structure in the process. Take out targets along the pipeline.
PMC_S4/KILLS_MULTI_POI_OILFIELD_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Rohan Oil in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/KILLS_UNIQUE_WEAPON_CLASS_DESC: Kill enemies with ^.&&1^7 different weapon classes in one deployment.
PMC_S4/KILLS_UNIQUE_WEAPON_CLASS_DETAIL_: Morning to you. Good work getting those supplies for the Vondel people. It's a good time for you to get some training in working with different weapon systems. I know you've done your basic training but training at base and real combat are quite different wouldn't you say. We need a flexible operator who knows how to handle themselves in any situation.
PMC_S4/LARGE_CONTRACT_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DE: Welcome back. We have a high need for quick cash. We need you to complete a high volume of contract work in a short amount of time. Sounds like something you're capable of right?
PMC_S4/LAST_LINE_OF_DEFENSE_DESC: This is the final push. We need to eliminate as many remaining threats as we can to ensure success on our final assault. Remove enemies from the city by any means necessary.
PMC_S4/LAST_LINE_OF_DEFENSE_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Vondel in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/LETTER_UPLOAD_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Now that you're slightly acquainted with our work, we have a small task for you. We've been contacted by an insider in the CIA, Laswell. She's investigating the events in Vondel. We've relayed her instructions to you. Check your notes collection for the letter.
PMC_S4/LETTER_UPLOAD_STORY_READ_DESC: Read Laswell's instructions in your notes collection.
PMC_S4/LETTER_UPLOAD_STORY_UPLOAD_DESC: Read Laswell's Letter in the notes menu and complete the requested task.
PMC_S4/LIKE_FOLLOW_SUBSCRIBE_DESC: Despite our best efforts, enemy soldiers and supplies are still entering the city, some from as far as Al Mazrah. The tracks are blocked but there's still a lot of Peacekeeper activity at the train station. You need to get eyes inside the station and observe the situation.
PMC_S4/LIKE_FOLLOW_SUBSCRIBE_MARK_DESC: Mark ^.&&1^7 enemies with the Tactical Camera at the Central Station.
PMC_S4/LIKE_FOLLOW_SUBSCRIBE_PLACE_DESC: Place a Tactical Camera at the Central Station in Vondel.
PMC_S4/LOAD_HARDDRIVE_DESC: This hard drive has been loaded with important data. Handle with care.
PMC_S4/LOOT_EXTRACT_SC_LAPTOP_DETAIL_DES: Our SIGINT team tracked encrypted data being sent from a Shadow Company laptop in the Ashika Science Center. A drone was able to spot it being used around the 2nd floor of the center. We need you to extract the objective for us. You know your orders.
PMC_S4/LOOT_EXTRACT_SC_LAPTOP_LOOT_DESC: Take the Shadow Company laptop from the 2nd floor desk in the Ashika Science Center.
PMC_S4/LOOT_KILLSTREAK_DESC: Acquire a killstreak from a buy station, supply drop, or elsewhere.
PMC_S4/LOOT_KILLSTREAK_DETAIL_DESC: When duty calls, you'll need to be ready to utilize rapid air support. Find a killstreak in the AO and try using it against any enemy combatants you encounter.
PMC_S4/LOOT_SUPPLY_BOXES_DETAIL_DESC: There's a lot of cargo planes flying over the exclusion zone. Some of those planes are funded by corrupt officials. Stealing that cargo means money out of their pockets. Shoot them down or wait for supply drops. Either way, we need you to take any valuables you can find on their cargo.
PMC_S4/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_BIOBUN: Extract the weapon case from Koschei Complex without dying.
PMC_S4/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_DELTA_: Extract the weapon case from Vondel without dying.
PMC_S4/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_DETAIL: Hello again. We have word of multiple weapon cases being transported through the AO and we'd like to know their contents. Bring a few back to us and we'll see about your payment.
PMC_S4/MAP_WEAPON_CASE_EXTRACTION_SEALIO: Extract the weapon case from Ashika Island without dying.
PMC_S4/MEDIC_RAISE_DESC:
Raise yourself ^.&&1^7 times using a Self Revive.
OR
PMC_S4/MEDIC_STIM_DESC: Use ^.&&1^7 stims while at low health.
PMC_S4/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC: We've been sustaining heavy casualties from RPGs as Al-Qatala insurgents have begun to mobilize northwest of Al Mazrah into the mountains. We need material for critical medical care. There's a dumpster dead drop we set up outside the south gas station in Zarqwa Hydroelectric. Deposit low-value material there and bring more sensitive medical equipment back on your person.
PMC_S4/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_LIQUOR_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 AFAKs or large medical bags to the same dead drop.
PMC_S4/MEDS_DELIVER_EXTRACT_STIMS_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 revive pistols or self revive to the dumpster dead drop in Zarqwa Hydroelectric.
PMC_S4/MICROPHONE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Shadow Company is moving suspicious cargo aboard their ship. Surveillance footage suggests there are undocumented barrels of material on board. Our theory is that perhaps Shadow Company is working with the Russian gas. We need more concrete intel though. We set up a discrete radio for you to take and plant aboard their ship. Upload the frequency of the radio challenge to us after the hard work is done. Good luck.
PMC_S4/MICROPHONE_STORY_LOOT_MICROPHONE_: Take the discrete radio transmitter from the Ashika town center dead drop.
PMC_S4/MICROPHONE_STORY_PLACE_MICROPHONE: Plant the radio at the top of the Shadow Company ship.
PMC_S4/MICROPHONE_STORY_UPLOAD_MICROPHON: Upload the radio's frequency to an Upload Station after it's planted.
PMC_S4/MIKE24_PLATFORM_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: Thanks for retrieving that map. We're investigating any other pathways through the bunker. We have another weapon platform we'd like you to test: the Bryson Long Rifle. Enough said, good hunting.
PMC_S4/MIKE24_PLATFORM_KILLS_RANGED_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a range of over ^.50^7 meters with the Bryson Long Rifle weapons platform.
PMC_S4/MIKE24_PLATFORM_KILLS_SUPPRESSED_: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a suppressed Bryson Long Rifle platform weapon.
PMC_S4/MULTIPLE_CONTRACT_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL: Our work with the civilians has cost us. We're getting stretched for funds and we need to recuperate in as short a time as possible. You're tasked with completing contract work without wasting too much time or resources.
PMC_S4/NEW_DELTA_CONTRACT_COMPLETE_DESC: Hack ^.&&1^7 contracts in one match using the Signals Intelligence Contract.
PMC_S4/NEW_DELTA_CONTRACT_DESC: SIGINT has picked up encrypted transmissions. These could be originating from contract phones in the area, which we now have the ability to hack. Each phone you compromise will strengthen our connection and increase the amount of cash being siphoned. We'll follow the money.
PMC_S4/NO_MERCY_KILL_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies attempting to revive downed allies.
PMC_S4/NO_MERCY_KILL_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators attempting to revive a teammate.
PMC_S4/NO_ONE_LEFT_BEHIND_DESC: Peacekeepers have been holding hostages. We believe that some of those taken are local cryptologists who could be of great use to us in particular. Rescue these hostages and bring them back safely.
PMC_S4/NO_ONE_LEFT_BEHIND_EXFIL_DESC: Rescue ^.&&1^7 hostages in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/NOT_INCLUDED_DEPOSIT_DESC: Extract or Deposit in dead drops ^.&&1^7 batteries.
PMC_S4/NOT_INCLUDED_DESC: Power is still running in the city, but that could change at any moment. We have to be prepared if Peacekeepers target the power grid. Find batteries wherever you can and get them into our hands. Let's make sure we have the advantage under any conditions.
PMC_S4/OASIS_CAMERA_TRACKERS_BUY_DESC: Buy ^.&&1^7 trackers from a buy station in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/OASIS_CAMERA_TRACKERS_CAMERA_DESC: Plant a tactical camera in the airlock at the Oasis bunker entrance.
PMC_S4/OASIS_CAMERA_TRACKERS_DETAIL_DESC: Thank you again for those supplies. There's an entrance to the Koschei Complex in the oasis near Taraq Village. Can you plant a camera there watching the door for us?
PMC_S4/OASIS_CAMERA_TRACKERS_TRACKERS_DE: Place both trackers on the radioactive barrels in the oasis ruins in one deployment.
PMC_S4/PASSIVE_INCOME_DESC: Now that we've confirmed that the Peacekeepers are communicating with Al Mazrah, Black Mous will be investigating the encryption over there. We need to keep recording local samples to provide them more data. Compromise contract phones and keep the connection running as long as you can. Breaking open their safes should encourage them to make a report that we can capture.
PMC_S4/PASSIVE_INCOME_OPEN_SAFE_DESC: Open 3 safes in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/PAUSED_CHARGE_DESC: The timer has stopped, but the charge is still extremely dangerous.
PMC_S4/PHALANX_HARD_DRIVE_DESC: A hard drive provided by Phalanx.
PMC_S4/PHALANX_HARDDRIVE_STORY_DETAIL_DE: Thank you for those documents you retrieved. We have suspicion of the association of Building 21 with a certain group. Phalanx acquired a hard drive that has some data on Crown. We'd like to cross reference it with our own intel dead dropped near the burger store at the AM observatory. Get both hard drives and upload them both to our team in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/PHALANX_HARDDRIVE_STORY_LOOT1_DES: Take the hard drive found at Phalanx's Vondel University dead drop.
PMC_S4/PHALANX_HARDDRIVE_STORY_LOOT2_DES: Take the decrypted B21 hard drive from the Al Mazrah observatory dead drop.
PMC_S4/PHALANX_HARDDRIVE_STORY_UPLOAD_DE: Upload both hard drives at the same time in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/PING_KILL_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC: For a simple combat test we need to know you can communicate and kill with efficiency. Track down threats and eliminate them. Be weary not to expose who you're working with.
PMC_S4/PING_KILL_LOOT_LOOT_DESC: Pick up ^.&&1^7 weapon in a deployment.
PMC_S4/PING_PHONE_DESC: Use your Tac-Map with [{togglemap,togglescores}] and ping a contract phone.
PMC_S4/PING_PHONE_START_CONTRACT_DETAIL_: Al-Qatala is using burner phones to coordinate attacks against us. Intel was able to track some that are still active, but we need to secure them fast. Locate a phone and download its contents. Once decrypted, we can use the data to take on contracts for a payout.
PMC_S4/PLANT_FAKE_DOCS_DETAIL_DESC: Our intel confirms Shadow Co is attempting to coordinate with AQ on an upcoming operation. We're going to supply the PMCs with bad intel and use it to our advantage. The documents are in a dead drop near Sa'id Mall. Take them to the castle on Ashika Island and leave them inside the Shadow HQ.
PMC_S4/PLANT_FAKE_DOCS_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the fake Al-Qatala documents from the Zaya Observatory dead drop.
PMC_S4/PLANT_FAKE_DOCS_PLACE_DESC: Stash the fake Al-Qatala documents on the central security desk in the top room of the Ashika Island castle.
PMC_S4/PLANT_IR_BEACON_TOWERS_DETAIL_DES: We'd like to perform some recon over Al Mazrah City to keep an eye on AQ. We need you to set up two IR beacons to help our UAV navigate. You can find the beacons in the dumpster dead drop in Al Sharim Pass near the cliffs. You'll need to plant them on the two partially constructed towers in between AM city and the marshlands. Get back in one piece okay.
PMC_S4/PLANT_IR_BEACON_TOWERS_LOOT_DESC: Take the ^.&&1^7 IR beacons from the Al Sharim Pass dead drop.
PMC_S4/PLANT_IR_BEACON_TOWERS_PLANT1_DES: Plant ^.&&1^7 at the north tower in the A.M. City construction zone.
PMC_S4/PLANT_IR_BEACON_TOWERS_PLANT2_DES: Plant ^.&&1^7 at the south tower in the A.M. City construction zone.
PMC_S4/PLANT_MICROPHONE_DETAIL_DESC: We need eyes and ears inside of Shadow Company's base on Ashika Island. We prepped a radio transmitter for you in a dead drop. Take it to the top of Tsuki Castle under their desk so we can listen in.
PMC_S4/PLANT_MICROPHONE_LOOT_DESC: Take the discrete radio transmitter from the Beach Club dead drop.
PMC_S4/PLANT_MICROPHONE_PLANT_DESC: Plant the radio transmitter under the central security desk at the top of the Tsuki Castle.
PMC_S4/PLANT_USB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: There are three computers we need access to in Al Mazrah. First is at the air traffic control tower at Al-Malik International. Second is the computer in the corner on the first floor of the northern telescope in Zaya Observatory. Third is at the corner desk in the offices of the TV station in Al Mazrah City. We placed thumb drives with special software at the dead drop in the city near the Sarwana Hotel. Secure the thumb drives and plug them into those computers. We'll handle it from there.
PMC_S4/PLANT_USB_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Take the ^.&&1^7 hacked thumb drives from the dumpster dead drop near the Al Bagra Fortress.
PMC_S4/PLANT_USB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: In one deployment, plant hacked thumb drives in computers at the air traffic control tower, the north Observatory telescope, and the Al Mazrah City TV Station.
PMC_S4/PMC_UAV_TOWER_ACTIVATE_DETAIL_DES: Al-Qatala has deployed UAV towers at many points of interest around the DMZ. These towers provide critical intel on the surrounding areas. Activate them and route the signal to base so we can gain an informational advantage.
PMC_S4/POI_VEHICLE_KILLS_DETAIL_DESC: We'd like to claim some territory in Al Mazrah but Al Qatala has vehicle reinforcements at the ready. We can't allow them to interfere. Target their transportation so we can contain the threat.
PMC_S4/POI_VEHICLE_KILLS_TECHOS_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 armored AQ patrol truck in Al Safwa Quarry.
PMC_S4/POI_VEHICLE_KILLS_TRUCKS_DESC: Destroy ^.&&1^7 cargo trucks in Zaya Observatory.
PMC_S4/PUSHING_BACK_DESC: Knowing that external forces are ensuring a flow of soldiers to the Peacekeepers, we need to be targeting and intimidating their more vulnerable assets. Get your knuckles bloody by pounding Peacekeeper ground forces into submission. They won't forget finding their own on the ground, beaten and bruised.
PMC_S4/PUSHING_BACK_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with your fists in one deployment.
PMC_S4/PYRO_INTEL_NOTE: Yes we got a decent supply of C4 and plastic explosives from the Russians. Kastovs too. The job they requested of us was odd but nothing incredibly strange. But who cares that much about an old bunker? I can't say I trust them but they provide so we will take.
PMC_S4/RADIOACTIVE_CLEANUP_DESC: While we try to crack the Peacekeepers secure comms, we're relying on ears on the ground. Reported topics of enemy discussion include nuclear material within city limits, and we have no intention of letting them get their hands on it. Locate, acquire, and extract the material.
PMC_S4/READY_TO_ROCK_DESC: We don't have much intel on these so-called Peacekeepers but reports make it clear that they aren't short on hardware. With their kind of firepower, if you give them the chance to hit you, they'll hit hard. While exploring the city, get yourself suited up with the essentials and make sure you'll have the chance to hit back.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_DELTA_VEHICLES_DETAIL_DESC: Hello there. We'll need you to refuel and repair vehicles in Vondel in key locations for a future operation. Thank you for your swift and precise action.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_DELTA_VEHICLES_POI1_DESC: Repair and refuel ^.&&1^7 vehicles at the Vondel market.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_DELTA_VEHICLES_POI2_DESC: Repair and refuel ^.&&1^7 cargo trucks at the university.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_DELTA_VEHICLES_POI3_DESC: Repair and refuel ^.&&1^7 boat in Vondel.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_VEHICLE_DETAIL_DESC: Find a vehicle and get familiar with navigating the terrain. Commit entry and exit routes to memory. Just remember to keep a full tank.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_VEHICLE_PING_DESC: Ping a vehicle on the Tac-Map.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_VEHICLE_REFUEL_DESC: Fully refuel and repair a vehicle at a gas station.
PMC_S4/REFUEL_VEHICLE_USE_DESC: Find and then use a gas can from your backpack while in a vehicle to refuel it.
PMC_S4/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_DETAIL_DESC: We need soldiers that aren't hot heads. Defusing hostile engagements, and cooperating with other teams will prove beneficial for both you and our faction. We want you to try joining together with other teams. A bigger team means more firepower for us.
PMC_S4/REQUEST_ASSIMILATION_REQUEST_DESC: Hold [{+ping_wheel,+ping,+actionslot 1}] to request to assimilate with a nearby squad.
PMC_S4/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_DETAIL_DE: The revolver is a weapon of a true marksman. Al Mazrah policemen were known to use them as sidearms before AQ took over. Prove to us you know your fundamentals with precision fire on any enemy combatants.
PMC_S4/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with headshots using a Basilisk.
PMC_S4/REVOLVER_HEADSHOT_KILLS_LOOT_DESC: Acquire a Basilisk, commonly found in police stations.
PMC_S4/RUSSIAN_DOCS_DESC: Documents tying Konni to Koschei Complex
PMC_S4/RUSSIAN_HARDDRIVE_DESC: A Hard Drive belonging to the Russians.
PMC_S4/RUSSIAN_STORY_DOCS_NOTE:
[In Russian]
Michal, don't worry about the defenses of the new lab. You can trust that our elite Spetsnaz group will maintain security on the compound just as we did for Koschei. Albeit we will need a change of name to keep under the radar of prying eyes.

- K
PMC_S4/SAMSITE_SUPPLY_BOX_CAPTURE_DESC: Capture ^.&&1^7 SAM sites in one deployment.
PMC_S4/SAMSITE_SUPPLY_BOX_DETAIL_DESC: AQ is using surface-to-air missiles to protect their resupply shipments. Denying AQ these shipments will aid us in our upcoming operation. Your objective is to reroute two SAM sites to signals intel. We'll target incoming enemy aircraft while you move to secure equipment from the wreckage.
PMC_S4/SCAN_BIOBUNKER_EXITS_STORY_DETAIL: The map you extracted for us shows that there's potentially other entrances into the Koschei Complex. We believe there's two stairwells in the DRD that are blocked off, beyond which there's immense radiation emanating outwards. Locate those stairwells and get a reading on your Geiger counter. We'll hatch up a plan to secure them.
PMC_S4/SCAN_BIOBUNKER_EXITS_STORY_LOCATE: Locate the two stairwell exits in the DRD.
PMC_S4/SCAN_BIOBUNKER_EXITS_STORY_SCAN_D: Scan each exit with with a Geiger counter.
PMC_S4/SCHARLIE_PLATFORM_KILLS_ARMORED_D: Kill ^.&&1^7 armored enemies with the Tactique-Verte platform of weapons.
PMC_S4/SCHARLIE_PLATFORM_KILLS_DETAIL_DE: We're always looking to investigate how other weapon systems behave, both for our own personal usage, but also to better understand the enemy. We want you to use the Tactique-Verte platform to dispatch a few targets. Stay frosty.
PMC_S4/SCHARLIE_PLATFORM_KILLS_RANGED_DE: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a range of over ^.25^7 meters with the Tactique-Verte platform of weapons.
PMC_S4/SCOUTING_DESC: We've seen increased activity around UAV towers. Peacekeepers could be altering the functionality to allow for their specific encryption. Set yourself up at the castle and monitor the activity. With this much focus on signal encryption, we may have underestimated the scope of their communications.
PMC_S4/SCOUTING_MARK_ENEMIES_DESC: Mark ^.&&1^7 enemies while in the Castle using a Spotter Scope.
PMC_S4/SECURE_BIOBUNKER_EXITS_STORY_DESC: Secure both stairwell exits in the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S4/SECURE_BIOBUNKER_EXITS_STORY_DETA: We've figured out that there's a mechanism near each of the stairwell exits that should unlock the stairwell doors after some time. We just need you to go down there and secure those exits for us. We'll come in afterwards to secure the complex. Your work is greatly appreciated, soldier.
PMC_S4/SECURE_SUPPLIES_COMPLETE_DESC: Complete a Secure Supplies contract in ^.2:30^7 minutes.
PMC_S4/SECURE_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_DESC: Our contractee is sending a payout to any fireteams that can secure a list of supplies in the AO. Find a burner phone with intel on AQ's supply stashes and move in to secure them. Time is of the essence here so haul ass.
PMC_S4/SELL_ITEM_DESC: Sell a valuable item at a buy station.
PMC_S4/SELL_ITEM_DETAIL_DESC: Some of the things you'll find in the exclusion zone are quite valuable. You'll need to learn to make a profit out of what you can scavenge for our cause. Make your way to a buy station to sell any valuables. You can keep the cash for this mission.
PMC_S4/SELL_UNIQUE_ITEMS_DESC: Sell ^.&&1^7 unique valuables in one deployment
PMC_S4/SELL_UNIQUE_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: A great operator knows how to turn a profit. Get items to a buy station and cash them in for us. Show us that you're a great operator.
PMC_S4/SHADOW_COMPANY_LAPTOP_DESC: A laptop owned by Shadow Company.
PMC_S4/SIGNAL_EXFILS_FINAL_DETAIL_DESC: The enemy uses exfil helos as a way to ambush operators. Call for exfil at each point, but do not board. Scan for threats and eliminate any you find. Get to the final LZ when you're done.
PMC_S4/SIGNAL_EXFILS_FINAL_EXFIL_DESC: Extract on the final exfil in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/SIGNAL_EXFILS_FINAL_SIGNAL_DESC: Signal all ^.&&1^7 exfils in Al Mazrah in one deployment.
PMC_S4/SIPHON_DELIVER_GAS_DELIVER_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 full gas cans in Vondel.
PMC_S4/SIPHON_DELIVER_GAS_DETAIL_DESC: In preparation for an upcoming operation we need you to neutralize and sabotage ground vehicle targets in Vondel. Siphon fuel from any vehicles and dead drop full gas cans for us.
PMC_S4/SIPHON_DELIVER_GAS_SIPHON_DESC: Siphon ^.&&1^7 vehicles of gas in Vondel.
PMC_S4/SIPHON_USE_GAS_DETAIL_DESC: In the field you'll need to know how to effectively operate any motor vehicles you come across. In our case, we'd like you to sabotage some of Shadow Company's vehicles on Ashika Island. Siphon some gas with a non-full gas can while in a vehicle and then transfer that fuel to another vehicle.
PMC_S4/SIPHON_USE_GAS_REFUEL_DESC: Use ^.&&1^7 gas can in a vehicle to refuel.
PMC_S4/SIPHON_USE_GAS_SIPHON_DESC: Siphon the gas from ^.&&1^7 vehicle on Ashika Island.
PMC_S4/SMUGGLERS_RUN_DESC: We've established ourselves in Vondel, but we're not having the same luck identifying the enemy. Reports are that their forces use particular weapons, and at this point, we'll take any potential lead we can get our hands on. Secure their weapons, so we can try to locate their source. And if you take contact, I would advise using one yourself. They pack quite a punch.
PMC_S4/SMUGGLERS_RUN_DROP_DESC: Drop ^.&&1^7 ISO Hemlock weapons in a dead drop.
PMC_S4/SMUGGLERS_RUN_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with an ISO Hemlock weapon in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/SMUGGLERS_RUN_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with an ISO Hemlock.
PMC_S4/SNIPER_RUSHER_KILL_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Kill both the Sniper and the Rhino within 60 seconds of each other.
PMC_S4/SNIPER_RUSHER_KILL_SPEEDRUN_DETAI: The commanders in the bunker need to be taken out at the same time. One without the other will only further drive them to maintain their hold on the Koschei Complex. See to it that they're eliminated.
PMC_S4/SPICE_OF_LIFE_DESC: There's no such thing as being too prepared.  You need to be ready to grab any gun off of the ground and still be effective. Work with as many different weapons as you can and become a threat no matter what you're holding.
PMC_S4/SPICE_OF_LIFE_KILLS_UNIQUE_AMMO_C: Kill 10 enemies with a single ammo clip.
PMC_S4/SPICE_OF_LIFE_KILLS_UNIQUE_WEAPON: Kill enemies using ^.&&1^7 different weapons in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/START_CONTRACT_DESC: Find a contract phone and download the intel to start the contract.
PMC_S4/STOCKING_UP_DEPOSIT_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 ammo of any type to any dead drop.
PMC_S4/STOCKING_UP_DESC: Pointing big guns in the enemy's direction is only as useful as the number of bullets we have to let loose on them. To break through their toughest defenses, it's going to take a lot. Make a point of scavenging all the ammunition you can out there.
PMC_S4/STRESS_TEST_DESC: Every potential ally is an invaluable resource when the enemy has their own partners lurking in the shadows. Convincing other operators to cooperate can be tricky but you'll want as much support out there as possible against the Peacekeepers. Form alliances with other operators to make sure you all extract safely together.
PMC_S4/STRESS_TEST_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract in a helo carrying ^.&&1^7 or more operators.
PMC_S4/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Clear ^.&&1^7 locked strongholds each in under ^.20^7 seconds.
PMC_S4/STRONGHOLD_CLEAR_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_: Aggression will catch our enemies off guard. Locate strongholds and sweep them fast. Show others our speed of violence.
PMC_S4/STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_AL_MAZRAH_CITY_: Clear a stronghold in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S4/STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_DETAIL_DESC: Hello friend. There are a few targets of interest we'd like access to. Al Qatala has taken a foothold in the oilfields, AM city, and Taraq. We're looking to move some objectives through those areas. Can you handle the situation?
PMC_S4/STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_ROHAN_OIL_DESC: Clear a stronghold in Rohan Oil.
PMC_S4/STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_TARAQ_DESC: Clear a stronghold in Taraq Village.
PMC_S4/SUNKEN_SHIP_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: We've located sunken ships off the coasts of Al Mazrah and Ashika Island. Some intel found off of some unknown combatants seems to indicate these ships are of old Soviet origin. We've already cleared the easternmost ship in the Al Mazrah waters. It seemed to be part of a drug smuggling operation. Locate the remaining ships and bring back any items you find.
PMC_S4/SUNKEN_SHIP_STORY_SABA_DESC: Extract the ^.&&1^7 contraband packages from the sunken ships in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/SUNKEN_SHIP_STORY_SEALION_DESC: Extract the ^.&&1^7 contraband packages from the sunken ships in Ashika Island.
PMC_S4/SWAP_DELTA_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC:
A friend of ours left some key documents inside the Vondel Zoo's veterinary office. She's requesting that you retrieve them for her so that the unknown forces in Vondel don't get their hands on her work.

She wrote some false documents that you need to replace with the real documents. Bring the real documents to the 2nd floor of the church near the castle. You'll find the fake docs there as well. We'll send a small boat unit at night to retrieve the notes. Good luck then, and don't be seen.
PMC_S4/SWAP_DELTA_ITEMS_LOOT_DESC: Find the researcher's notes in the Vondel Zoo veterinary office.
PMC_S4/SWAP_DELTA_ITEMS_PLACE1_DESC: Place the researcher's notes on the 2nd floor of the church near the castle in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/SWAP_DELTA_ITEMS_PLACE2_DESC: Take the false notes from the church and place them in the veterinary's office in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/SYNC_SAMSITE_CONTROL_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala SAM sites in the area are limiting our aerial options. Secure enough at the same time for our resupply aircraft to land at our FOB.
PMC_S4/TAG_RADIATION_ENEMIES_DESC: Tag ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Al Mazrah radiation with a recon drone.
PMC_S4/TAG_RADIATION_ENEMIES_DETAIL_DESC: The Chemist has some intel from us that we'd like to not let others have. He's been spotted in the radiation zone of Al Mazrah. We need you to perform reconnaissance on the forces he's guarding himself with. Use a drone to tag any of his combatants.
PMC_S4/TEST_DRIVE_DESC: Canals are the veins of this city and we should be taking advantage. Tactical amphibious vehicles in the area can move between roads and waterways, and if any Peacekeepers use one for a quick retreat, you'll need to keep up. Find a TAV and get a feel for being behind the wheel. They can be used as boats but let's hope they don't handle like one.
PMC_S4/TEST_DRIVE_VISIT_DESC: Visit ^.&&1^7 POI using a Tactical Amphibious Vehicle in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/THE_GOOD_STUFF_DESC: Vehicles seem to play a crucial role in Peacekeeper operations. Either transportation is a top priority or they are carrying something worth protecting. One extremely fortified amphibious vehicle has been spotted driving around Vondel on a regular basis. Eliminate this dangerous target and recover whatever you can from the wreckage. Don't underestimate its defenses, make sure you're properly equipped.
PMC_S4/THE_GOOD_STUFF_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the Bullfrog Commander's Weapon Case in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/THE_GOOD_STUFF_KILL_DESC: Destroy the Bullfrog Commander from a vehicle.
PMC_S4/TRACK_BIOLABS_CARGO_DETAIL_DESC: Shadow Company transported goods into and out of the DRC on cargo trucks. We stashed some trackers in Building 21. Place them underneath the trucks and get out safely.
PMC_S4/TRACK_BIOLABS_CARGO_LOOT_DESC: Take ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Building 21 dead drop.
PMC_S4/TRACK_BIOLABS_CARGO_PLANT_DESC: Plant a tracking device under each of the ^.&&1^7 cargo trucks in the parking garage.
PMC_S4/TRACK_SUBMARINES_DETAIL_DESC: There are two submarines we've taken an interest in and we'd like to be prepared in case they come into use. We believe Shadow Company may be using the ports of Hafid and Ashika to transport DRC equipment. A courier prepared two dead drops with trackers for you. One in the southeast of Al-Sharim Pass and one in the town center of Ashika Island. Get trackers on the submarines and we'll see where they lead. Good luck out there.
PMC_S4/TRACK_SUBMARINES_LOOT_DESC: Take the ^.&&1^7 tracking devices from the Town Center or Al Sharim Pass dead drops.
PMC_S4/TRACK_SUBMARINES_PLANT_SABA_DESC: Plant a tracker on top of the submarine in Hafid Port.
PMC_S4/TRACK_SUBMARINES_PLANT_SEALION_DE: Plant a tracker on top of the submarine in the Ashika Island Waterways.
PMC_S4/TRACKING_ACTIVITY_DEPOSIT_DESC: Deliver the loaded tracker back to the dead drop at the Zoo.
PMC_S4/TRACKING_ACTIVITY_DESC: After confirming encrypted transmissions are being sent from the city, I made contact with another organization interested in the Vondel situation. Black Mous has agreed to assist by supplying us with a device that will let us track these specific signals to their destination, which we suspect may be Al Mazrah. Using the device on UAV towers there should allow you to confirm reception of the signal, then return the device for analysis. If we can uncover who the enemy is talking to, we'll have a better idea of who we are fighting.
PMC_S4/TRACKING_ACTIVITY_LOOT_DESC: Take the tracker from the dead drop in Vondel's Zoo.
PMC_S4/TRACKING_ACTIVITY_USE_DESC: Use ^.&&1^7 UAV towers in Al Mazrah while carrying the tracker in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/TRADE_KEYCODE_CODE_DESC: Enter the code into the locked room keypad in the Alpha Cluster entrance.
PMC_S4/TRADE_KEYCODE_DETAIL_DESC: The shopkeeper in Koschei Complex has something we'd like. The password to a locked door. I think you can convince him to trade it for some cheap liquor. Once you have the code, the door is directly left of the eastern entrance to the Alpha Cluster. There will be some documents within that we need you to extract.
PMC_S4/TRADE_KEYCODE_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the research documents from the room.
PMC_S4/TRADE_KEYCODE_TRADE_DESC: Trade the shopkeeper a bottle of liquor in exchange for the keycode.
PMC_S4/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: Intel located an ammo cache at the embassy in Al Mazrah City. Crown has been active in that area, so this is a priority target. We've stashed an explosive device in the tunnel near Zaya Observatory. Use the device on the ammo cache and destroy it.
PMC_S4/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_EXPLODE_DESC: Wait for the charge to detonate near the supply site.
PMC_S4/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Pickup the charge in the closed tunnel near Zaya Observatory.
PMC_S4/TRANSPORT_BOMB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Transport and drop the charge near the supply site at the U.S. Embassy in Al Mazrah City.
PMC_S4/TRAP_NO_DOWN_DESC: Complete a Raid Weapon Stash contract without being downed.
PMC_S4/TRAP_NO_DOWN_DETAIL_DESC: Al-Qatala is hiding their most expensive equipment in weapon stashes they keep protected in their strongholds. A contractee has data on their positions. Take the contract and secure the equipment without taking casualties.
PMC_S4/TRIATHLON_DRIVE_DESC: Drive ^.&&1^7 meters in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/TRIATHLON_SWIM_DESC: Swim ^.&&1^7 meters in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/TURN_THE_TIDE_COMPLETE_DESTROY_SU: Complete a Destroy Supplies contract in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/TURN_THE_TIDE_DESC: Resources continue to be delivered to the Peacekeepers but we can make sure that it's never enough. Confiscate what you can and destroy what you can't. Weakening their position should make them much less careful, and we'll be ready to intercept any intel as a result.
PMC_S4/TURN_THE_TIDE_DRILL_DESC: Drill ^.&&1^7 safes in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 contracts of unique types in a single deployment.
PMC_S4/UNIQUE_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: Contracts are still open all over the city, so get out there and clean the streets. Wrap up as many as you can so that we can shift all of our focus and resources into one final assault.
PMC_S4/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DESC: Complete ^.&&1^7 contracts in ^.8^7 unique POIs in one deployment.
PMC_S4/UNIQUE_POI_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_DESC: We're expanding our operations and are trying to secure resources to support ourselves. We need you to take on a high volume of contract work throughout the AO.
PMC_S4/UPLOAD_KONNI_HARDDRIVE_DETAIL_DES: Do you remember that Shadow Company laptop you procured? Well, we're going to use it to send some confidential intel to SC. An informant detailed the location of a hard drive with intel on the identity of the Vondel occupiers. Shadow Company has some interest in this but they are stretched too thin to retrieve the hard drive themselves. We need you to find it in Vondel and use the laptop to upload it to the Shadows. The hard drive was supposedly located in the graveyard behind one of the private mausoleums. Stay safe out there.
PMC_S4/UPLOAD_KONNI_HARDDRIVE_INFIL_DESC: Infil into Vondel with the Shadow Company laptop.
PMC_S4/UPLOAD_KONNI_HARDDRIVE_LOOT_DESC: Find and take the Russian hard drive from the graveyard in Vondel.
PMC_S4/UPLOAD_KONNI_HARDDRIVE_UPLOAD_DES: Use the laptop to upload the Russian hard drive to Shadow Company at an upload station.
PMC_S4/WATER_CAVES_STORY_DETAIL_DESC: One of our drone feeds showed AQ transporting a narcotics shipment through the Sattiq Cave Complex. They're likely in contact with the cartel. Infiltrate the caves by boat and clear the site. We know an AQ commander left some documents in a temporary shelter in the riverside caves. Bring them back for us and make it look like they were misplaced.
PMC_S4/WATER_CAVES_STORY_ENTER_DESC: Dock a boat at the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves.
PMC_S4/WATER_CAVES_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the smuggling records in the riverside caves in Sattiq Caves.
PMC_S4/WATER_CAVES_STORY_SWAP_DESC: Place sensitive documents at the original location of the smuggling records in the same deployment.
PMC_S4/WELCOME_TO_DELTA_ACTIVATE_DESC: Activate a UAV Tower in Vondel.
PMC_S4/WELCOME_TO_DELTA_DESC: Vondel has been infiltrated by hostile forces posing as a peacekeeping group, using their cover to spread through the city. In order to conduct operations effectively and expose who they really are, we need to establish our own footholds. Familiarize yourself with the city while gathering recon on the situation. Remember, the citizens are evacuated, so don't hesitate to collect souvenirs from the enemy while you get the lay of the land.
PMC_S4/WELCOME_TO_DELTA_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 radio marked enemies in Vondel.
PMC_S4/WELCOME_TO_DELTA_PICKUP_DESC: Pick up an enemy radio in Vondel.
PMC_S4/WORLD_TRIP_SOUVENIRS_DESC: Our focus remains on Vondel but it's clear the threat moves far beyond city limits. Knowing that the Peacekeepers are in communication with Al Mazrah, we need to maintain a strong presence elsewhere in case of other connections. Keep us ready on all fronts by deploying to different areas and eliminating threats to our other operations.
PMC_S4/WORLD_TRIP_SOUVENIRS_SABA_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 dog tags from Al Mazrah.
PMC_S4/WORLD_TRIP_SOUVENIRS_SEALION_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 dog tags from Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/ACQUIRE_HEAVY_CHOPPER_DETAIL_DESC:
One of our evac helos sustained a fuel leak and was abandoned in the AO. It's bingo on fuel and inoperable at this time. If AQ or Konni gain access to the helo eyes will be directed at our organization for providing such expensive equipment for the enemy. We can't let that happen. Find fuel for the heavy chopper, refuel the bird, and pilot it out of the AO. You will have our utmost gratitude for this task.

We tracked a Konni shipment of heavy chopper fuel that they distributed to various locations along the Al Mazrah railway. Intel suggests there could be remaining fuel at either the Rohan Oil train station, the Hafid Port station, the AM International hangers, in the Sattiq smuggling caves, or on the cargo train itself.
PMC_S5/BOSS_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: We need some more intel on how the cartel knew about the bunker. We now believe that they were in communication with the Konni group. We believe the Rhino led the charge on the intel. Eliminate him and secure all objectives. With the cartel spotted in Vondel we'll also need to you gather any intel on their end of the deal.
PMC_S5/BOSS_INTEL_EXTRACT_KONNI_DESC: Extract the deal documents from the cruise terminal office in Vondel.
PMC_S5/BOSS_INTEL_EXTRACT_RHINO_DESC: Take and extract the documents from the Rhino.
PMC_S5/BUYSTATION_KILLSTREAK_DETAIL_DESC: We have secured and authorized payment for heavy artillery at the nearest buy station. Bring the appropriate amount of funds and take out enemy forces in the area.
PMC_S5/BUYSTATION_KILLSTREAK_PURCHASED_D: Purchase ^.&&1^7 killstreaks from a buy station.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_KONNI_CAMERA_TAKE_PICTURE_: Get a shot of a Cartel soldier together with Konni in your tactical camera.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_LOCATE_DETAIL_DESC: Good to see you again soldier. We have a major threat on our hands. Russian gas is being transported by the cartel as we speak, and unless we're able to keep on the hunt, we won't know where it's going. Building 21's signals intel indicates the cartel is moving that gas to their own base of operations. We need eyes inside Building 21 to discover where that gas is going. Now get at 'em.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_LOCATE_MARK_MEMBER_DESC: Mark a member of the transportation group in their base of operations.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_LOCATE_MARK_SHIPMENT_DESC: Mark a shipment near their base of operations.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_LOCATE_READ_DESC: Find and read the email off the laptop in the 3rd floor office in Building 21.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_REVEAL_INTEL_DESC: I know we've had our differences in the past but you're no stranger to the power of hard cash right? Here's the deal. There's a bunker hidden deep under Al Mazrah. A relic of our past so to say. Their entrances have been buried, and we just need you to gain access to them. The catch? We need you to team up with AQ and feign that you discovered the bunker on your own. What we do afterwards isn't of your concern, but I recommend leaving soon after you secure the bunkers.
PMC_S5/CARTEL_TRANSPORTATION_PLANS_NOTE:
[In Russian]
We'll need to rendezvous with the cartel to transfer the gas. From there they'll take it to the target destination. For now let's designate the safe house as the meeting location. Discretion is of utmost importance. 

- V
PMC_S5/CLEAN_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies without taking damage from them.
PMC_S5/CLEAN_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: We are losing several soldiers in skirmishes with the enemy forces. We need your squad to carefully dispose of enemy soldiers.
PMC_S5/COLLECT_BOUNTIES_DETAIL_DESC: We have word of enemy squads causing chaos in the AO, firing on passive operators. They're distracting our forces from the primary Russian threat. There's bounties on those squads. Go see if you can't make yourself worthwhile.
PMC_S5/COMPOUND_KILL_LOCATION_DETAIL_DES: Enemy forces have strengthened across the globe. We need your team to take them out.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_DESTROY_SITES_DETAIL_DES: Several locations have been taken over by enemy forces. We need you to destroy these sites.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_HOSTAGE_RESCUE_DETAIL_DE: We have seen an uptick in hostages taken under enemy forces. We need your squad to secure and rescue these hostages.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_LOCATION_DETAIL_DESC: We have accumulated several international jobs. Fulfill these contracts and secure payment.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_SECURE_INTEL_DETAIL_DESC: An unknown enemy has been operating across the globe and we need your team to secure intel and provide us information on their plans.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_SECURE_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_D: An abundance of enemy supplies are being traced back to the cartel. We need you to secure these supplies.
PMC_S5/CONTRACT_WEAPON_STASH_DETAIL_DESC: We have seen an uptick in enemy weapons being hoarded. We need you to disrupt and secure these supplies.
PMC_S5/DAILY_ASSIMILATE_DETAILED_DESC: We need you to share intel with other enemy squads. Get out there and try not to kill each other.
PMC_S5/DAILY_CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DETAIL_DES: Our opposition has a strategic advantage with multiple strongholds in the AO. We need you to eliminate any targets on site.
PMC_S5/DAILY_COMPLETE_CONTRACTS_DETAIL_D: We're at a loss for cash. Complete some contracts for us and bring us back any objectives you earn.
PMC_S5/DAILY_DEAD_DROP_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: Our supply lines are tight. We have some objectives we need secured. Bring the targets to a designated dead drop.
PMC_S5/DAILY_EXTRACT_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We need certain objectives extracted out of the AO. Our birds will be waiting for you.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: Our opposition is gaining space and we need you to take it back. Get out there and show us what you can do with a weapon in hand.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILL_REINFORCEMENT_HELIS_SA: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILL_REINFORCEMENT_HELIS_SE: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILLS_BIOBUNKER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Koschei Complex.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILLS_RANGED_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a range of over ^.50^7 meters.
PMC_S5/DAILY_KILLS_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with marksman rifles or snipers.
PMC_S5/DEAD_DROP_KONNI_ITEMS_DETAIL_DESC: We're looking for intel on what Konni's long term plans are. Eliminate key Konni targets and deliver all objectives found on their person to one of our designated dead drops. Good hunting.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_ATTACHED_WEAPONS_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons with five attachments.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_ATTACHED_WEAPONS_DETAIL_: We have seen reports of weapons being captured by enemy forces. We need these weapons out of the hands of our enemies.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_BACKPACKS_DETAIL_DESC: We are noticing an alarming amount of illicit items being smuggled by enemy forces via backpacks. Deliver backpacks to dead drops to prevent them from being used by the enemy.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_ALMAZRAH_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_ASHIKA_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_BIOLAB_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash in Building 21.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_BIOLAB_DETAIL_DESC: Graves has instructed us to reduce the cash reserves of Building 21. Please dead drop any cash you find in Building 21.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_DETAIL_DESC: We have been asked by several local governments to track the exorbitant amount of money being funneled through terrorist organizations. We have secured several dead drop locations where this cash can be deposited and traced.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_CASH_VONDEL_DESC: Dead drop $^.&&1^7 in cash in Vondel.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_COMPUTERS_DETAIL_DESC: We have secured intelligence that there is potentially a new weapons simulation program located on various pieces of tech strewn across the area. We need you to secure this information.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_GAS_CANS_DETAIL_DESC: We are running low on fuel for our vehicles. We need you to secure as much gas as you can and provide it at the nearest dead drop.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_PHOTOS_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 pictures of people or pets.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_PHOTOS_DETAIL_DESC: Our organization has been hired to locate missing refugees and families reported missing. We have been tasked with gathering photographs portraying these families.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_VEHICLE_DETAIL_DESC: Some of our vehicles are in desperate need of repair and need supplies to be fixed.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_WEAPONS_LOCATION_ALMAZRA: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_WEAPONS_LOCATION_ASHIKA_: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 weapons on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/DEADDROP_WEAPONS_LOCATION_DETAIL_: We are noticing an abundance of unauthorized weapons around the globe and need to make sure these do not reach enemy hands. Please deposit these at the nearest dead drop and we will make sure they are safely disposed of.
PMC_S5/DESTROY_CARTEL_DETAIL_DESC: Okay this is it. We need to assault that terminal here and now. Intel reports a multitude of secure safes inside and cargo outside waiting for transportation. We don't know if the gas is still in those safes but we need to find out. Reinforcements will be all over your ass once you're in so stay frosty.
PMC_S5/DESTROY_CARTEL_DETONATE_DESC: Detonate charges on the ^.&&1^7 cargo shipments outside the Terminal in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/DESTROY_CARTEL_SAFES_DESC: Open the ^.&&1^7 safes and search for any gas in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/EXFIL_BIOLAB_DETAIL_DESC: We need more eyes and ears at Building 21 for an investigation. Shadow Company has lost a lot of good soldiers there. We are sending your squad to investigate. Please return alive and in one piece.
PMC_S5/EXTRACTION_PROTOCOL_NOTE:
Now that we've gathered all the data we can, our job is to move all sensitive data to secure hard drives to transport to HQ immediately. Remember shadows, Konni's going to watching us to blast a hole through any transport exiting this compound. Use the tunnels underneath the DRC to load up the armored truck at Building 1. Good luck out there.

- Graves
PMC_S5/FALSE_REINFORCEMENT_SIGNAL_STORY_: Given the positions of those missile launchers, we believe Konni is targeting some attack on Al Mazrah. It's likely that these missiles were sourced with the help of their explosives expert, who has been spotted on Ashika Island. See if you can't find out where they're planning to attack.
Take and extract the combat intel off of the Konni reinforcements.
Find the intel off of Konni's Bomb Maker.
Send a false signal for Konni reinforcements at the target location.
PMC_S5/FINAL_EXFIL_HOSTAGE_DESC: Exfil a hostage at the final exfil.
PMC_S5/FINAL_EXFIL_HOSTAGE_DETAIL_DESC: We have some targets we need you to extract. With the ongoing Konni conflict, we believe the Russians are tracking our birds. Extract them on a neutral organization's exfil chopper to help conceal the target's whereabouts.
PMC_S5/FIND_ENTER_MRAP_DETAIL_DESC: There's an MRAP that was engaged by Konni troops and abandoned in the AO. We'd like for you to commandeer the vehicle. You'll need to acquire a key for it and make your way to the objective. Get out there soldier.
PMC_S5/FIND_ENTER_MRAP_LOOT_DESC: Acquire the key to the MRAP by finding it or purchasing it at a buy station.
PMC_S5/FLUSH_OUT_DECOY_DESC: Throw a decoy grenade into the safe house to flush out the guards.
PMC_S5/FLUSH_OUT_DETAIL_DESC:
Hey there again. We require fast action to intercept those Konni gas transports. We acquired intel that the transportation operations were handled within some safe house of Konni's planned out by one of their commanders.

We need you to find that safe house and secure any objectives on site. Remember, slow is smooth, smooth is fast. Get it done.
PMC_S5/FLUSH_OUT_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the intel off of the Konni guards inside.
PMC_S5/FLUSH_OUT_LOCATE_DESC: Find the Konni safe house plans from the Commander Helo.
PMC_S5/GAS_CANISTER_DESC: A gas canister procured from Konni.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_BRONZE_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 bronze dog tags or better.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_DETAIL_DESC: Unaffiliated mercenaries have been spotted in the area. We have determined them to be a threat and they have taken out several of our key operators. We need you to take them out and bring their dog tags to confirm the kill.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_GOLD_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 gold dog tag or better.
PMC_S5/HUNT_SQUAD_SILVER_DESC: Dead drop ^.&&1^7 silver dog tags or better.
PMC_S5/INVESTIGATE_SHIPPING_CONTAINER_ST: Clear all hostiles on the ship to the southeast of Al Bagra Fortress.

Glad to see you're back in one piece. Satellite imagery places an unknown ship anchoring off the coast of the A.M. airport. A number of suspicious containers and combatants are on board. Clear the deck and open those suckers up.
Investigate the contents of the shipping containers.
PMC_S5/IRRADIATED_GAS_CANSITER_DESC: A canister used by Konni to test the effects of irradiated Russian gas as a means to radioactively poison the bloodstream.
PMC_S5/KILL_COMMANDERS_WITHOUT_DYING_DET: It's time to make an impact on Konni's organizational capacity. We're targeting their commanders. Eliminate these key targets and come back alive. Good hunting out there.
PMC_S5/KILL_EXTRACT_KONNI_BIOLABS_DETAIL: So it seems that Konni has overtaken Building 21 after we left. Not unexpected on our part, but we wanna clean up any objectives we might have left there. And well you're our clean up crew. Reportedly Konni soldiers got their hands on our extraction procedures from the lab. Get that for us will you?
PMC_S5/KILL_EXTRACT_KONNI_BIOLABS_EXTRAC: Extract the extraction protocol from Building 21.
PMC_S5/KILL_HELICOPTER_SEA_LION_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/KILL_HELICOPTER_SEA_LION_DETAIL_D: We have a priority task for you. Konni forces are engaging our troops still stationed on Ashika Island. Konni's reinforcements are proving to be overwhelming for our numbers there and they're running out of supplies. Get your ass over there and save our shadows.
PMC_S5/KILL_KONNI_DETAIL_DESC:
Hope you did your basics. We have a situation on us that's demanding for some more hands on deck. We've confirmed the force in Vondel to be working for the Russian Konni Group. Intel places them securing territory in Al Mazrah and Ashika Island.

This is where you come in. Eliminate those sons of bitches, come back alive, and we'll see about your payment. Get at 'em soldier.
PMC_S5/KILL_KONNI_SABA_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 Konni soldiers in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/KILL_KONNI_SEALION_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 Konni soldiers on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/KILL_OPERATORS_LOCATION_DETAIL_DE: Unaffiliated operators have been spotted in the area. They could be working with enemy forces and we have authorized that they be taken out.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_ALMAZRAH_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at Taraq Village in Al Mazrah.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_ASHIKA_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at the Tsuki Castle on Ashika Island.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_DETAIL_DESC: We have seen an increase of enemy operations at key locations such as the Zoo in Vondel, the Tsuki Castle on Ashika Island, and Taraq Village in Al Mazrah. Neutralize the enemy in these key locations.
PMC_S5/KILL_POI_VONDEL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies at the Zoo in Vondel.
PMC_S5/KILL_RANGED_IN_RADIATION_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in radiation with headshots from over ^.35^7 meters.
PMC_S5/KILL_RANGED_IN_RADIATION_DETAIL_D: Konni forces have been spotted on drone surveillance investigating the radiation in Al Mazrah and Ashika Island. We'd like you to knock some heads. Keep your identity concealed and be efficient.
PMC_S5/KILL_SNIPER_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a sniper rifle.
PMC_S5/KILL_SNIPER_DETAIL_DESC: Several of our soldiers have directly engaged with the enemy, we need your squad to take out the enemy forces from a distance using a sniper rifle.
PMC_S5/KILL_TURRET_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with an LTV turret.
PMC_S5/KILL_TURRET_DETAIL_DESC: We have noticed several vehicles equipped with turrets being used by enemy forces. We need you to capture these vehicles and use their own fire power against them.
PMC_S5/KILL_UAV_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies pinged by a UAV tower.
PMC_S5/KILL_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: We need your squad to provide reconnaissance and at your discretion take out any enemies highlighted in the area.
PMC_S5/KILLS_ALMAZRAH_DETAIL_DESC: We are seeing an uptick in enemy forces in Al Mazrah, we need you to take them out.
PMC_S5/KILLS_ASHIKA_DETAIL_DESC: Ashika Island has been overrun by enemy forces and is disrupting our organization's work. We need your squad to neutralize this threat.
PMC_S5/KILLS_CLOSE_DETAIL_DESC: We have seen a lot of unconfirmed kills and would like you to make sure that your kills are confirmed by being close to the target upon death.
PMC_S5/KILLS_MELEE_DETAIL_DESC: We are running low on guns and ammunition. We need you to use more personal means of taking out your enemies such as knives, riot shields, or swords.
PMC_S5/KILLS_VONDEL_DETAIL_DESC: Vondel is increasingly becoming a hostile place. We need you to disrupt and take out as many enemy combatants as possible to restore some peace.
PMC_S5/KONNI_BATTLE_NOTE_DESC:
[In Russian]
Make your way into AM through the DRD and up through the chemical plant. AQ isn't expecting any resistance right now. Setup a heavy assault in the city and we'll have time to bring armored vehicles from the north undetected.
PMC_S5/KONNI_COMBAT_INTEL_DESC:
[In Russian]
Once we're able to open up the target, our team needs to set security around the site's south side while evac teams extract the sensitive objective inside. Anticipate Shadow Company interference. There's no retreating from this critical objective.
PMC_S5/KONNI_REVEAL_INTEL_DESC: Glad to be working with you again. I'm sure you enjoyed the spoils of deceiving AQ, not that they know. I have another job for you. You'll meet us at Ashika Island to take a certain cargo off of our hands. Move it to Vondel, and from there you'll distribute the objective to key locations in Europe. It's a simple operation, and I'm sure this isn't your first transportation job. This one is more critical however, and I trust you understand the consequences of your actions here.
PMC_S5/KONNI_SAFEHOUSE_INTEL_NOTE:
[In Russian]
We'll need a safe house to help distribute the chemicals. I trust that you'll be able to oversee its operation? I suggest somewhere in Ashika Island. The tourist center there seems both defensible and discrete. It is critical that those shadows don't discover it, otherwise we risk our deal coming to light.
- K
PMC_S5/KONNI_SHIP_INTEL_DESC:
[In Russian]
The ship is set to arrive at night from Vondel. It's not officially meant to dock so it'll instead anchor down near the airport where we'll be able to take the cargo off easily. Make sure that area is secured.
PMC_S5/LOCATE_MISSILE_CONTAINERS_DETAIL_:
We traced that Konni ship back to Europe where it was reported that eight shipping containers made it onto that deck, yet only six are currently spotted. Now with two missile launchers out in the wild for Konni to use, well that just doesn't sound right does it.

Here's what you're gonna help to do about it. We believe those launchers are somewhere in Al Mazrah. We need you to find where they're planning on moving the missiles to and plant beacons on them for us to surveil. Lay low out there.
PMC_S5/LOCATE_MISSILE_CONTAINERS_LOCATE_: Locate the remaining missiles using the transportation plans from the Konni ship in one deployment.
PMC_S5/LOCATE_MISSILE_CONTAINERS_LOOT_DE: Take the ^.2^7 IR beacons from the Zaya Observatory dead drop and plant ^.&&1^7 near the first missile.
PMC_S5/LOCATE_MISSILE_CONTAINERS_PLANT_D: Plant ^.&&1^7 IR beacon at the second missile.
PMC_S5/LOOT_GAS_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 leftover gas canisters from the exposed Observatory lab.
PMC_S5/LOOT_GAS_DETAIL_DESC: Good day there. Some of our operators noted that Konni hasn't yet managed to transport all gas canisters from the observatory lab. We'd like for you to secure whatever leftovers you can find. We'll talk about your payment when you're back.
PMC_S5/MATCH_UAV_DESC: Activate 3 UAV towers per match ^.&&1^7 Times.
PMC_S5/MATCH_UAV_DETAIL_DESC: We need your squad to provide reconnaissance. We have several UAV towers stationed at various locations. Activate these UAV Towers to provide sight on the enemy.
PMC_S5/MISSILE_INTEL_DESC:
[In Russian]
I've got eyes on some weapons that will be able to blast open the objective with plausible deniability. We'll need security on those observatory tunnel entrances. Get forces ready to reinforce the area if they get a signal.
PMC_S5/MISSION_COOPERATIVE_DESC: Help squadmates complete ^.&&1^7 missions without squad wiping.
PMC_S5/MISSION_COOPERATIVE_DETAIL_DESC: We have some operators that need some squadmates to help accomplish their objectives. I figure that you, as an experienced fighter, should be able to handle yourself enough to help them out. Hopefully I'm not mistaken.
PMC_S5/MRAP_VEHICLE_KILL_CHOPPER_BOSS_DE: Destroy the Helo Commander from the MRAP.
PMC_S5/MRAP_VEHICLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: We need to show our opposition that our Shadows are here to stay. Your job in this is to showcase our firepower. Acquire an MRAP and wreak havoc on anyone who'd cross us. Come back in one piece for your reward.
PMC_S5/MRAP_VEHICLE_KILL_HELICOPTERS_DES: Destroy ^.&&1^7 reinforcement helicopters from the MRAP.
PMC_S5/MRAP_VEHICLE_KILL_OPERATOR_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators or commanders from the MRAP.
PMC_S5/MULTI_ATTACHMENT_KILL_ACOG_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the MCPR-300 with a hybrid sight equipped in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/MULTI_ATTACHMENT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: That intel you brought revealed the severity of the situation at hand with Konni. But we still need to investigate the exact nature and purpose of their global operations. This is what we need you for. Your job is to cause enough chaos that Konni slips up. Fire at targets from varying ranges and positions to confuse the enemy. We'll then send in ISR teams to analyze their operations.
PMC_S5/MULTI_ATTACHMENT_KILL_REFLEX_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the MCPR-300 with iron sights.
PMC_S5/MULTI_ATTACHMENT_KILL_THERMAL_DES: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with the MCPR-300 with a thermal sight equipped in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/PLANE_ENCOUNTER_DETAIL_DESC: With Konni taking hold of the cave complex in Al Mazrah, we'd like you to secure some information on our crashed plane and neutralize any hostiles on site. Good hunting.
PMC_S5/PLANE_ENCOUNTER_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Download data from the crashed plane's black box.
PMC_S5/PLANE_ENCOUNTER_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract with the black box data in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/PLANE_ENCOUNTER_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in the Sattiq Caves Complex in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/R4D_TRACK_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract item off of corpse at end of trail.
PMC_S5/R4D_TRACK_TRACK_DESC: Use the R4D to track blood splatters.
PMC_S5/RADIATION_DEFEND_DETAIL_DESC: Some drone footage we were able to capture showed Konni transporting secured safes and gas canisters into the radioactive sectors of the AO. We believe they're doing some kind of testing on the effects of radiation on their gas samples. Get access to one of those safes and secure the objective.
PMC_S5/RADIATION_DEFEND_DRILL_DESC: Drill open the secured safe in the Vondel radiation.
PMC_S5/RADIATION_DEFEND_EXTRACT_DESC: Find and extract the gas canister inside.
PMC_S5/RAT_KING_KILL_KING_DESC: Kill the Rat King in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/RESCUE_LABS_HOSTAGE_DESC: Rescue the hostage from the Building 21 armory.
PMC_S5/RESCUE_LABS_HOSTAGE_DETAIL_DESC: While we look into the cartel's base of operations in Vondel, our associate who got us that intel on Building 21 was found out. We'd like to get him outta there before Konni does God knows what to him. We believe he's being held in the armory room. Get him back to us and you'll be rewarded.
PMC_S5/SCAVENGER_BUY_STATION_BUY_DESC: Buy an item at the Scavenger's buy station while wearing the disguise.
PMC_S5/SCAVENGER_BUY_STATION_DETAIL_DESC: We have some suspicions that some of our enemies have been resupplying from a target known as the Scavenger. You may be already familiar. We need eyes on what he's dealing, so lay low and get close enough to peruse his offerings.
PMC_S5/SCAVENGER_TRADE_BARTER_DESC: Barter for the defective dog bank from the Scavenger.
PMC_S5/SCAVENGER_TRADE_DETAIL_DESC: The Koschei Shopkeeper claims to have acquired some critical intel on Konni. He wants some peculiar items, though I'm sure a soldier of your caliber should have no issues getting him what he wants right? Well, good luck out there.
PMC_S5/SCAVENGER_TRADE_SHOPKEEPER_DESC: Deliver the defective dog bank to the Shopkeeper's dead drop in Koschei Complex.
PMC_S5/SPEED_DEADDROP_CHAIN_DELIVER_ALT1: Deliver the same laptop to the Zaya Observatory, Ahkdar, and Al Sharim Pass dead drops within ^.3^7 minutes of the first delivery.
PMC_S5/SPEED_DEADDROP_CHAIN_DETAIL_DESC: While we sift through intelligence on those missiles, we have an odd job for you. We need you to give us access to a laptop. An associate was able to plant some USBs in dead drops that you will just need to plug into the laptop and then remove. To evade any security alerts we'll need them delivered in a rapid time frame. Get to it.
PMC_S5/SPEED_DEADDROP_CHAIN_LOOT_DESC: Take the laptop from the Hydroelectric dead drop.
PMC_S5/STIM_PISTOL_ENEMY_DESC: Revive a downed enemy with a revive pistol.
PMC_S5/STIM_PISTOL_ENEMY_DETAIL_DESC: Back again then huh? No matter, we have a mission for you to develop your people skills. We need you to be able to deescalate conflicts and cooperate with other operators. Go out there and show us that you're not hot-headed and that you can successfully disengage active conflicts.
PMC_S5/STRONGHOLD_CODE_DETAIL_DESC:
Welcome back soldier. Operation Rogue Arsenal was a failure. Makarov escaped with the objective and we need to move fast to try to intercept them.

Intel reports Konni taking a hold in the ruins of the observatory. A Konni commander was spotted moving a laptop into a locked storage closet in the observatory lab offices. We need you to retrieve it. Find a radio in one of Konni's strongholds and we'll intercept to acquire the door's code. Stay frosty out there.
PMC_S5/STRONGHOLD_CODE_EXTRACT_DESC: Use the code to open the locked closet in the destroyed Zaya Observatory and extract the laptop inside.
PMC_S5/STRONGHOLD_CODE_RADIO_DESC: Acquire a code from a radio from an Al Mazrah stronghold while disguised.
PMC_S5/TRANSPORT_DECOY_DEAD_DROP_DESC: Deliver it to the Observatory dead drop.
PMC_S5/TRANSPORT_DECOY_DETAIL_DESC: One of our associates left a specially engineered grenade at the top of the Sarrif Bay lighthouse. He's requesting that we bring it back and since we owe him, well that's where you come in. Take the grenade and bring it to the observatory dead drop. Trust me, you'll have my thanks for this one.
PMC_S5/TRANSPORT_DECOY_LOOT_DESC: Take the decoy grenade from the Sarrif lighthouse.
PMC_S5/TRANSPORTATION_PLANS_NOTE:
[In Russian]
We don't have enough resources to move each container at once. Let's send the first one to the cemetery and we'll have to figure the rest out after.
PMC_S5/TRAVEL_POI_UNDAMAGED_DESC: Visit ^.&&1^7 POIs without taking any health damage.
PMC_S5/TRAVEL_POI_UNDAMAGED_DETAIL_DESC: We have lost several squads in recent deployments. We need to assess the situation, please visit several locations and be extremely cautious not to be seen and not to receive fire.
PMC_S5/UNAWARE_KILL_CLOSE_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies who are unaware of you from a range of under ^.10^7 meters.
PMC_S5/UNAWARE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC: See you're back in one piece. Well then, let's not waste any time. We need you to help keep Konni forces on their toes. Use concealment to neutralize OPFOR units with stealth. They won't know what hit them.
PMC_S5/UNAWARE_KILL_FAR_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies who are unaware of you from a range of over ^.40^7 meters.
PMC_S5/VEHICLE_ASSISTS_DESC: Have an enemy operator kill ^.&&1^7 enemies from a vehicle you are driving.
PMC_S5/VEHICLE_ASSISTS_DETAIL_DESC: We need someone that can work with other operators in the fight against Konni. Find some enemy operators to help kill any Konni soldiers you find. Move, shoot, and communicate.
PMC_S5/VEHICLE_MASS_DESTRUCTION_BOSS_DES: Destroy the Bullfrog commander in the same deployment.
PMC_S5/VEHICLE_MASS_DESTRUCTION_DESC: Destroy all aquatic vehicles in a Vondel deployment.
PMC_S5/VEHICLE_MASS_DESTRUCTION_DETAIL_D: The cartel is using boats to transport the gas shipments out of Vondel. We need you to disrupt their operations. Target any transportation vehicles you find. Now get at it.
PMC_S5/WEAPON_GIVE_DETAIL_DESC: We need to arm and recruit other fighters to aid our cause against the Konni group. Give one of your insured weapons to another operator for them to extract. Try to keep your cool and avoid any unnecessary conflict with enemy squads.
PMC_S5/WEAPON_GIVE_EXTRACT_DESC: Have an enemy operator extract your insured weapon before you exfiltrate.
PMC_S5/WEAPON_GIVE_GIVE_DESC: Give your insured weapon to an enemy operator.
seasonal_event/delta_community_desc: Collect Medals as a community to unlock a new weapon and gameplay elements in Vondel.
hash_11c02ea7db73a168: One of the most iconic structures of the Vondel skyline, this historic castle is the perfect backdrop for all of your photography needs.
hash_713525dc654ec9f0: Home to finely-crafted stonemasonry, a peaceful place to take a breath and reflect on our past.
hash_40a11628104085a8: Take a stroll through the front courtyard and admire the artistry and atmosphere that Vondel is famous for.
hash_1330bc356f5fe617: Solid intel is crucial to our operation so we need eyes and ears everywhere. Learn what you can in the field.
hash_56aac4136dfb343b: Securing and delivering equipment to the front lines is essential. Sustain pressure and clear the way.
hash_43bb653541f1b061: We're fighting on multiple fronts. Join in any of the operations around the globe and support the effort.
hash_6e027ea5cd75be27: Rivenburg University boasts an impressive selection of reading material for whenever you're looking for a nice, quiet spot to relax.
hash_d8a462c270c0ad6: Even if you're just window shopping, don't miss the elegant experience of perusing this luxurious set of stores and cafes.
hash_3c79a11d843c8c6c: Home to an incredible variety of local vendors, there's always exciting displays featured in this city square.
hash_1e7b4f77cb1b4418: Learn something new at either of the city's museums, offering guided audio tours and perfect souvenirs.
hash_ed2948b3b230d67: Join a roaring home crowd in cheering on the Lions at Vondel's gorgeous stadium, offering premium seating and amenities.
hash_64a995084c6c9d00: Magnificent architecture providing a perfect gateway into or out of Vondel.
hash_4e71f5a5417470f8: Go wild and experience the majesty of nature through beautiful biomes and a full aquarium.
hash_7ec3f30f202b33: Complete Mastery Challenges in Warzone, DMZ or Multiplayer to earn medals.
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_CHILD: Use ^55^7 Killstreaks, or earn all ^53^7 Killstreaks in one life
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_FOX: Punch a vehicle ^510^7 times before it explodes
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_SECRET2: Get Top ^53^7 in a Battle Royale match
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_SKUNK: Get ^55^7 Throwing Knife kills in a single match
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_TEENA: Win a ^52v2^7 match as the top scorer
SPLASHES/CHALLENGE_TEENB: Crouch rapidly over several players after you've killed them
STORE/DESCRIPTION_SEASON_1_RAID_BUNDLE_M: Unlock by purchasing this Raid Bundle then completing Raid Episode 1.
STORE/DESCRIPTION_SEASON_2_RAID_BUNDLE_M: Unlock by purchasing this Raid Bundle then completing Raid Episode 2.
STORE_FLAVOR/DMZ_OPERATOR_SLOT_DESC: Adds 1 more Active Duty Operator Slot to DMZ.
store_flavor/operator_default_eastern_k_: Wreak some havoc with the Shadow Company I Mil-Sim Skin.
store_flavor/operator_kyle_western_basic: Cut down the competition with Gaz\xe2\x80\x99s Sabre Operator Skin.
store_flavor/operator_lerch_eastern_basi: Make them feel small in Lerch's Behemoth Operator Skin.
store_flavor/operator_roze_eastern_a_fla: Plan your moves accordingly with Roze's Rook Operator Skin
super_mp/deadsilence_desc: Temporarily makes your footsteps silent. Gun, melee, and throwing knife kills refresh duration.
super_mp/personal_redeploy_drone_insuffi: Not enough space to use Drone
vehicles/apc_desc: This amphibious APC can lay down 30mm cannon fire, transport up to 6 squad members to the front line, and serves as a mobile spawn point.
vehicles/atv_desc: Take charge with rough and ready capability delivered with plenty of low-rpm torque and power. Top-tier rack capacity offers an impressive payload capability: hold 'er wide and send it.
vehicles/c130_desc: A heavy assault gunship equipped with a laser tracking missile, along with the standard 40mm and 25mm cannons.
vehicles/cargo_truck_desc: A large industrial vehicle. Slow moving, but may provide a small amount of protection in firefights.
vehicles/jeep_desc: Built and designed without compromise, a spacious interior allows for crew transportation to even the most remote corners of the map. Confident on- or off-road, with the durability to tackle the most extreme of challenges, the SUV can take a beating and keep on ticking.
vehicles/light_tank_desc: A maneuverable tank with a multipurpose turret and light armor.
vehicles/little_bird_desc: A twin-engine light helicopter for combat support and rapid traversal of the engagement zone.
vehicles/tac_rover_desc: The pinnacle of ultra-light tactical off-road vehicles, allowing rapid personnel deployment for squads of up to four. Go deep and hard in the most rugged and austere environments with world-class mobility and versatility.
vehicles/vehicle_horn_mountainking: In the Hall of the Mountain King
vehicles/vehicle_horn_toccata: Toccata and Fugue in D minor
WEAPON/COUNTERWEIGHT_DESC: Modified FHR40 scanned in Geneva which has built-in reduced recoil.
WEAPON/REPEATER_DESC: Modified R.A.W. with an increased ammo capacity. Headshot kills will refill the clip.
